filas.intro:
The senior leadership in the Angel Lyceum 
 is shocked by the brazen attack from the Evil Lyceum.
 To stop them in their tracks, Michael has 
 ordered the Angels to head to Eden at once,
 rescue the three Goddesses, and drive the 
 evil out of Eden forever!
pasos: 1. Go to Mushroom Village to \n meet with Blocks Envoy.
2. Defeat Trainee Witch or Crystal Envoy: \n /c$9%16075%/c* /100
3. Report to Blocks Envoy.
4. Find Guerrilla Leader Mola in Building Blocks County\n

filas.intro:
What we've learned from Guerrilla Leader Mola
 is that the territory between Building Blocks City and Poker city 
 are all occupied. Building Blocks city 
 is the last line of defense 
 and our enemies are closing in on it.
 Can you assist Mola in defeating these enemies?
pasos: 1. Defeat Fireball Baby or Flower Thorn Baby: \n /c$9%16076%/c* / 100
2. Report to Guerrilla Leader Mola.
3. Defeat Dog Fighters: /c$9%16077%/c* /100
4. Report to Guerrilla Leader Mola.
5. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City\n, and claim the rewards from him.

filas.intro:
Thanks to your help, Lord Kahn 
 has plans to recapture Eden.
 But first we need to eliminate 
 all the enemies in the area. Please 
 help me to eliminate all the enemies 
you can find near Building Blocks City.
pasos: 1. Defeat Dessert Fruit Fly or Poisonous Fruit Fly: \n /c$9%16078%/c* /100
2. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City.
3. Defeat Blocks Soldiers or Soul monsters:\n  /c$9%16079%/c* /200.
4. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City\n, and claim the rewards from him.

filas.intro:
Lord Kahn received a request when 
 fighting the enemies around Building 
 Blocks city. It's said the voice came 
 from Strawberry Garden where they are suffering 
 from a heavy attack. We hope you can go 
 to assist them before its too late.
pasos: 1. Go to Strawberry Garden to find Leader Sharm. \n
2. Defeat Blueberry Collector: \n  /c$9%16081%/c* /150
3. Talk with Leader Sharm.
4. Defeat Cheese Warrior:\n  /c$9%16082%/c* /150
5. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City\n, and claim the rewards from him.

filas.intro:
Please gather enough arms before the next 
 counterattack. In addition to weapons we produce 
 ourselves, "borrow" weapons from our 
 enemies.
pasos: 1. Go to Fruit Town to dispatch the materials \n with the help of Weapon Seller.
2. Go to Chocolate Village and find Military Surplus Vendor to dispatch the goods.
3.Go to Strawberry Garden and [borrow] /c$9%16083%/c* /200 weapons  from Lollipop Soldiers.
4. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City\n, and claim the rewards from him.

filas.intro:
We have prepared enough supplies.
 Now you should begin to gather the disparate units of the army to defeat the Evil Lyceum once and for all.
 Lord Kahn orders you to find 
 Army 1, Army 2 and 
 Army 3. Reports put them in 
 Fruit Town, Chocolate Village and Strawberry Garden.
pasos: 1. Go to Fruit Town to find Army 1's trace \n
2. Go to Chocolate Village to find \n Army 2's Trace.
3. Go to Strawberry Garden and find Army 3's trace. \n
5. Report to Lord Kahn in Building Blocks City\n, and claim the rewards from him.

filas.intro:
When everything is done, you 
 will be asked to deliver the supplies 
 to Chocolate Forest, and prepare 
  for the final battle with the Evil Lyceum.
pasos: 1. Go to Chocolate Forest to find Commander Sally.
2. Defeat Warrants in Chocolate Forest or Berry Sandwich Goblin : \n/c$9%16084%/c* / 200
3. Report to Commander Sally.
4. [Borrow] /c$9%16085%/c* / 200 weapons and food from warriors in Chocolate Forest.
5. Report to Commander Sally.

filas.intro:
Commander Sally is asking you to 
 go to the Poker City Gate,
 and tell General Dior that 
 we are ready to attack Poker city.
pasos: 1. Go Poke City's gate in the Chocolate Forest \n to find General Dior.
2. Tell Lord Kahn about Dior's confusion.
3. Take the Time Mark from the monsters near Poker City. \n
4. Give the Time Mark to Lord Kahn.\n
5. Go to Angel Lyceum and find the Blessing Time Mark from Michael.
6. Bring the Time Mark to General Dior.

filas.intro:
The Caring Angel has prepared lots of 
 candy and desserts for the refugees 
 in Eden. Unfortunately, all the 
 relief supplies were stolen by 
 monsters while on the road to Eden.
pasos: 1. Defeat the robber Evil Cats \n and get back /c$9%16726%/c* /30 candy
2. Give the candy to Caring Angel \n in Mushroom Village.
3. Punish the robber witches \n and bring back /c$9%16727%/c* /30 cakes
4. Give the cakes to Caring Angel in Mushroom Village \n.
5.Receive the praise from Caring Angel.

filas.intro:
It took a lot of effort to find the relief 
 supplies, but now we've got them back and they need to be delivered to 
 the refugees promptly. Hurry up 
 and deliver the supplies to the Item Angel.
pasos: 1. Give the goods from Caring Angel \n to Item Angel in Mushroom Village.

filas.intro:
To help the starving people in Mushroom 
 Village, the Item Angel will give you 
 a list of refugees. I hope 
 you can help to deliver the Goods to them.
pasos: 1. Give the candy and Patties to Lloyd in Mushroom Village \n
2. Give the candy and patties to Halsey\n in Mushroom Village.
3. Give the candy and patties to Golico in Mushroom City. \n
4. Report to Item Angel.

filas.intro:
After taking care of the problem in Mushroom 
 Village, you need to move 
 on to Eden center 
 and assist with the treatment work there.
pasos: 1. Find EMT Angel in the Building Blocks County. \n

filas.intro:
After fierce fighting, many 
 people in Building Blocks city 
 have been injured. To resolve 
 the shortage of supplies, the EMT Angel is 
 asking you to gather medical equipment.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Little Pigs in Building Blocks County \n  to find the bandage: /c$9%16730%/c* /30
2. Defeat dwarfs in Building Blocks City\n and find /c$9%16729%/c* /30 capsules
3. Find Healer and buy /c$9%1354%/c* /50 Medium Red Potions from him\n, then give all the medicine to EMT Angel in Building Blocks City.
4. Talk with EMT Angel again.

filas.intro:
The injured are in danger. 
 We must deliver the 
 medical equipment to Building Blocks 
 city immediately!
pasos: 1. Find Healing Angel in Building Blocks City.

filas.intro:
The Angel has praised you for your 
 outstanding work in Eden. Now, 
 go claim your rewards from the Angel in 
 Eden, then return to the Angel Lyceum!
pasos: 1. Give a mental to Healing Angel from Building Blocks City as reward.
2. Claim a medal from EMT Angel in Building Blocks City
3. Claim a medal from Item Angel in Building Blocks City
4. Claim a medal from Caring Angel in Building Blocks City
5. Return to Angel Lyceum\n , then find Michael to receive Angel's blessing.

filas.intro:
Batlar wants to be a legendary dessert 
 chef. To ensure his fame, 
 he has decided to challenge himself to create a legendary 
 Dessert
pasos: 1. Defeat Fruit Soldiers from Fruit Town \n and collect /c$9%16731%/c* /50 ingredient.
2. Bring back the ingredient collected by Batlar \n.
3. Go to punish /c$9%16732%/c* /50 Witches who are disturbing Batlar in Fruit Town.
4. Tell Batlar that Witch has retreated.
5. Challenge Love Fighter Lisa and borrow the legendary kitchen tools possessed by her.
6. Bring the legendary kitchen tools to Batlar.
7. Claim the rewards from Batlar.

filas.intro:
Batlar finally finished cooking the Legendary Dessert. 
 To ensure his fame, the 
 sweet dessert needs to be tasted 
 by dessert experts.
pasos: 1. Give Batlar's Legendary Patties to Fat Knight in Paradise. \n
2. Deliver the dessert to one of the Gourmands:\n Fisherman Lars
3. Deliver the dessert to one of the Gourmands:\n Bored Priest
4. Deliver the dessert to one of the Gourmands:\n Richman Dave
5. Let Fat Knight know about the good comment from all the Gourmands!
6. Report the good news to Batlar.

filas.intro:
A group of free mercenaries have 
 been entrusted to defend 
 the remote area of Eden all alone.
pasos: 1. Send troops against Pink Rabbit or \n Blue Rabbit in Chocolate Village: /c$9%16733%/c* /50
2. Send troops to defeat /c$9%16734%/c* /50 Chocolate Soldiers in Chocolate Village.
3. Send the troops to sandwich fighter \n or Caramel Pudding Fighter \n: /c$9%16735%/c* /50
4. Go into Strawberry Garden , then report the war situation to Lazy Sergeant.
5. Report to Madden that the war has ended.
6. Talk with Madden again.

filas.intro: A group of free mercenaries are alone \n in the remote area of Eden. What are they doing there? \n
pasos: 1. Assist Outpost Fighter in Strawberry Garden\n to eliminate White Fairy /c$9%16736%/c* /50 fairies.
2. Assist Outpost Fighters in Strawberry Garden\n to eliminate Cheese Spearman /c$9%16737%/c* /50 fairies.
3. Assist Outpost Fighters in Strawberry Garden\n to eliminate Strawberry Imp /c$9%16738%/c* /50 Strawberry Imps
4. Inform Lazy Sergeant in Strawberry Garden that the war has succeeded.
5. Report to Madden in Fruit Town \n that we won in the war.
6. Talk with Madden again.

filas.intro:
The Desperate Doctor is coming to visit 
 his friends. He wants to examine 
 them, but he doesn't 
 feel well because of all the 
 candy he's been eating. He needs you to 
 check his friend's blood sugar for him.
pasos: 1. Help Frederick in Chocolate Forest to check.
2. Help Frederick in Chocolate Forest to check.
3. Talk with Desperate Doctor about the medical result.

filas.intro:
Most of Eden is once again at peace, now Leader 
 Michael will direct you on how to save the three 
 Goddesses who have suffered the shackles 
 of true evil.
pasos: 1. Defeat Goddess Ward in Poker City \n and unleash the shackle from the Evil.
2. Defeat Goddess Aglaia in Poker City\n and unleash the shackle from the Evil.
3. Defeat Goddess Thalia in Poker City \n and unleash the shackle from the Evil.
4. Inform Leader Michael in Angel Lyceum that the Goddesses have been rescued.

filas.intro:
The Goddess of Destiny has finally come 
 to life. But the true murderer 
 of the Angel Lyceum is still hiding 
 in Poker city. The final 
 battle in the war for Paradise is coming!
pasos: 1. Defeat Gothicllo in Poker Castle.
2. Successfully defeat Gothicllo in Poker Castle\n and report to the leader of the Angel Lyceum.

filas.intro:
Poor Rucca has been enduring a string of bad luck when wearing 
 the Luck Amulet. However, the amulet is now missing 
 after what happened in 
 Mushroom Village. Even though 
 the Luck Amulet is not as lucky as it sounds, 
 it was a 
 gift from his wife and he is determined to find it. Please 
 help Rucca find the Luck Amulet.
pasos: 1. Luck Amulet: /c$9%15981%/c* /1
2. Give the Luck Amulet to Poor Rucca.

filas.intro:
Recently a group of Little Pigs moved 
 into the house near Building Blocks 
 County and decided to hold a house 
 building contest. But this contest is wasting 
 a lot of building materials. Please [persuade] 
 them to refrain from wasting so many supplies!
pasos: 1. Training Little Pig: /c$9%15982%/c* /100
2. Report to Truk.

filas.intro:
Harry's boss wants to bake a cake in the 
 house nearby, but there isn't enough cheese! 
 Some suggested the 
 Cheese Spearmen, because they always have a lot of cheese.
 Go help Harry [borrow] some from the Cheese Spearmen.
pasos: 1. Collect Cream: /c$9%15984%/c* /130
2. Give the cream to Harry.

filas.intro:
Little Red Riding Hood wants to visit her grandmother's 
 house. But there have been reports that there 
 is a Big Homeless Dog on the way as well! 
 Please help Little Red Riding Hood to defeat 
 the Big Homeless [Dog].
pasos: 1. Drive Dog Swordsman away: /c$9%15985%/c* /100
2. Report to Little Red Riding Hood.

filas.nombre: Losing Weight is Harder Than Finding It
filas.intro: Fat Pucci has tried everything to lose weight, with no success. Now he thinks he knows why. It is the sandwich fighter who always lures Pucci into a dessert trap. To successfully lose weight, please eliminate all these sandwich fighters and set Fat Pucci free!
pasos: 1. Drive sandwich fighter away: /c$9%15986%/c* /130
2. Report to Fat Pucci.

filas.intro:
Laurent is a fruit vendor. Recently 
 the fruit has been acting weird, which is unusual, because usually the fruit doesn't act up at all.
 The fruit has been turning into monsters, apparently resulting from some magic spell.
 To successfully sell 
 the fruit, help Laurent get the fruit back to normal.
pasos: 1. Bring back fruit: /c$9%15987%/c* /130
2. Bring back the fruit and give them to Laurent.

filas.intro:
Recently, the Spade Spearmen 
 near Poker city has been sighted robbing and
 even attacking innocent villagers.
 Can you help them to get rid of 
 these horrible Spade Spearmen.
pasos: 1. Defeat Spade Spearman: /c$9%15988%/c* /150
2. Report to Fulisa.

filas.intro:
Chartereux likes to sit and read somewhere quiet. 
  But recently Buddy has been playing tricks there, 
 even going so far as to steal 
 Chartereux's  bento. Please help 
 Chartereux to get his bento back from Buddy.
pasos: 2. Give the bento to Chartereux.

filas.intro:
Nicole's masterpiece is Berry 
 Cake Cushion. If you want to 
 taste his cake, just bring 
 some fresh Berries to him.
 You can "borrow" some Berries 
 from the Strawberry Imp.
pasos: 1. Collect Strawberry: /c$9%15990%/c* /130
2. Give the Strawberry to Nicole.

filas.intro:
Eddie's son has been unhappy 
 the whole day because his beloved toy was broken.
 Eddie tries to fix the toy before 
 buying a new one for his son.
 To repair the toy, you need some springs. You can 
 claim some springs from the Toy Gunner
.
pasos: 1. Collect the spring: /c$9%15991%/c* /100
2. Give the wind to Edie.

filas.intro:
Mage Syma has powerful mana.
  He can change water into wine 
 and stone into cake with his magical powers! 
 But people have been saying that the magic power 
 is still very weak. 
 Only the broom can bring out the full potential of the magic.
 Can you help Mage Syma 
 to collect some Brooms?
pasos: 1. Collect the broom: /c$9%15992%/c* /150
2. Give the broom to Mage Syma.

filas.intro:
Phoebe lost her purse after 
 falling down near Chocolate Village. 
 She tried to find it,
 but it is still missing.
 Can you help Phoebe to 
 find the purse?
pasos: 1. Phoebe's purse: /c$9%15993%/c* /1
2. Give the purse to Phoebe.

filas.intro:
Luke loves Pudding a lot! 
 If you can bring some delicious 
 pudding to him, he will give you 
 a lucrative reward.
pasos: 1. Delicious Pudding: /c$9%15994%/c* /1
2. Give the Pudding to Luke.

filas.intro: Mage Cathy is making trouble in Building Blocks City. I hope you can kick Mage Cathy out.
pasos: 1. Defeat Mage Cathy.
2. Report to Allen.

filas.intro:
Marlin is very diligent and 
 responsible. He comes from the 
 remote Oriental desert. It's 
 said that there is an abundance of food 
 in Eden. So he has come on behalf 
 of the starving villagers 
 in his country. Will he 
 help his country out of famine?
pasos: 1. Defeat /c$9%16739%/c* /40 cream soldiers in the Poker city\n and take them away!
2. Defeat /c$9%16740%/c* /15 Dessert Angel in the Poker city and take them away!
3. Defeat /c$9%16741%/c* /60 Fruit Guardians in Poker city and take them away!
4. Defeat /c$9%16742%/c* /60 Berry Killers in Poker city and take them away!
5. Give all the food to Marlin. \n She will bring them to the hometown.
6. Talk with Marlin again.

filas.intro:
The Journey Artist loves 
 traveling, and he is now 
 on the road looking for Eden. 
 Unfortunately, he lost his beloved 
 musical instrument amid the chaos of war.
pasos: 1.Defeat the Cream Soldier in Poker City \n and find the Music Score wrote by Seth \n
2. Bring back the Music Score and give it to Seth.
3. Defeat Fruit Guardians in Poker city and find out Seth's favorite Violin.
4. Give the violin to Seth in Chocolate Village
5. Defeat the Toy army in the Poker city and find out Seth's favorite Guitar.
6. Bring Guitar to Seth in Chocolate Village.

filas.intro:
You happened to pick up a missing 
 story book called [The Unknown Evil] 
 after a small battle. To find 
 out the truth of the story, 
 you should track this thing to where it came from.
pasos: 1. Beat Pigs in Chocolate Village, \n and find out Chapter 2 of [The Unknown Evil] Book.
2. Defeat strawberry monsters in Strawberry Garden\n and find out Chapter 3 of [The Unknown Evil] Book.
3. Defeat Warrants in Chocolate Village and find out Chapter 4 of [The Unknown Evil] Book.
4. Defeat sandwich soldiers in Chocolate Village and find out Chapter 5 of [The Unknown Evil] Book.
5. Defeat Toy army in Poker city, \n and reveal the identify of [The Unknown Evil].
6. Talk with John.Liber in Poker city, \n and stop him doing bad things.

filas.intro:
The cat with luxurious clothes 
 is boasting for his host. 
 As smart as he is, 
 there should be something tough 
 to deal with.
pasos: 1. Eliminate /c$9%16749%/c* /75 Toy army and /c$9%16750%/c* /75 Cream Soldiers in Poker City.
2. Tell Count Envoy Kal about the good news.
3. Go to Grocer to buy /c$9%1211%/c* /10 Ten-star Piercing Hammer and bring back to Count Envoy Kal.
4. Go to Strawberry Garden  to defeat Witches, \n then find /c$9%16751%/c*/10 employees\n, to treat the distinguished guest!
5. Report to Count Envoy Kal.
6. Claim the rewards from Count Envoy Kal.

filas.intro:
傳說中，只要持有芙勞爾所給
予的恩賜，就能找到神秘的彼
岸之花。
pasos:
1.從21級以上怪物或物產身
  上尋找彼岸之花吧，集滿
  200個帶給產包任務專員，
  一天可以換取一次神秘的
  獎勵。

filas.intro:
The Beast Legion of Primitive Jungle has gained Demon Power and 
 is going to attack Eden
. Michael directed the little angels 
 to go to the jungle and stop the legion 
 before Eden 
 is attacked. However, Angel Lyceum has limited information 
 about the Beast Legion controlled by Satan
. More information 
 must be collected before
 hastily challenging the legion.
pasos: 1. Go to the Primitive Jungle and contact the local residents \n.

filas.intro:
You found a wounded weak Jungle resident Lochman 
 at the  entrance of the jungle
. As a helpful person, 
 you help him without hesitation
. The poor wounded Lochman hasn't had food 
 for some days and. The top priority is to 
 find some food and herbal medicines 
 for him.
pasos: 1. Search /c$9%19624%/c* /10 \n curative herbal medicines in the cave.
2. Give the herb to Lochman
3. Search /c$9%19626%/c* /10 \n Antidote Herbs in the cave.
4. Give the Antidote Herb to Lochman.
5. Hunt /c$9%19628%/c* /50 \n Toad Meat from the Draught Toads in the cave.
6. Give the Toad Meat to Lochman.
7. Go to Rock Forest to search the weird \n  researcher.

filas.intro:
You found the Researcher Kraydon
 on the road to Rock Forest. He 
 told you that there are rare huge dragon beasts
 in the jungle. If 
 you help him finish some researches, he 
 can tell you some information about 
 the beasts.
pasos: 1. Get /c$9%19629%/c* /100 \n small beast samples from Shadow Shrimps 100.
2. Give the sample to Researcher Kraydon
3. Get /c$9%19630%/c* / 100 \n large beast samples from Sharp-eye Wing Dragons.
4..Give the sample to Researcher Kraydon
5. Give the sample to the Researcher Corben.

filas.intro:
Hoca Village is a peaceful tribe that doesn’t exclude 
 strangers. The villagers 
 should know something about the Beast Legion, but 
 they don’t seem to be willing to say
 too much. To get more information about the 
 legion, the Researcher Corben suggested 
 to establish a good relation with the villagers 
 and get their trust.
pasos: 1. Go to Hunter's Ridge to collect /c$9%19631%/c* / 15 pieces of \n Jungle Meat.
2. Give the Jungle Meat to the Researcher \n Corben.
1. Go to Hunter's Ridge to collect /c$9%19633%/c* / 15 \n Jungle Wild Vegs.
4. Give the Jungle Wild Vegs to the researcher \n Corben.
5. Bring the dish to Hungry Lukas.

filas.intro:
As the traffic hub Rex
 Point is occupied by other tribes, the transportation of materials 
 is affected, and 
 many materials are in shortage. If the 
 occupiers can be driven away, it should be able to relieve the
 current shortage of materials.
pasos: 1. Go to Rex Point and drive away /c$9%19635%/c* /120 \n Barren Barbarians.
2. Report to Hungry Lukas
3. Go to Rex Point and drive away /c$9%19636%/c* /120 \n Barren Spearmen.
4. Report to Hungry Lukas
5. Go to Rex Point and get /c$9%19637%/c* / 10 portions of \n food from the goods.
6. Give the food got from goods to \n Hungry Lukas.
7. Inquire information from the Hoca villager \n Douglas the Hermit.

filas.intro:
Douglas the Hermit is a Hoca villager who's familiar 
 with the ecology of jungle beasts. He thinks it's a good way to weaken the Beast Legion 
 by preventing more strong beasts 
 from joining the legion. 
 It is said that the legion 
 breeds and trains beasts in Raven Riverpoint. To disintegrate 
 the ferocious legion, its
 source of beasts must be cut off first.
pasos: 1. Go to Raven Riverpoint to destroy /c$9%19639%/c* /120 \n Swordfang Tigers that cause threats.
2. Report to Douglas the Hermit
3. Catch /c$9%19640%/c* /15 \n cubs that can be trained from the Beast Den in Raven Riverpoint.
4. Report to Douglas the Hermit
5. Find Dowa the Marquis and inquire about the latest news\n of the Beast Legion.

filas.intro:
Dinosaur Arena
, the base camp of Beast Legion, has sent a Pioneer Troop to attack
 the Hoca Village. Currently, the Troop has arrived 
 in the nearby Hunter's Ridge. Take 
 your weapon and go to Hunter's Ridge to 
 stop the Troop before Hoca Village 
 is attacked!
pasos: 1. Go to Hunter's Ridge to stop /c$9%19642%/c* / 150 \n Sword Dragon Riders or \n Clever Dragons of the Beast Legion's Pioneer Troop.
2. Report to Dowa the Marquis
1. Go to Hunter's Ridge to stop /c$9%19643%/c* / 150 \n Earth Dragons or \n Horned Dragons of the Beast Legion's Main Force.
4. Report to Dowa the Marquis
5. Get reward from the Tribe Leader Vanity.

filas.intro:
After the Pioneer Troop was defeated, Hoca
 Village's Tribe Leader Vanity suggested that little angels 
 should pursue enemy troops in retreat since the 
 wounded beasts have strong 
 recovery ability. They'll 
 recover soon and start 
 fighting again.
pasos: 1. Go to Shilly Desert \n to destroy /c$9%19645%/c* / 200 Silverfang Tigers \n of the Beast Legion before the legion has a rest.
2. Report to Tribe Leader Vanity
3. Drive away /c$9%19646%/c* /200 Shadow Swift Dragons\n  and Rampage Swift Dragons\n near Dinosaur Arena.
4. Report to Tribe Leader Vanity

5. Go to Rock Forest and find: 
 /c$9%19647%/c* / 1 Boulder Forest Stone Material
. Go to Rex Point and find: 
 /c$9%19648%/c* /1 Rex Cirrus. 
 Go to Raven Riverpoint and find: 
 /c$9%19649%/c* /1 pile of Zonian Wood.
6. Transport Boulder Forest Stone Materials, Rex Cirrus、\n and Zonian Wood to the camp near Dinosaur Arena\n in Shilly Desert.
5. Get reward from the Tribe Leader Vanity.

filas.intro:
Hans the Prospector is a geology scholar
. It is said that the earth in Lost Cove
 contains substance
 not found in other places. He needs 
 a great deal of earth samples for analysis. He is
 shorthanded, so he seeks help here
. He hopes someone can collect a great deal of 
 earth samples for him.
pasos: 1. Search 1 /c$9%19668%/c* / earth sample \n needed by Hans in the hillock of Lost Cave \n.
2. Get /c$9%19669%/c* / 50 \n Mixed Activators from Gold Toxic-wart Frog \n in the Lost Cave.
3. Report to Hans the Prospector and get \n rewards.

filas.intro:
Hugh claims to be the strongest 
 warrior in Primitive Jungle, but his weapon and shield 
 were stolen when he slept. It is said that his 
 shield can resist dragon flame, and his weapon 
 used to kill dragons. Being angry, 
 he hopes you to 
 search his weapon and shield, and 
 teach the thief a good lesson.
pasos: 1. Get back /c$9%19670%/c* / 1 \n Unattractive Knife from \n Faint Chan in the Lost Cave.
1. Get back /c$9%19671%/c* / 1 \n Ragged Shield from \n Crying Dead Soul in the Lost Cave.
3. Give the Knife and Shield to Hugh.

filas.intro:
More and more strangers have come to hunt in 
 Primitive Jungle. Many greedy 
 hunters hunt excessively. These hunters 
 kill jungle animals 
 wantonly to get benefits. They even 
 set up traps to catch cubs
. To avoid ecological unbalance caused by 
 capture of cubs, Chubby the Hunter
 hopes you to remove 
 the traps.
pasos: 1. Remove /c$9%19672%/c* /30 \n Cub Traps buried in the Rock Forest.
2. Report to Chubby that the traps in Rock Forest \n have been removed.
3. Remove /c$9%19673%/c* /30 \n Cub Traps buried near Hoca Village.
4. Report to Chubby the Hunter and get rewards.

filas.intro:
Drake the Warrior is a 
 hunting expert in Hoca Village. He knows the
 habits of beasts well, and can hunt a great deal of 
 beasts in a short time. He can hunt large strong beasts or 
 small animals easily
. No one can break his 
 hunting record. Do you want to challenge 
 his record?
pasos: 1. Hunt /c$9%19675%/c* / 100 \n Shadow Snails before the torch goes out.
2. Report the result to Drake
3. Hunt /c$9%19676%/c* / 100 \n Wind Wing Dragons before the torch goes out.
4. Report to Drake and get \n rewards.

filas.intro:
Hunting strong beasts successfully is the glory 
 of a hunter and the proof of a warrior. You 
 aren't indigenous to Primitive Jungle, but 
 Hoca Village will regard you 
 as a warrior if you pass 
 Leader Hanks' test. Do you want to challenge the test
 and get Hoca Village's recognition and glory
?
pasos: 1. Hunt /c$9%19677%/c* /1 \n Mystic Shrimp Huchis in the Lost Cave.
2. Defeat /c$9%19678%/c* /1 \n Gururu the Wild in the Rock Forest.
3. Hunt /c$9%19679%/c* /1 \n Demon Snail Olo in the Hoca Village.
4. Report to Leader Hanks and get \n rewards.

filas.intro:
After you finish the Warrior's Proof, Hoca 
 Village has admitted you to be a brave hunter 
, but there's a traditional
 test. It is said only few warriors have 
 passed the test. The one that passes 
 it successfully will be praised 
 as the strongest warrior, and be respected and adored 
 by villagers. Are you confident to pass 
 this test?
pasos: 1. Hunt /c$9%19680%/c* /1 \n Turtle Dragon Chell in the Rex Point.
2. Hunt /c$9%19681%/c* /1 \n Minks the Fanged Tiger General in the Raven Riverpoint.
3. Hunt /c$9%19682%/c* /1 \n Armored Horned Dragon Caine in the Hunter's Ridge.
4. Hunt /c$9%19683%/c* /1 \n Sabretooth Yagre in the Shilly Desert.
5.Report to Leader Hanks and get rewards.

filas.intro:
A successful hunter must 
 be able to hunt any kinds of beasts
. Besides excellent hunting 
 skills, he must be familiar with geographical environment 
 and the habits of beasts
 in order to know the preys' 
 trace. Will you accept 
 Master Hunter Domma's test and prove yourself to 
 be a skillful and knowledgeable hunter
?
pasos: 1. Hunt: /c$9%19684%/c* / 100\n Ancient Crustaceans.
2. Hunt: /c$9%19685%/c* / 100\n Remote Crustaceans.
3. Hunt: /c$9%19686%/c* / 100\n Shield Armor Crocodiles.
4. Hunt: /c$9%19687%/c* / 100\n Horned Dragons.
5. Hunt: /c$9%19688%/c* / 100\n Path Chair Rexes.
6. Report to Master Hunter Domma and get \n rewards.

filas.intro:
流焰菁華是火山稀有的產物，
它可以自行微弱發光，並且是
辨識稀有礦物多彩石不可獲缺
的物品。
pasos:

  上尋找多彩石吧，集滿200
  個帶給產包任務專員，一
  天可以換取一次獎勵。

pasos: 1.Field Mice Tail: /c$9%295%/c* /10
2.Take reward from Spike Farmer

pasos: 2.You have got rid of many Pumpkins and can report to Spike Farmer.
3.Take reward from Spike Farmer

pasos: 1.Defeat Jackstraws: /c$9%297%/c* /20
2.You have communicated with sufficient Jackstraws and can\n report to Spike Farmer.

2.Take the parcel to Manor Keeper of Sunflower Plain\n.

pasos: 2.Take reward from Farm Cook

2.You have killed many Field Mice and can report to the Farm Cook\n.
3.Take reward from Farm Cook

pasos: 2.Take reward from Farm Cook

pasos: 1.Magic Pumpkinmen: /c$9%302%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Clerk
3.Take reward from Clerk

pasos: 1.Sheep's Woolly Curls: /c$9%303%/c* /5
2.Take reward from Keeper

pasos: 1.Stop the Sheep's Noise: /c$9%305%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Gardener
3.Take reward from Gardener

pasos: 1.Magic Flute: /c$9%306%/c* /1
2.Take reward from Gardener

pasos: 1.Beethoven's Score: /c$9%307%/c* /1

pasos: 1.Find Fishing Leader of Dawn Harbor

pasos: 1.Fatman's Ring: /c$9%309%/c* /1
2.Take reward from the fatman.

pasos: 1.Get rid of the Grey Mice: /c$9%310%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Chef
3.Take reward from Chef

2.Take reward from Chef

pasos: 1.Fresh Turtle Meat: /c$9%312%/c* /4
2.Take reward from Chef

pasos: 1.Hand Planning Book to Sailor Karter

pasos: 1.Talk with Retired Sailor
2.Inquire of old sailor about\n the secret of Gold Island

pasos: 1.Give a lesson to the Riprap Pirates: /c$9%315%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Barkeeper
3.Talk with Chef

pasos: 1.Drive Away the Harp Sheep: /c$9%316%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Fisher
3.Talk with Fisher

pasos: 1.Clear the creatures in the harbor up: /c$9%317%/c* /20

pasos: 1.Hand the letter to Deputy Colonel.

pasos: 1.Kill Vice Head Pirate.

pasos: 1.Go to Cherry Village for Village leader.

pasos: 1.Pirate's Necklace: /c$9%320%/c* /5

pasos: 1.Hand the necklace to the owner or those who know the owner.

pasos: 1.Go to Aurora City for Timi.
2.Talk with Timi again

pasos: 1.You don't know what to do, so you decide to\n consult Spy Angel of Dawn Harbor.
2.Talk with Cherry's Leader for aid
3.Hand Village leader's Pearl to Asmode
4.Talk with Asmode

filas.intro: Asmode completely believes that you belong to Pirate Corps. So he gives you a Magic Stone and asks you to find a Monkey Statue holding an egg somewhere along Cherry Village coast...\n
pasos: 1.Look for Monkey Statue Holding An Egg in Cherry Village

filas.intro: You must defeat Asmode in order to avoid being assimilated by him and to stop him from recruiting students.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Asmode: /c$9%1337%/c* /1
2.Talk with Spy Angel
3.talk with Spy Angel again

filas.intro:
It reads "Respected 
 warrior with hunting soul in Hoca Village, a warrior 
 with hunting soul is a real warrior
. When you become a real warrior, I'll 
 grant you glory and fortune."
pasos:
1. Investigate the 
 Stone Table of Hoca Village after finishing the following quests: 
  [Hunter's Kindness]
  [Hoca Village Legend]
 [Warrior's Proof]
  [Strongest Warrior]
  [Hunter's Wisdom]

filas.intro:
Hugh loves peacefulness. To 
 enjoy peacefulness, he goes to take a nap in the Lost 
 Cave, but the Jumpy Lizard Dragons
 ruin 
 the peaceful atmosphere. Hugh hopes someone can 
 drive away these annoying Jumpy Lizard Dragons
, so that he can take a nap quietly
.
pasos: 1. Drive away /c$9%19589%/c* / 100 Jumpy Lizard Dragons.
2. You've driven away many Jumpy Lizard Dragons\n . Report the result to Hugh.

filas.intro: Carden's pet Pipy lost its way in the Lost Cave\n. He hopes someone can \n help him search Pipy.
pasos: 1. Find out if Pipy is caught by Black Dragon.
2. You've found Pipy from Black Dragon. \n  Send it to its owner Carden.

filas.intro:
The foolish Hunter Haddock wanted to catch 
 preys with a trap, but he forgot 
 the trap position and was injured 
 by the trap. It is said that Styptic Flowers in Rock Forest 
 have good effect. 
 Go and pick some Styptic Flowers and 
 stop his bleeding.
pasos: 1. Search /c$9%19591%/c* / 5 Styptic Flowers on the Hay Stack.
2. You've got enough Styptic Flowers. Go \n to heal Hunter Haddock's wound.

filas.intro:
Nana of Hoca Village admires 
 Drake the Warrior very much. She hopes to give him a gift 
 to express her adoration. If you help
 her get a Top-grade Beast Bone, she 
 can make a bone spear 
 for Drake as a gift.
pasos: 1. Hunt a \n Top-grade Beast Bone from the Spy Dragon nearby.
2. Give the Top-grade Beast Bone to Nana.

filas.intro:
Angry Fist wants to talk about the old days with the eldest brother of 
 Wild Brothers. He hopes you can 
 send a Challenger to the eldest brother
. However, 
 the Wild Brothers look the same and are 
 bad-tempered. You may be knocked about if 
 you give it to the wrong person...
pasos: 1. Send the Challenge to \n the eldest brother of Wild Brothers.
2. Tell Angry Fist that the Challenge has \n been sent to the eldest brother.

filas.intro:
Recently, some beasts that eat crops 
 have come here from other place, so 
 Carnon who lives on farming faces the crisis of survival. He 
 needs someone to drive 
 away these beasts, otherwise 
 he won't be able to support himself.
pasos: 1. Drive away /c$9%19595%/c* / 100 \n Mountain Flaming Tigers that eat crops nearby.
2. Tell Carnon that Mountain Flaming Tigers have been driven away.

filas.intro:
Just as its name implies, Hunter's Ridge is a place 
 where people can hunt as much as they like. 
 Hunter Zern especially holds a hunting sacrifice ceremony
 here. If you can hunt the 
 quantity of beasts designated by Zern, you can get his 
 reward.
pasos: 1. Hunt /c$9%19596%/c* / 100 \n Amphibian Thorny Turtles designated by Zern.
2. Report the result to Hunter Zern

filas.intro:
There's a 
 hunter who loses his memory in Shilly Desert. He's even forgot 
 who he is. At present, the only clue is that he woke near here after he was 
 knocked down by a beast
. He has 
 lingered here for some days. He only hopes he can find 
 clues that help him restore the memory.
pasos: 1. Search \n clues that may be related to the \n amnesiac hunter on the Stealthy Dragon nearby.
2. Give the trinket engraved with name to \n the amnesiac hunter. See if he can \n think of something.

filas.intro:
The Barren Barbarians stole the Meat Gift Boxes 
 to be delivered when 
 the Rex Deliverer took a nap. Most of these 
 Meat Gift Boxes must have 
 been eaten up, but the Rex Deliverer hopes to 
 get back the remaining ones and 
 account for this to the client. Therefore, he hopes you 
 can find the remnants for him.
pasos: 1. Find /c$9%19598%/c* / 10 \n lost goods from the nearby Barren Barbarians.
2. Report the result to Rex Deliverer.

filas.intro:
Coen heard that 
 Amazon Fish in the Raven Riverpoint is tasty. He wants to taste them, but he has to give up since 
 he doesn’t know how to swim. It is said that beasts 
 near the river live on Amazon Fish
. You may get 
 the fish from them.
pasos: 1. Get /c$9%19599%/c* / 50 Amazon Fish from the Water Thorny Dragon near the river.
2. Give the Amazon Fish to Coen.

filas.intro:
The meat of beasts on the Hunter's Ridge is 
 one of the most admirable food of Hoca villagers. 
 The stranger Gluttonous Lolor has also come to 
 taste it. However, 
 the beasts in the Hunter's Ridge are agile and ferocious, 
 so he can't cope with them. 
 He hopes you can hunt
 the Fatty Meat 
 on those beasts for him.
pasos: 1. Hunt /c$9%19600%/c* / 50 \n Fatty Meat from Rock Dragon Turtle in the Hunter's Ridge.
2. Give the collected Fatty Meat to \n Gluttonous Lolor.

filas.intro:
According to the record of Hoca Village's stone tablet, the 
 Shilly Desert used to be an ocean 
 in the ancient time. Now it seems to be 
 unbelievable, but the Archeologist Hacon 
 thought the record is correct. 
 Now he is doing 
 research in this respect. If you get any evidence that 
 proves 
 its being ocean in the past, please give it 
 to Archeologist Hacon.
pasos: 1. Get a clue that proves the Shilly Desert's \n being ocean in the past from Special Horned Dragon \n.
2. You find \n pearls from Special Horned Dragon. Report this result \n to the Archeologist Hacon.

filas.intro:
The value of hunting doesn’t lie in maintaining 
 life but enjoying the feeling of conquering. In the 
 legend, the most ferocious beast in the world 
 live in the Dinosaur Arena...
pasos: 1. Catch /c$9%19651%/c* / 35 \n Clawed Swift Dragons before the Special Anesthetic loses its effect.
2. Bring the captured dinosaur to Kong.
1. Catch /c$9%19652%/c* / 35 \n Sharp Fang Tigers before the Special Anesthetic loses its effect.
4. Bring the captured tiger to Kong.
5. Get reward from Kong.

filas.intro:
In the legend, a dinosaur only existed before the heaven 
 war. Now it appears again
, so the biologists are wild with joy
. Will you assist the dangerous 
 research?
pasos: 1. Go to Dinosaur Arena \n to defeat Crystal Dragon Turtle and get back  /c$9%19653%/c* / 10 \n turtle eggs, so as to study the secret of birth.

2. Go to Dinosaur Arena 
 to catch Blade Thorny Dragons: 
  /c$9%19654%/c* / 20 female ones and 
 /c$9%19655%/c* / 20 male ones
, so as to study the secret of multiplying.
3. Go to Dinosaur Arena \n to find the Ancient Dinosaur's remains in the third pass area \n , so as to study the secret of death.

4. Go to Dinosaur Arena to defeat 
 the Thunder Dragon and bring back  /c$9%19656%/c* / 15 
 Muscle Chips 
, so as to study the secret of being powerful.
6. Settle the work reward with Merwin.

filas.intro:
Due to the influence of demons, 
 young people in the Village have left their homes. They form cliques, ride dinosaurs and 
 do evil things. You must correct 
 them for those anxious parents.
pasos:
1. Go to Dinosaur Arena to defeat Barren Warriors 
 and find out the drug antidotes. Then defeat /c$9%19658%/c* / 20 
 Dragon Bladers 
 , and make them become clearheaded.
2. Bring back the Lost Youths back\n , and find the Lady Gurkha.
3. Receive the Lady Gurkha's return present.

filas.intro:
The affluent Landlord Doo isn't good at 
 speaking, but he is big in the local place since 
 he is very generous. Now 
 he is recruiting good adventurers who can get top-grade food 
 in the Dinosaur Arena.
pasos: 1.\n  /c$9%19659%/c* / 20 portions of \n Chewy Turtle Meat and /c$9%19660%/c* / 20 portions of Delicious Shrimp Meat.
2. Bring the food material to Doo
3. Find King of Sauces, the \n seasoning master for Doo outside of the village.
4. Drive away /c$9%19661%/c* / 45 \n Winged Tigers and /c$9%19662%/c* / 60 \n knights who disturb King of Sauces when he studies seasoning.
5. Tell King of Sauces that the monsters have been driven away.
6. Bring the seasoning back to Doo.
7. Claim your wage from Doo.

filas.intro:
The Dinosaur Legion supported by Evil Lyceum 
 has gradually threatened the peaceful life of the village. To maintain 
 the villagers' safety, John Michael hopes someone 
 has the courage to mop up the base camp of Dinosaur Legion.
pasos: 1. Mop up the disaster in the Dinosaur Arena: \n /c$9%19663%/c* / 35 Barren Warriors \n and /c$9%19664%/c* / 30 Adventure Chair Ralons.
2. Mop up the evil beasts in the Dinosaur Arena: \n /c$9%19665%/c* / 30 Horned Bump Dragons \n and /c$9%19666%/c* / 30 Bloody Thorn Dragons.
3. Report to John Michael the completion of the quest.
4. Talk to John Michael again.

filas.intro:
The evil hands of Dinosaur are reaching 
 Eden. A great number of people will be killed 
 if they aren't stopped. In the legend, only the champion 
 who wins all challenges in the arena 
 can lead humans defeating evil and creating 
 a bright future.
pasos: 1. Challenge the first pass of Dinosaur Arena. \n  Defeat the Winged Dragon Bosen Dino.
2. Challenge the second pass of Dinosaur Arena. \n  Defeat the Magic Dragon Ambassador.
2. Challenge the second pass of Dinosaur Arena. \n  Defeat the Disaster Dragon Cartastolov.
4. Return to the Elder Moore.

filas.intro:
The last decisive combat in the arena. You will 
 face Dragon Emperor Rex, 
 the strongest descendant in the land. Your brave fight 
 will become the hope of the entire world, and 
 bring the highest heroic glory.
pasos: 1. Challenge the last pass of the Dinosaur Arena. \n  Defeat Dragon Emperor Rex.
2.Return to the Elder Moore.

filas.nombre: Get back the cold water bottle
filas.intro:
Assc. Vendor Rem is a merchant in the desert who sells 
cold water. He's always looking for
 thirsty people to make a quick buck from. Unfortunately, 
Blue Sand Baby has stolen his cold water bottle, and he 
hopes someone can get it back for him.
pasos: 1.On the body of the Blue Sand Baby close by found \n  empty cold water bottle:/c$9%22148%/c* /50
2.Give the empty Cold Water Bottle to Assc. Vendor Rem \n  to collect your reward

filas.intro:
The pauper, Nuke,  heard that one of the ingredients for Papyrus Paper, 
Papyrus, is in short supply. He wanted to pick some, but 
found that the best Papyrus all grows on 
Papyrus Golem. He's looking for someone to help 
him pick some so he can supplement his income.
pasos: 1.Defeat papyrus golem:/c$9%22149%/c* /100
2.Report the results to Nuke.

filas.intro:
The young widow Remi lives in the Pharaoh Village that's often 
attacked by demons. The jewelry box that her 
husband left her was destroyed by Scorching Mudhands. 
She hopes someone will take down these 
monsters, and take her revenge for her.
pasos: 1.Eliminate Scorching Mudhand:/c$9%22150%/c* /100
2.Hurry and report the results back to Remi.

filas.intro:
The slave Yuri has raised her child all by herself. Her child has 
always wanted to eat Crunchy Corn with milk, yet she cannot afford 
to buy it keep the promise she made with
 her child. Please help this poor mother realise her dream!
pasos: 1.Defeat and collect \n  Crunchy Corn:/c$9%22151%/c* /100
2. Give the Crunchy Corn to Yuri

filas.intro:
Lady Margarette wants to catch a Pyramid Cat and 
keep it as a pet. But the monster is both fierce and fragile - 
if you don't catch it in one go, it will fall to pieces
. She's looking for someone highly-skilled
 to help her catch one.
pasos: 1.Carefully catch \n  Pyramid Cat:/c$9%22152%/c* /1
2.Take Pyramind Cat to Lady Margarette for rewards.

filas.intro:
The Bassil Kingdom's Silver Cat Mask is able to 
exorcise monsters. Yet, for no apparent reason, it's turned into a monster!
 This has aroused the interest of Mask Collector Vick.
 He's put up a large reward for its capture, in hopes of 
adding it to his collection.
pasos: 1.Remove the evil power that is controlling masks,\n  Collect Silver Cat Mask:/c$9%22153%/c* /50
2.Give the mask to Mask Collector Vick\n  for a reward.

filas.intro:
The Eden Express deliveryman who always gets lost 
while making a delivery from Eden to the oasis
 would like a Little Angel to help him deliver
 this letter to Krosby.
pasos: 1. Give the letter to Krosby.
2.Bring the receipt to the lost delivery man to collect your \n  reward.

filas.intro:
Trying to steal the Century Honey, Zasabi was attacked
 by the bees and is now heavily poisoned.
 He's actually thinking of trying to make an antidote from the poison stingers
 of the bees. Who knows if it will save him or poison him further?
 Nonetheless, help him before he dies of the poison
 he already has in his body!
pasos: 1.From the body of the dead Mutated Hornet:\n  Mutated Hornet's poison stinger /c$9%22155%/c* /100
2.Give the poison needles to Poisoned Zasabi.

filas.intro:
Historian Shion discovered that the wall paintings
 by savages in the Cave of Falling Sand could
 help trace the evolution of the Bassil Kingdom.
 If there was some way to restore the paintings to their original state, it could be
 a breakthrough in his research.
pasos: 1.From the body of Mural Tribe got:\n  Mural Tribe shards /c$9%22156%/c* /50
2.Give the shards to Historian Shion for research

filas.intro:
Strawberry Sand and Mint Sand are mysterious minerals
 that can be used to save lives. They were thought
 to have vanished from the face of the earth. After
 Parolles found out that these two types of sand could still be found, she's looking for
 someone to help her collect them.
pasos:
1.From Cave of Falling Sand's Strawberry Sandball people and 
  Mint sandball people gotten:
  Strawberry sand /c$9%22157%/c* / 50 bags
  Mint Sand /c$9%22158%/c* / 50 bags
2.Give the two type of  Amazing Sand  to  Pethro

filas.intro:
After hearing that the best Cream Corn in Eden
 can be found here, Gourmet Karl has come
 to have a taste. Satisfying her appetite will
 result in a nice reward.
pasos: 1. Select the best Cream Corn
2.Give the Cream Corn to Gourmet Karl\n  to try it out

filas.intro: As the Flame Evil Books could contain lost Fire Magic, the library has sent Committee Member Kedal to retrieve these books. Please help him.
pasos: 1.Remove Flame Evil Book's curse to collect\n  Old Magic Book:/c$9%22162%/c* /50
2.Give the Magic Book to Riprap for a reward.

filas.intro:
The pyramid ornaments that were supposed to be funerary accompaniments 
have turned into demons. The Silver Guardian has discovered that
 the controlling energies are coming from the bel
l on the body. Hopefully someone can retrieve
 the bell, and find a solution.
pasos: 2.Give the bells ot Silver Guardian for a reward.

filas.intro:
The man hiding in the corner is Vester. He claims 
to be looking for help just because he doesn't want 
to soil his hands, yet what he wants is someone
 to eradicate the Blood Patterned Three-headed Snake. Something isn't right
 about this, but let's help him.
pasos: 1.Defeat Blood Patterned Three-headed Snake:/c$9%22184%/c* /100
2.Report results to Vester.

filas.intro: マハ神廟をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「マハ神廟」で守護者・\n  夜叉王を倒す。
2.「マハ神廟」で震天の神獣\n  ・梵天を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 煉獄マハ神廟をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「煉獄マハ神廟」で煉獄-\n  夜叉王を倒す。
2.「煉獄マハ神廟」で煉獄-\n  梵天を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro:
法源碎片看似平凡的石頭，但
是聚集起來仍然會有令人畏懼
的威力，為了不讓惡魔學園獲
得，協助產包任務專員蒐集法
源碎片，並且帶回來給他，他
會給你相對應的獎品。
pasos:
1.從21級以上怪物或物產身
  上尋找200個法源碎片，並
  且帶給產包任務專員，會獲
  得相對應的獎賞。

filas.intro: Panpaka has arrived in Eden! He’s here to look for [Angel Pants]. But his precious friend [Punyan] has gone missing, and he’s frantic…
pasos: 1. I heard that someone in Aurora City saw a dark blue cat! But I don’t think it’s safe for Panpaka to go alone. Please follow him there.
2. Looks like we just missed Punyan… I guess he’s heading towards Dark City. Let’s hurry!
3. Looks like we missed him again… The words [Iron Castle] are written on the pants he left here… Let’s go!
4. Huh, it says here that he’s in [the forest city and enjoying the lovely scented breeze]… Maybe he won’t go anywhere else for a while. Let’s take this chance to catch up with him!
5. I think we’ve been following the wrong cat! Let’s hurry back to Panpaka!
6. I think Punyan’s gone off to the Angel Lyceum. Let’s hurry. This time we’re sure to find him!

filas.intro: The Sickle Soldiers ask you to help them kill the Evil Cats destroying building equipment so that the project can be carried out smoothly.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Evil Cat: /c$9%634%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Sickle Soldier
3.Take reward from Sickle Soldier

filas.intro: Because the western building site is occupied by a crowd of evil skeletons, the Sickle Corps soldiers asks you to kill the Skeletal Sniper hurting others with its covert methods.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat the Skeletal Sniper: /c$9%635%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Sickle Soldier
3.Take reward from Sickle Soldier

filas.intro: Forman (Foreman) needs a Progress Chart to make a briefing, so he asks you to take the charts from the Engineers in other building sites for him.\n
pasos:
1.Ask
 Engineer in Shadowy Path for Progress Chart.
 Progress Chart for northern building site: /c$9%636%/c* /1
 Progress Chart for southern building site: /c$9%637%/c* /1
2.Talk with Forman

filas.intro: The working bomb is lost unexpectedly. Workers suspect that it was stolen by the Red-hooded Skeleton. So they ask you to get it back, otherwise a serious catastrophe will occur if it is used to do evil.\n
pasos: 1.Stolen gun powder: /c$9%638%/c* /1
2.Talk with Worker

filas.intro: A special magic is fashionable in Dark City. So Mystique Trader is in emergency need of Evil Cat's tail as a drug for the magic. These goods are out of stock. Help him collect these goods.\n
pasos: 1.Evil Cat's tail: /c$9%639%/c* /10
2.Talk with Mystique Trader

filas.intro: Because Red-hooded Skeletons often destroy the Shadowy Path Extension Project , the manager of the Railway Company entrusts you to drive away those fierce Red-hooded Skeletons.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Red-hooded Skeleton: /c$9%640%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Railway Boss
3.Take reward from Railway Boss

filas.intro: The Railway Boss's key to his coffer is taken by an Evil Cat. He needs some important documents from in the coffer right away, so he troubles you to get back his key.\n
pasos: 1.Missing key to coffer: /c$9%641%/c* /1
2.Talk with Railway Boss

filas.intro: The Giant Cat Cinlo's bell often sends out a boring tone, which has a serious effect on the efficiency of the Workers of the Railway Company. The Manager asks you to help solve this problem.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Giant Cat Cinlo: /c$9%642%/c* /1
2.Talk with Railway Boss
3.Take reward from Railway Boss

filas.nombre: Confirmation of order for project material
filas.intro: The Railway Boss asks you to confirm the order sent to the Fungus Forest South and to see if the requested material can be shipped to Shadowy Path in time.\n
pasos: 1.Hand the order for material to\n Merchant Pierce in Fungus Forest South
2.Talk with Merchant Pierce

filas.intro: The Merchant in the Fungus Forest South is always disturbed by a crowd of Imps so that he can hardly do business. He asks you to help him deal with them.\n
pasos: 2.Report the result to Merchant Pierce
3.Take reward from Merchant Pierce

filas.intro: Nick is sleepless because of the Crybaby's cry. So he entrusts you to help him drive away the Crybaby so he can sleep soundly.\n
pasos: 1.Drive Crybaby: /c$9%645%/c* /20
2.Tell Nick how it has been dealt with
3.Take reward from Nick

filas.intro: Mystique Wizard in Dark City asks you to collect rare[dew]from Paopao.\n
pasos: 1.Dew and Fog: /c$9%646%/c* /10
2.Talk with Mystique Wizard

filas.intro: Miss Diana feels upset because the Imps make waves here and there. She asks you to help her drive these Imps away.\n
pasos: 2.Talk with Miss Diana
3.Take reward from Miss Diana

filas.intro: The Trainer is busy training his soul, but he feels curious about the Crybaby's firm will, so he asks you to find a clue from the Crybaby...\n
pasos: 1.Find the method to concentrate attention
2.Hand the shrunken paper to Trainer

filas.intro: The Trainer asks you to find the Crybaby 's knack though you don't know why he is so persistent...\n
pasos: 1.Spirit knack I: /c$9%649%/c* /1\n Spirit knack II: /c$9%650%/c* /1\n Spirit knack III: /c$9%651%/c* /1
2.Talk with Trainer

filas.intro: The Trainer thinks you've deceived him, so he calls an elf to punish you with anger.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Rage Fire Elf
2.Talk with Trainer
3.Talk with Trainer again

filas.intro: The Trainer apologizes to you for thinking you decieved him and decides to train again. You hand him a letter for his father.\n
pasos: 1.Hand the letter to Esmat in Bottomless Pit
2.Talk with Esmat

filas.intro: Soldiers of the Defence Research Center are bored with Fire Mimics, so they ask you to help teach a lesson to those mischievous Mimics.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Fire Mimic: /c$9%654%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Sickle Soldier
3.Take reward from Sickle Soldier

filas.intro: The research center is constantly disturbed by a crowd of Wizards who believe there are demons in the Bottomless Pit. To alleviate the burden of the Sickle Corps, you should kill those superstitious Wizards.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Frantic Wizard: /c$9%655%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Sickle Soldier
3.Take reward from Sickle Soldier

filas.intro: Because the material shipped to Dark City is always robbed  by a crowd of Wizards with ravens. To solve this problem, the researchers ask you to drive away those Wizards.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Crow Wizard: /c$9%656%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Researcher
3.Take reward from Researcher

filas.intro: The Researchers were scalded by a pan of Fire Mimics, they ask you to collect materials for a scald ointment.\n
pasos: 1.Collected Black Agar: /c$9%657%/c* /10\n Collected raven's feather: /c$9%658%/c* /10
2.Talk with Analyst

filas.intro: A Researcher with a hobby of collecting coins asks you to collect a rare Clown's Coin. He would like to give you a reward for obtaining it.\n
pasos: 1.Collected Clown's Coin: /c$9%659%/c* /10
2.Talk with Researcher

filas.intro: You pick up some stamp pieces accidentally. It is carved with strange ancient letters on it. Maybe you will understand the explanation to it if you show it to a senior scholar.\n
pasos: 1.Consult senior scholar
2.Talk with Esmat

filas.intro: A Central Official leaving for Dark City takes some stamp pieces back to the Energy Research Center in the Bottomless Pit.\n
pasos: 1.Go to Dark City for Central Official
2.Take blue stamp pieces to Energy Research Center in Bottomless Pit\n
3.Talk with Esmat

filas.intro: The stamp pieces kept by Esmat were robbed by the Fire Mimics. You must get back the stolen pieces from those mimics.\n
pasos: 1.Retake the robbed stamp pieces
2.Take Stamp to Energy Research Center\n in Bottomless Pit.
3.Talk with Esmat

filas.intro: Combine the two stamp pieces into one and go to the ancient mausoleum gate on the west side of the research center according to Esmat's instructions.\n
pasos: 1.Go to northern ancient mausoleum
2.Defeat the Giant Grave Elf
3.Look into the stone gate again
4.Talk with Esmat
5.Take reward from Esmat

filas.intro: The Manager of the official residence can't stand that the Evil Elves expel excrement near the Duke's residence. You must drive away these detestable elves.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Little Eye: /c$9%666%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Manager
3.Take reward from Manager

filas.intro: Those Leeches actually have begun to suck the dead body's blood. So the Manager asks you to teach them a lesson because of their wicked deeds.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Leech /c$9%667%/c* /20
2.Report the result to Manager
3.Take reward from Manager

filas.intro: Because the season of picking Darkness Pumpkins is approaching , the Gardener asks you to collect reports on the growth of pumpkins in the other melonland.\n
pasos: 1.Report about East Melonland: /c$9%668%/c* /1\n Report about North Melonland: /c$9%669%/c* /1
2.Talk with Melonland Worker

filas.intro: Degula Duke's tube, used for sucking blood, has begun to shrink because its been so long since he absorbed fresh blood. So he asks you to collect material to make an analgesetic.\n
pasos: 1.Little Eye's tail: /c$9%670%/c* /10\n One-eyed Bat's wing: /c$9%671%/c* /10
2.Talk with Degula Duke

filas.intro: Degula Duke begins to become greedy as soon as his teeth are free of pain. Please defeat Bershala and then take the rare Dark Pumpkin to him.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Bershala: /c$9%672%/c* /1
2.Send the rare Dark Pumpkin to Duke
3.Talk with Degula Duke

2.Talk with Sad Father

filas.intro: Porky Men daddle in the Graveyard every day and often steal offerings to eat. He does not wash himself so that his body odor scares away many people offering sacrifices to the dead. So the Graveyard Worker troubles you to drive those disgusting men away.\n

2.Report the result to Graveyard Worker
3.Take reward from Graveyard Worker

2.Report the result to Graveyard Worker
3.Take reward from Graveyard Worker

2.Talk with the Lady

filas.intro: The Executive Clerk is in a rage because the Magic Cats have destroyed the tombstone with their sharp claws. So he wants you to punish them.\n

filas.intro: Help the old Executive Chief look for a Time Box in De Naqoura Maze. It was buried there by him and his wife 30 years ago.\n

2.Hand the Time Box to Executive Chief
3.Talk with Executive Chief

filas.intro: The Old Executive Chief asks you to dig out a present hidden by his wife before her death from a corner on the eastside of the Graveyard.\n

2.Defeat Rotten Wanda and retake Musical Box

filas.intro: Hand the old Musical Box to the Executive Chief of Memory Cave. It may have been left by his wife.\n

2.Talk with Executive Chief

3.Talk with Executive Puyi again

filas.nombre: From the Legend of the Ancients
filas.intro:
Sitting in the Eastern Desert, the mysterious ancient kingdom of 
Bassil has many old monuments that have aroused much
 speculation among archaeologists. This is a great chance for
 the Little Angels to help humanity!
pasos: 1.Head to Karang Desert, and report to Nel

filas.intro:
The Eden Archaeological Society has announced the official route to
 the 「Discover Bassil」 study trail. 
Unfortunately, things have not gone well. The mirages particular to
 the desert have proved a problem!
pasos: 1.Defeat Karang Desert's robber,\n  Find back /c$9%22014%/c* /40 boxes of supplies
2.Return the supplies to Nel
3.Defeat the Masks in the Karang Desert:\n  /c$9%22015%/c* /90,remove the Mirage
4.Tell Nel about the disappearance of the Mirage \n .
5.Talk to Nel again.

filas.intro:
The new archaeologist, who happens to be Prof. Stein
 from the Ancient Civilisations Authority, 
is already in Pharoah Village trying to establish good relations
 with the locals…
pasos: 1.Look for Prof.Stein in Pharaoh Village
2.Eliminate the Sand Beast around Pharaoh Village:\n  /c$9%22016%/c* /120
3.Successfully helped the farmers of Pharaoh Village,\n  report back to Prof. Stein
4.Defeat the source of the Sand Beast:Sand Queen\n  Habes!
5.Successfully defeated Sand Beast King,report back to \n  Prof. Stein
6.Meet the current top leader of  Bussett  \n ,Priest Eaglearch

filas.intro:
The State Regent, Priest Eaglearch, has just lost his liege. 
He is fairly suspicious of foreigners, and we must try to allay 
those suspicions with haste...
pasos: 1.Clear Kitty Tower or Cat Mask that control the water source of the Niro River \n  :/c$9%22017%/c* /100
2. Report the results to Priest Eaglearch

3.Go to three water sources of the Niro River to collect water
  northen water source:/c$9%22018%/c* /1 pot
  eastern water source:/c$9%22019%/c* /1 pot
  southern water source:/c$9%22020%/c* /1 pot
4. Report the results to Priest Eaglearch
5.Collect Priest Eaglearch's reward

filas.intro:
Priest Eaglearch has given a chance at friendship to the Archaeological Society,
 who wishes to enter the Royal Valley.
 On behalf of the Royal Family, the conquered
 holy city, Raksui, must be retaken!
pasos: 1.Defeat Dune Oasis's Golden Brown or Green light\n  Jackal Soldiers:/c$9%22021%/c* /150
2.Defeat Dune Oasis's Hornet:\n  /c$9%22022%/c* /150
3.Defeat the leader of Dune Oasis's magic soldiers \n  Pharaoh's wife Nefertina
4. Report the results to Priest Eaglearch
5.Tell Prof. Stein the good news about being able to enter the \n  Royal Valley

filas.nombre: History sealed in the yellow sand
filas.intro:
Going through the deep caves of the Royal Valley, 
the Archaeological Society discovered wall paintings chronicling
 important parts of Bassil's history. 
The planned route has thus temporarily been changed.
pasos: 1.Enter the Cave of Falling Sand and defeat the /c$9%22023%/c* /125 Sandman
2.Road is finished, return to Pharaoh Village to find\n  Prof. Stein

3.Enter the Cave of Falling Sand and break the Mural 
  Collect/c$9%22024%/c* /32 pieces.
4.Task completed! Return to Prof. Stein

filas.intro:
The Royal Valley, foundations to countless huge pyramids, 
has been the resting place of Pharoahs through history. 
And the mysterious chaotic energy that created Bassilian civilisation
 also appears to be tombed here...
pasos: 1.Defeat Goldbrick Road's intruders:\n  Jackal Priest or Jackal High Priest/c$9%22025%/c* /75 \n  Blizzard Mage/c$9%22026%/c* /75
2.Road construction completed, return to Pharaoh Village to find \n Prof. Stein
3.Defeat Goldbrick Road's:\n  Silver Spirit Guide Akabi.
4.Defeat Goldbrick Road's:\n   Ankor the Book of Apollo
5.Defeat Goldbrick Road's:\n  Corn Star Fincto
6.Tell Prof. Stein the good news about being able to enter the \n  Large Pyramid

filas.intro:
As human footsteps near Ottenkhamun's tomb, 
the number of obstacles grow. Only by getting past these
 barriers will the historic truth
 be revealed to the people!
pasos: 1.Go ask Pharaoh Village's Priest Eaglearch.

2. Head to the Ancient Tombs,to defeat the creatures,
  find the Five Guard Tribe's statue:
  Snake Tribe statue /c$9%22027%/c* /1 
  Mural Tribe statue /c$9%22028%/c* /1 
  Book Tribe statue /c$9%22029%/c* /1 
  Tower Tribe statue /c$9%22030%/c* /1 
  Bee Tribe statue/c$9%22031%/c* /1
3.Bring all the statue back to the Pharaoh Village,please ask \n  Priest Eaglearch to open the door to the secret room.
4.Find Pharaoh Village's Prof. Stein

filas.intro:
The lost secret chamber guards the remains of Ottenkhamun, 
and is the final sanctuary of the Forces of Chaos. 
The story of undying will,  demonic motives, and the battle
 between factions looms ever closer. What will come of the truth
 that the Archaeological Society pursues?
pasos: 1.Go to the Unknown Chambers' front gate,\n  look for「 Pharaoh's Book 」carefully
2.Give  Pharaoh's Book  to Pharaoh Village's \n Prof. Stein,end Archaeological Society's \n  long「Discover Bussett 」action

filas.intro:
What a turn of events - the cruel Ancient Priests
 live once more! To save their family, and indeed, 
the world, the brave adventurers enter
 the pyramid!
pasos: 1.Destroy /c$9%22033%/c* /30 Archaic Mummies \n  in the unknown chamber
2. Return to Ancient Tombs, to meet up with \n  O'Cornnel
3. Defeat the Pharaoh's Guardian \n in the unknown chamber,lure out the  Evil Priest and Defeat it
4. Return to Ancient Tombs, to meet up with \n  O'Cornnel
5.Talk to O'Cornnel again.

filas.intro:
One of the guardian spirits of Bassil,
 the Sphinx, is famous for its love of riddles. 
It is neither good nor evil - yet, too many 
innocent lives have been lost to its riddles
 of life and death. It must be stopped!
pasos: 1.Destroy the guard of the Unknown Chambers\n:Holy Sphinx Guardian,\n  release the souls that are trapped
2. Return to Pharaoh Village and confirm with Eflun \n  about his brother's condition.

filas.intro:
To some men, archaeology, adventure and treasure seeking
 are the only things that bring meaning to their lives. 
Prof. Jones, who has been through countless
 life-and-death situations, has also come to the Royal Valley
 to get to the truth behind the Pharoah's treasure!
pasos: 1.Found from the body of the Messengers of Styx within the Unknown Chambers\n : /c$9%22034%/c* /12 tablets
2.Give the found Records of Apollo's slabstones all to \n  Ancient Tombs' Prof. Jones
3.From Unknown Chambers's Desert Meatball's \n body found Forces of Chaos Residues:\n  /c$9%22035%/c* /20
4.Give the Forces of Chaos Residues found all to \n  Ancient Tombs's Prof. Jones
5.Collect payment from Prof. Jones.

filas.intro:
Their homes destroyed, the Cat People fled to Eden. 
The Lightning Cat King, who is about to ascend to the throne, 
received news that the demons who destroyed 
his ancestral home have appeared at the Pyramids. Unable to stand by
 and watch yet another home meet the same fate, 
he has decided to join forces with the adventurers!
pasos:
1.Attack the Unknown Chambers and kill everything within!
  Helio Jade Bangle:/c$9%22036%/c* /30 
  King Tomb's Mage:/c$9%22037%/c* /30 
  Ghostly Warrior:/c$9%22038%/c* /30
2.Victorious, report the good news to Prince Lemur \n !

filas.intro:
The beautiful yet venomous Empress, with darkness in her heart,
 masterminded the plot to kill the king and 
planned the revival of the previous Pharoah. With her loathing
 for her family and indeed, for her country, she has become one of the top targets
 of the Bassil Elders' elimination list.
pasos: 1.Sand Mist Queen Gilypela is hiding in \n  the Unknown Chambers,go defeat her!
2.Report Queen 's death to \n  Pharaoh Village's Totemus

filas.intro:
The Bassil Templars have always seen the protection of
 the Royal Valley as their mission in life. 
Upon hearing that the demons intend to revive
 the previous Pharoah, these mysterious warriors
 have begun to move to stop
 the insult to king and country!
pasos: 2.The battle has ended. Return to Aderbas.

filas.intro:
The kind old ruler has been revived 
as an evil king because of the work of the demons. 
This has dealt a great blow to
 the history of Bassil - to rebuild its glory, 
he must be given salvation!
pasos: 1. Into the depths of the Unknown Chambers,\n and defeated Pharaoh Emperor Ottenkhamun.
2.Give the ancient honor back to \n the ruler of  Bussett ,Priest Eaglearch

filas.intro:
The pessimistic and timid Walter has held office at the Archaeological Society
 for many years. He's always thought of himself as
 having terrible luck. Now he's in Bassil, can he
 overcome his misgivings and complete the task at hand?
pasos: 1.Punish Karang Desert's robbers,\n  get back /c$9%22042%/c* /1 Cat Crown Key,\n  return it to Walter
2.Give the key to Walter personally.
3.Accept Walter's Gift.

filas.intro:
Prof. Osmosis is one of the three great pillars of the Archaeological Society, 
and is regarded as a top figure in the intrepretation of ancient writings.
  He now resides in Pharoah Village, and 
looks forward to unearthing more ancient history!
pasos: 1.Pass through Karang Desert,to Pharaoh Village and \n  meet with Prof. Osmosis.

filas.intro:
The Sandworms that run rampant
 in the vast Bassil desert are the bane of caravans
 and merchants. If these huge, repugnant
 problems cannot be solved…
pasos: 1.The Snad Worm outside of Pharaoh Village must be eliminated!\n  The target is /c$9%22043%/c* /90!
2.Report the news to Prof. Osmosis.
3.Ask Prof. Osmosis to enforce the agreement.

filas.intro:
Within the Bassil Kingdom, the Niro River
 holds many ancient artifacts that have been
 washed into it over thousands of years.
 Without a doubt, it is of 
great research value.
pasos: 1.Carefully searched the Niro River,\n  dug out/c$9%22044%/c* /50 artifacts!
2.Give the documents to Prof. Osmosis.
3.Ask Prof. Osmosis to enforce the agreement.

filas.intro:
To decipher the ancient writings, more reference books are needed. 
And the Dune Oasis that was the old city of 
Bassil must be a huge repository of books. 
There are many robbers that covet these artifacts,
 so make with haste!
pasos: 1.Defeat Dune Oasis' Naga,\n  Get back /c$9%22045%/c* /30 stolen ancient books!
2.Give the ancient book to Prof. Osmosis.
3.Ask Prof. Osmosis to enforce the agreement.

filas.intro:
The branch of the Archaeological Society led by Prof. Osmosis 
is about to enter the Royal Valley, 
where the Pharoahs lie in eternal sleep. But before that, they must pass through
 a barrier put in place by nature…
pasos: 1.Drive away the dangerous lifeforms in the Cave of Falling Sand:\n  all types of Mummies/c$9%22046%/c* /75 \n  All types of Poison Snakes /c$9%22047%/c* /75
2.Report the news to Prof. Osmosis.
3.Ask Prof. Osmosis to enforce the agreement.

filas.intro:
At the end of the dark cave, huge monuments
 line a straight, yellow brick road that stretches
 into the horizon. It seems almost like a
 golden road…
pasos: 1.Go meet Griffon at Goldbrick Road.

filas.intro:
The advance party led by Prof. Griffon
 has met with trouble. The countless restless spirits in
 the Royal Valley have stopped their progress.
 It's time for you to go to the rescue!
pasos: 1.Cleared Goldbrick Road's Blocker!\n  Yellow-covered Evil Book or Flame Evil Book/c$9%22048%/c* /200
2. Talk to Goldbrick Road's Griffon \n  again.

filas.intro:
No matter how great a man is, 
he will still die in the end. 
The countless pyramids in the Royal Valley
 attest to that. What, really, can history
 teach the world?
pasos:
1.Enter the Ancient Tombs to find the shattered plate
  piece kept by the Pyramid Maid/c$9%22049%/c* /1 
  piece kept by the Mural Statue /c$9%22050%/c* /1 
  piece kept by the Magic Order Book/c$9%22051%/c* /1
2.Give the Shattered plate to Goldbrick Road's \n  Griffon
3.Return to Pharaoh Village to find Prof. Osmosis

filas.intro:
Violent sandstorms have blocked the path of the caravans. 
And the origin of these storms appear to be a group of Sand Demons
 that have banded together...
pasos: 1.Crush/c$9%22052%/c* /120 Karang Desert\n  's Yellow Sand Baby or Blue Sand Baby
2.Let Eros know the good news that the sandstorms are initially \n  under control
3. Defeat Lime Sand King Bitu
4.Let Eros know the good news that the sandstorms are completely \n  under control
5.Help Eros transport the goods to Pharaoh Village's \n  Elder Fredderick

filas.intro:
The elders of Pharoah Village in charge of agricultural matters
 are concerned about evil powers affecting
 the corn that was grown with hard labour. The food must be
 wrested back from the clutches of evil!
pasos: 1.In Pharaoh Village destroy the evil minded \n  corn monster:/c$9%22053%/c* /140
2.帶回所有被破壞的玉蜀黍給\n  長老法拉瑞克
3.Head to the suspicious place outside of Pharaoh Village,\n  spread the Holy Fertilizer
4.Tell the Elder Fredderick that Exorcise Fertilizing \n  has finished
5.Talk to Elder Fredderick again.

filas.intro:
The notorious Magic Eye has cast its gaze on
 what has become the focus of the world
 - the ancient Bassil artifacts. 
What on earth are they plotting?
pasos: 1.Teach the Naga of Dune Oasis a lesson:\n  /c$9%22054%/c* /100
2.Report the situation witht the Naga King to \n  Pan
3.In order to ensure the peace,defeat Niro River's Naga King \n  Hery!
4.收拾完畢，回頭告知潘恩
5.Ask Pan for your pay.

filas.intro:
Rumours have it that those who enter
 the Royal Valley and show disrespect for the
 royal tombs will be struck with a deadly curse! 
Can you save him?
pasos: 1.To destroy the nightmare,must defeat Goldbrick Road's \n  Jackal Priest or Jackal High Priest:\n  /c$9%22055%/c* /200!
2.Go back to check if Chief Sakar \n  is better

filas.intro: The whispers of death that come from Hades\n send human hearts into panic, and carry the promise of demise...\n
pasos: 1.To unlock the secret of the Lost Treatise,\n   defeat Ancient Tombs' Three head snake: \n  /c$9%22056%/c* /150!
2.Read Ancient Tombs' \n  Lost Treatise
3.In order to unlock the secrets of the Lost Treatise, \n  defeat Ancient Tombs's Hornet:\n  /c$9%22057%/c* /200!
4.Read Ancient Tombs' \n  Lost Treatise
5.Eliminate all the enemies that are buried next to the Lost Treatise \n  ,then read it.

filas.intro: 万花聖殿をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「万花聖殿」で女王・フラ\n  ンネルを倒す。
2.「万花聖殿」で大地の女神\n  ・ﾌﾗﾐを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 熾牙聖域をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「熾牙聖域」で赤炎犬神・\n  烈熾牙を倒す。
2.「熾牙聖域」で灼熱女王\n  ｻｲﾔﾘｰﾝを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 魔源聖殿をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「魔源聖殿」で混沌魔獣カ\n  オッツを倒す。
2.「魔源聖殿」で深淵魔王\n  ダークスを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 終焉の時域をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「終焉の時域」で幽魂王兎\n ラビットを倒す。
2.「終焉の時域」で時間女神\n ｱﾝｼﾞｪﾘｰﾅを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 幻金迷城をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「幻金迷城」で千年龍王ア\n トラスを倒す。
2.「幻金迷城」で賢者参謀\n ダイアナを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: The Merchant traveling in the desert is purchasing skins. You can sell some Lizard's skins to him~\n
pasos: 1.Collect Lizard Skin: /c$9%524%/c* /10
2.Take reward from the Merchant.

filas.intro: The Merchant traveling in the desert is purchasing skins. You can sell some Toad's skins to him~\n
pasos: 1.Collect Toad Skin: /c$9%525%/c* /10
2.Take reward from the Merchant.

filas.intro: The Merchant is often attacked by Desert Mice when traveling in the desert. To solve this problem , you help him wipe out those Desert Mice.\n
pasos: 1.Defeat Desert Mouse: /c$9%526%/c* /20
2.You\n can report the result to the Merchant since you have killed so many Desert Mice.
3.Take reward from the Traveler.

filas.intro: The Worker shipping parts was attacked by many Desert Mice when going back to Iron Castle. Help him get back those parts held in the mouths of the Desert Mice.\n

Little Red Riding Hood's 
grandfather is worried for her safety, and would like 
someone to take care of the dangers along her path.
pasos: 1.Defeat Apple Dwarf or Sweet Dwarf,\n  can obtain:\n  Dwarf's surrender/c$9%21294%/c* /1
2. Give the news to Little Red Riding Hood's Grandpa
3.Defeat Black Forest Spearman can obtain:\n  a letter of surrender from Black Forest Spearman/c$9%21295%/c* /1
4. Give the news to Little Red Riding Hood's Grandpa
5.Defeat Poker Leader Tilla can obtain\n  :\n   a letter of surrender from Tilla/c$9%21296%/c* /1

filas.intro:
Everyone makes fun of Pilford for being new, 
and they say his hunting skill must be terrible. 
This, understandably, upsets him. 
He wants to decorate his bow with 
some spoils of victory, to put an end to the teasing.
pasos: 1.Defeat Ancient Crustacean can obtain:\n  hard Shrimp Shell/c$9%21297%/c* /50
2.Bring the Shrimp Shell back to Pilford。
3.Defeat Thunder Lizard Zoom Zoom can obtain\n  :\n  high grade precious metal/c$9%21298%/c* /1
4.Report to Pilford.

filas.intro:
Phobe lives in the Lost Cove, and says there are 
many scary creatures there. The timeless solution is, of course, genocide. 
Please help him get rid of the scary monsters.
pasos: 1.Phobe's crying and said large eyes are really scary,\n  help him get rid of it:\n  Evil Big-eye Boy/c$9%21299%/c* /100
2. Give news to Phobe
3.Phobe is crying about a scary demon \n  ,help drive away:\n  Hell Envoy Mora
4. Give news to Phobe

This time, the stout Janice 
wants to get together with Morbrew

pasos: 1.Defeat Cute Riding Dragon or Dagger Dragon Knight \n,receive:\n   Etiquette Instruction Article /c$9%21301%/c* /100 pages
2.Report to Janice.

  Tanice's maidservant Stayed in Giant Stone Forest
  task:

7.Morbrew asked you to help prepare a return gift. \n  defeat Giant Ramasaur,receive:\n  Giant Dragon Horn/c$9%21304%/c* /1

On the way back home

1.Defeat Wilde Dragon Turtle,catch:

filas.intro:
It's said that the males of the Enrol family have 
all been cursed. Purvis Enrol of the 
Hoca Village continues to publicly deny this, but hopes you can 
help him privately lift the curse.

7.Report back to Witch Bonnet。

pasos: 1. Collect the Shadow Worms or Flame Worms' skins: /c$9%10464%/c* /45
2. Hand the fur to Cash.

filas.intro: It is said that there are a lot of precious crystals buried under those towers. Please help me get some back.
pasos: 1. Find the crystal mines: /c$9%10465%/c* /80
2. Hand the crystal mines to Qatar.

filas.intro: There are always some obscure diseases in the hot desert. Mitts requires some materials for his research.
pasos: 1. Capture the Dark Beetles: /c$9%10466%/c* /30
2. Hand the Dark Beetles to Mitts.
3. Obtain /c$9%10467%/c* /30 bottles of smoke from the Smokers.
4. Hand the smoke to Mitts.

filas.intro: To prevent infectious diseases, we have to determine different kinds of creatures at a fixed time each day. However, it is dangerous to ask them directly, so please help me collect some samples.
pasos: 1. Collect some blood samples from the Grass Goblins: /c$9%10468%/c* /60
2. Hand the blood samples to Timothy.

filas.intro: Food shortages have become a big problem because of the drought. We have planned to capture some supplies from the monsters. If you would like to join us, please go and capture some goods first.
pasos: 1. Capture some supplies from the Gelu Warriors: /c$9%10469%/c* /65
2. Hand the food to Barbatos.

filas.nombre: The Holy Land has been Violated!
filas.intro: The holy land we use for sacrificial ceremonies has become corrupted by the monsters that have taken it over. Please drive them away.
pasos: 1. Defeat /c$9%10470%/c* / 70 Evil Dancing Girls.
2. Report to Wheeler.

filas.intro: It is hard for people here to fight against the monsters. Maybe you can help them.
pasos: 1. Drive those Fierce Outpost Archers away: /c$9%10471%/c* / 75
2. Report to Voltarus.

filas.intro: Viera dreams of flying in the sky. He guesses that the Aquarius Elite Captain's Magic Liquid will help him fulfill this dream.
pasos: 1. Collect some bottles of Magic Liquid from the Aquarius Elite Captains: /c$9%10472%/c* / 70
2. Hand the Magic Liquid to Viera.

filas.intro: Those hateful White Witches have captured the princess' legacy. Please defeat them and return the legacy to Phuket.
pasos: 1. Get some Floriated Chests back: /c$9%10473%/c* / 75
2. Return the legacy to Phuket.

filas.intro: As a son of royal blood, Moran hopes to regain his lost honor by defeating monsters. Please help him.
pasos: 1. Kill the Aquarius Elite Members: /c$9%10474%/c* / 50
2. Go ask Moran whether you can help or not.
3. Defeat /c$9%10475%/c* / 50 Flame Rock Goblins.
4. Report to Moran now.

filas.intro: Eliot is determined to learn the highest-level dance. It is said that the Leviathan's dancing girls have learnt the most captivating magical dance in the world. He would like to learn it too.
pasos: 1. Enter the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat every kind of Dancing Girls until you find 'Dance Book PT1'.
2. Enter the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat all the Dancing Girls until you find the 'Dance Book PT2'.
3. Enter the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat all the Dancing Girls until you find 'Dance Book PT3'.
4. Hand all Dance Books to Eliot.
5. Kill all the Shadow Dancing Girls near Eliot.
6. Talk to Eliot after you kill all Shadow Dancing Girls.

filas.intro: Leviathan became jealous when she heard Jessica, Alfred's girlfriend, is very beautiful. She captured Jessica. Jessica is in danger now. Hurry and Go save her.
pasos: 1. Enter the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat Confused Smoker Sid who captured Jessica.
2. Talk to Jessica and Alfred.
3. Claim your rewards from Alfred.

filas.intro: The Lucky Cafe Shopman would like to hire some beautiful dancing girls so that he can earn more money.
pasos: 1. Go to the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat a lot of Thorn Goblins. Try to persuade /c$9%10587%/c* / 10 of them to be waitresses.
2. Go back to find the Lucky Cafe Shopman.
3. Go to the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat a lot of Thorn Goblins. Try to persuade /c$9%10588%/c* / 5 of them to become waitresses.
4. Bring the second group of Thorn Goblins to the Lucky Cafe Shopman.
5. Claim your rewards from the Lucky Cafe Shopman.

filas.nombre: Legend of the Savior in the Desert
filas.intro: Leviathan's followers want only to plunder the water in the desert. Please go kill them for the local people.
pasos: 1. Kill /c$9%10589%/c* / 70 Aquarius Warriors in the Leviathan's Bedroom and then bring back /c$9%10590%/c* / 10 pails of water.
2. Report to Kenzie.
3. Talk to Kenzie again.

filas.intro: The most important thing now is whether we can reclaim our lost glory or not. You must fight harder.
pasos: 1. Destroy all the Statue Ghosts in the Leviathan's Bedroom: /c$9%10591%/c* / 75
2. Report to Dara now.
3. Talk to Dara.

filas.intro: One of the most popular desert legends is about a Lamp Elf that will help people fulfill their dreams. Nobody knows whether it is true. But Abdul still wants you to help him…
pasos: 1. Go deep into the Leviathan's Bedroom and then defeat the Lantern Chacha.
2. Hand the lantern to Abdul.
3. Talk to Abdul again.

filas.intro: It is said that the Evil Lyceum has captured all four rare legendary animals. Can you save them?
pasos: 1. Defeat Cactus Fighters in the Crescent Valley and save the Leopard.
2. Defeat Lord Adrian and save the panda.
3. Defeat the Female Priest Grace in Ghost Village and then save the ostrich.
4. Defeat the Blind Worm Rory at the Troop Outpost and then save the camel.
5. You have saved all four rare animals. It is time to go back to find Memphis.
6. Defeat the Dancing Girl Bonnie in the Nightmare Palace and then bring the rare animal's souls back.
7. Go back to find Memphis now.

filas.intro: The naughty Fire Elf is riding a locomotive on the racetrack. Please stop it.
pasos: 1. /c$2 Run two circles/c* within the appointed time and then talk to the Fire Elf again.

filas.intro: The Water Elf has been travelling everywhere on a submarine. Please stop it.
pasos:
1. Go defeat the Jellyfish in the /c$2Colorful Coral Reefs, Wave Harbor, and Blue Sea/c*.
Ball Jellyfish: /c$9%12510%/c* / 50 
Stab Jellyfish: /c$9%12511%/c* / 50
2. Go back to find the Water Elf.
3. Within the appointed time, you should pass through the Blue Ocean and then go deep into the Sunken Ruins, then double to go back to find the Water Elf.

filas.intro: The Fire Elf is really naughty. It stole a train and would like to refresh its racing record.
pasos:
1. Clear nearby scorpions.
Blazing Scorpion: /c$9%12514%/c* / 50
Cruel Executioner: /c$9%12515%/c* / 50
2. Go back to find the Fire Elf.
3. The Fire Elf asks you to be ready for the race.
4. Run 3 circles within the appointed time and then talk to the Fire Elf again.

filas.intro: The Wind Elf can fly very fast. But how can you win when it has an airplane?
pasos: 1. Pass through the Fantastic Sand City, Troop Outpost, Ghost Village in order within the appointed time and then return to talk to the Wind Elf in the Ancient Front.
2. It is hard to win the Wind Elf. Maybe the Earth Elf can help you.
3. The Earth Elf told you that you can obtain the Wind Elf's Wind Power by telling it something sweet.
