4. In order to make the Wind Elf happy, you have to defeat the monsters nearby.
Savage Elite Leslie: /c$9%12518%/c* / 1
Giant Smoker: /c$9%12519%/c* / 50
5. You have taken revenge on the Wind Elf. It is time to go back to claim the Wind Power from it.
6. The Wind Elf promises to give you its Wind Power. Are you ready to try again? You only have a chance.
7. Within the appointed time, you should pass through the Fantastic Sand City, Troop Outpost and Ghost Village. Then double to go back to the Ancient Front and talk to the Wind Elf.

filas.intro: The little girl has a music box. But she is not satisfied. She would like some precious shells.
pasos: 1. Fish for some Pearl Shells from the lake on the Desert Racetrack. You can find something you need from the Desert Worms.
2. Fish some Pearl Shells from the lake on the Desert Racetrack. You can find something you need from the Onion Buds.
3. Fish some Pearl Shells from the lake on the Desert Racetrack. You can find something you need from the Fierce Outpost Archers.
4. Go find Matiz in Nightmare Palace.

5. Bring all the shells from Dancing Girl Bonnie, Scorpion Nick, and Aquarius Elite Captain for the Shell Girl.
Crystal Pearl Shell: /c$9%12523%/c* / 1
Jade Pearl Shell: /c$9%12524%/c* / 1
Pearl Shell in Bottle: /c$9%12525%/c* / 1
6. You failed. Go back to find Matiz.

filas.intro: The little girl has a music box. But she is not satisfied. She would like some precious shells.
pasos: 7. Go find the Lantern Chacha and then ask him to make a perfect Pearl Shell for the girl.
8. The Shell Girl's Pearl Shell is strange. Go find Matiz and ask him to verify it.

filas.intro: The Green Forest Scholar has come from far away and has researched around Eden for a long time. \n However, his research is now lagging behind because he hasn't found the Wind Pinecone, yet...
pasos:
1. Drive the following monsters away: /c$9%8461%/c*/30 Red/Cyan Dragon in 
 River Valley
, /c$9%8462%/c*/30 Orangutan in 
 River Valley
, /c$9%8463%/c*/30 Man eating Crocodile/Den Crocodile in 
 the Secret Den
 and /c$9%8464%/c*/30 Iron-shell Worm/Fire-shell Worm in 
 the Secret Den.
2. Finish the quest and report to the Green Forest Scholar
3. Talk to Messi in the Waterfall Camp

filas.intro: The Waterfall Camp are not happy with the work done by the Breeze Woods group. \n I hope that you can go to find their Leader Alonso and address this matter properly.\n
pasos: 1. Talk to Sharker in the Breeze Woods
2. Talk to Messi in the Waterfall Camp
3. Go to the Noisy Rain Forest and find a Wind Pinecone: \n /c$9%8470%/c*/1
4. Find the Wind Pinecone and hand it to Sharker in the Breeze Woods.
5. Go to the Ancient Glide River and talk to the Leader Alonso.

filas.intro:
Because of the dissension within the Orcs, 
 the Beast army is unable to go on the search. 
 The Leader Alonso asks you to help him to investigate why, nearby.
pasos:
1. Go to the Ancient Glide River and investigate it: 
 /c$9%8478%/c*/1 Doubtful Air 1
  /c$9%8479%/c*/1 Doubtful Air 2 
 /c$9%8480%/c*/1 Doubtful Air 3 
 /c$9%8481%/c*/1Doubtful Air 4 
 /c$9%8482%/c*/1 Doubtful Tool
2. Report to the Leader Alonso after finishing the quest.
3. Go to the Half-beast Hamlet and investigate the truth.

filas.intro: The investigation shows that those Orcs have been involved with the change in the forest. The Leader Alonso asks you to \n go to the Half-beast Hamlet and investigate further.\n
pasos:
1. Go to the Half-beast Hamlet and investigate it: 
 /c$9%8483%/c* /1 Doubtful Pipe Pile
 /c$9%8484%/c* /1 Doubtful Goods Pile
 /c$9%8471%/c* /1 Belia's Letter
2. Return and find Alonso
3. Alonso hopes that you can help him to report the situation to Messi

filas.intro:
Pressured by Belia, the Orcs have carried through 
 a horrible poisonous air project. 
 You must try to stop them.
pasos: 1. Return to the Half-beast Hamlet and get an antidote sample from the Beastmen: \n /c$9%8472%/c*/1 Sealed Antidote
2. After finding the antidote sample, return to the Waterfall Camp and talk to Malin
3. Malin would like to finish the research during the next 24 hours. \n Please come back tomorrow.

filas.intro:
Malin has finally found the solution. Please 
 help him to collect the ingrediants so that he can make an antidote to the 
 Laziness Gas.
pasos:
1. Collect the materials for the antidote (you should bring a Material Tank with you): 
 /c$9%8466%/c*/30 Poisonous Flower's Grume 
 /c$9%8467%/c*/30 Ice Flower's Powder 
 and /c$9%8468%/c*/30 Giant Forest Moth's Wing in the Clouding Forest 
 and /c$9%8469%/c*/30 Wood-eating Worm's Eyes in the Giant Wooden Stairs
2. Collect all of the required material and then go back to find Malin

filas.intro:
I am sure that Sandman had used 
 the rare material Earth Dew, to make his gas.
 It is not easy to collect. 
 But Malin knows that 
 you are the best choice for this mission.
pasos: 1. Obtain the Earth Dew: \n /c$9%8475%/c* /10 Earth Dew
2. Collect all of the required material and then go back to find Malin
3. Malin asks you to hand the Antidote to the Wounded Plinking Bird in the Limitless Tower.

filas.intro: Plinking Bird tells you how the \n the Sleeper Sandman has made her suffer.\n
pasos: 1. Talk to Plinking Bird
2. Plinking Bird hopes that you can tell Messi her story and \n then give a warning to all of the animals in the Green Forest.

filas.intro:
Lampard is very angry after finding out the truth that 
 Belia has used him. He promises 
 not to help Belia any more and he considers you a friend of the 
 Half-beast Warriors.
pasos: 1. Become a Half-beast Warrior and Claim your rewards from the Chief Lampard.

filas.intro: You have uncovered Belia's Conspiracy and \n protected the Green Forest. You deserve our honor and thanks.\n
pasos: 1. Report it to Sharker.

filas.intro:
Demons have captured the princess. 
 The loyal Knight 
 has followed the demons to the 
 front of the tower.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Fantastic Ancient Armor in the tower and rescue the princess.
2. Tell Yasa that the princess has been rescued.
3. Claim your rewards from Yasa

filas.intro: The ordinary Fire Element has become mutated for unknown reasons. Linn would like to find out why and so \n has entered the Limitless Tower alone.\n
pasos:
1. Defeat the Hell Rock Giant and obtain the Fire Heart.
 Then gain the Mutant Element from the Heart: 
 /c$9%8397%/c* /10 Mutant Element 
 Hand them to Linn.
2. Claim your rewards from Linn
Graver =====>   Engraver

filas.intro: Bateman is addicted to engraving statues. He was shocked by the news that there were \n vivid statues in the Limitless Tower.  Due of his envy, he plans to destroy all of them.
pasos: 1. Destroy the [Cracked Statue Ghost] in the Limitless Tower: /c$9%8398%/c* /20
2. Destroy the [Complete Statue Ghost] in the Limitless Tower: \n /c$9%8399%/c* /15
3. Destroy the [Devil Statue Ghost] in the Limitless Tower: \n /c$9%8400%/c* /15
4. Destroy the [ Battle Statue] in the Limitless Tower: \n /c$9%8401%/c* /10
5. Destroy the [Devil Battle Statue\n] in the Limitless Tower: 10 /c$9%8402%/c* /
6. After finishing the quest, return to the Waterfall Camp and claim your rewards from the Engraver Bateman.
7. Claim your rewards from Graver Bateman.

filas.intro: A mysterious young man would like you to \n get his home back, after it was occupied by demons. However, his home is \n the Limitless Tower, in the depths of the forest…
pasos: 1. Climb to the top of the Limitless Tower and defeat Sandman
2. Return to the Waterfall Camp and find Mcbains
3. Talk to Mcbains and accept his gift.

filas.intro: The elite pilot Guest was attacked as he carried out the quest in the \n Cloud-top Land. It made him feel so ashamed of his weakness that now he needs needs \n someone else to help him do his job.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Birdmen in the Cloud-top Land: \n /c$9%8403%/c* /80
2. Return to the Clouding Forest and find Guest
3. Claim your rewards from Guest

filas.intro: You should learn about the market and \n find the newest most fashionable items if you want to earn money. So the Pet Manager would like you to collect as many new pet eggs as you can from the Cloud-top Land. Do you understand?
pasos: 1. Defeat the Rose Wind Elf in the Cloud-top Land \n and find /c$9%8404%/c* /15 Special Pet Eggs.\n Then hand them to the Pet Manager in the Giant Wooden Stairs.
2. Claim your rewards from the Pet Manager

filas.nombre: The Guards of the Cloud-top Land
filas.intro: The Angel Patrols have discovered that the Evil Lyceum are planning to do something heinous. When they arrived in the \n Cloud-top Land, they found that the \n Guards there had attacked everyone nearby for no good reason.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Sky Guards in the Cloud-top Land: \n /c$9%8405%/c* /40
2. Report to the Patrol Leader
3. Claim your rewards from the Patrol Leader

filas.intro:
The 
 South Pioneers have suffered much from the leader of the Birds; who always flies around the sky with its Lion Eagles threatening them. If you can 
 defeat it, the victory will surely come faster.
pasos: 1. Go to the Cloud-top Land and defeat the Lion Knights
2. Return to the Waterfall Camp and report to the Skipper
3. Accept the praise from the Skipper

filas.intro:
In order to protect Eden, the Guards need more sturdy 
 Armor. 
 Billups in the Breeze Woods needs the materials to make such armor.  Go to help him collect what he needs.
pasos: 1. /c$9%8494%/c* /30 Stone Crocodile Skins \n /c$9%8495%/c* /30 Valley Orangutan Skins \n /c$9%8496%/c* /10 Chameleon Scales
2. Hand all of the required material to Billups
3. Hand the armor and the Red Berry Fruit Pie to Miss Sweet
4. Accept the praise from Miss Sweet

filas.intro: \n Unocal, the best friend of Miss Sweet is terribly lost. Can you to help her deliver a letter deep into the forest and hopefully find her friend.\n
pasos: 1. Find the Cotton Wood's Pulp
2. Hand the pulp to Billups
3. Hand the paper to Miss Sweet
4. Get the Clean Spring from the Secret Den
5. Hand the spring to Miss Sweet
6. Go to ask Elizabeth Bethel whether or not she has seen the \n Unocal.
7. Hand the letter to the Unocal.
8. Talk to Unocal.

filas.intro: The Leech Elizabeth Bethel needs to drink fresh blood to remain young for ever. However, she is scared of something...
pasos: 1. Defeat the Bloody Widow and obtain /c$9%8501%/c* /35 Spider Coils \n Defeat the Evil Pawn or Evil Monitor and obtain /c$9%8502%/c* /20 Bat Wings
2. Hand the material to the Elizabeth
3. Hand the material to Elizabeth Bethel and then claim your rewards from her.

filas.intro: You want to follow Albert into the forest. But, \n Unocal is hoping that you will help her.\n
pasos: 1. Ask the local people about Albert
2. Help Lolita to collect the Creamy Mushroom: \n /c$9%8508%/c* /60
3. Hand the Creamy Mushroom to Lolita
4. Report to the Unocal
5. Talk to the Unocal

filas.intro:
The Hermit Charllo, in the Noisy Rain Forest, borrowed a Secret Potion Recipe from 
 Lolita.  
 The reason why he borrowed the recipe is too complicated to go into...
pasos: 1. Hand the Secret Potion Recipe to Charllo in the Noisy Rain Forest.
2. Kill the Dark Corpse Flower
3. Ask Charllo about the Cursed Clay Tablet.
4. Hand the Cursed Clay Tablet and the Clean Potion to Naga Priest
5. Talk to Naga Priest

filas.intro: The Naga are a brave race. After a long time of war, \n the Nagan souls hope that they can go back home.\n
pasos: 1. Defeat the Meat-eating Orchid and bring /c$9%8505%/c* /50 Naga Skeletons back
2. Hand the Naga Skeleton to the Priest
3. Talk to the Naga Priest

filas.intro:
Reuten, who was sent to deliver a letter to the Orc Race, is now lost. The Naga Priest hopes that 
 you can find him.
pasos: 1. Find the lost Reuten
2. Take the letter from the Rain Butterfly
3. Hand the Complete Letter to Reuten
4. Hand the letter to Okco in the Half-beast Hamlet

filas.intro: Okco thinks that the letter is ridiculous. He hopes that you can \n help to explain the misunderstanding.\n
pasos: 1. Explain the misunderstanding to the Naga Priest
2. Go to find the Beastman in the Clouding Forest to get the truth.
3. Hand the Devil Certificate to Naga Priest
4. Claim your rewards from Naga Priest

filas.intro: In order to kill those demons, try to \n find some clues \n from Tailltean.
pasos: 1. Find some clues about the Demon Shadow in the Giant Wooden Stairs
2. Find out the relationship between Albert and Demons.
3. Claim your rewards from Albert

filas.intro: Because he is a demon, Albert went into the \n forest alone.  He didn't want to risk hurting his friends. He hopes that you can help him to make up for all he has done.\n
pasos: 1. Defeat the Naga people and bring /c$9%8513%/c* /30  Naga Blood back. \n Find  /c$9%8514%/c* /20 Thorn Fruit Juices in the Giant Wooden Stairs
2. Hand the required Naga Blood and Thorn Fruit Juices to Albert
3. Hand Albert's ring to the Unocal and ask her return to the Breeze Woods
4. Report to the Unocal and claim your rewards from her.

filas.intro: A young boy worked hard for a long time and finally bought a new house. He would like to hold a party but he needs something.
pasos:
1. Help Harrods collect the following kinds of fruit:
Valley Orangutans' Banana: /c$9%12528%/c* / 20
Pirate Leaders' Coconuts: /c$9%12529%/c* / 30
Cactus Yoku's Peaches: /c$9%12530%/c* / 15
Dream Elf Terrossi's Pineapple: /c$9%12531%/c* / 1 
You can find these items from the River Valley, Shining Coast, Crescent Valley and Noisy Rain Forest.
2. Report to Harrods now.

3. Harrods would like you to collect the following materials for his lamp.
Artist Mark's magical paint /c$9%12532%/c* / 1
Destroyer Wesley's steel wick /c$9%12533%/c* / 1
Sea Explorer's lampshade /c$9%12534%/c* / 1
4. Report to Harrods.

filas.nombre: For the Sake of the Zoo
filas.intro: The young man dreams of owning a big zoo. But he requires more animals. Can you help him?
pasos: 1. Go consult with Glen
2. Help Glen get her beloved cow back. It is said that the cow has been captured by the Orangutan Mothers in Waterfall Camp.
3. You pick up a bell and find a name, "Arthur", on it.
4. Bring the cow to Glen. By the way, ask about Arthur's dog.
5. Ask Pele in Waterfall Camp about the missing dog.
6. Rescue the little dog from the Blue Clapper Dragons.
7. You have found the dog. Go back to find Arthur now.
8. Arthur would like to send his dog to the zoo. Go back to find Young Anthony now.

filas.nombre: Reign of Terror in the Palace
filas.intro: The Cursed Scorpion Emperor became enraged again and destroyed everything in the palace. What can I do now? There are some guests coming next month.
pasos: 1. Retake /c$9%12537%/c* / 20 Palace Chairs from the Palace Soldiers and Dark Warriors.
2. Hand all the chairs to the Palace Butler.
3. Go to the Ancient Front and find the Craftsman Alphonse.
4. You must collect /c$9%12538%/c* / 40 Rare Stone Materials from the Grass Goblins.
5. Hand the stone materials to Alphonse.
6. Obtain /c$9%12539%/c* / 1 Hard Drill from the Raging Giant Stoneman and /c$9%12540%/c* / 1 Bottle Liam's stone reamer in the Fantastic Sand City.
7. Hand the tool to Alphonse.
8. Bring this good news to the Palace Butler.

filas.intro: The spies in the Evil Lyceum said that the Evil Lyceum has sent someone to the Angel Lyceum. Let's find out who it is.
pasos: 1. Go investigate the entrance of the den.
2. Report to the Angel Agent now.
3. Defeat the Evil Knights in the Sad Abyss, Fiery Path or Flaming Door and obtain the sword.
4. Use the sword to destroy the entrance.
5. The door is locked. You have to come back to the Angel Agent.
6. Defeat the Poo Poo Demons in the Magic Kitchen and then bring back /c$9%12542%/c* / 40 Stool Distillate.
7. Go back to find the Angel Agent now.
8. Go back to find the Angel Agent two days later.

filas.intro: The spies in the Evil Lyceum said that the Evil Lyceum has sent someone to the Angel Lyceum. Let's find out who it is.
pasos: 9. Bring the key model and then fight with Rock God Mendun. Seize the chance to make a key.
10. Successfully made a key. You can use it to open the demons' den now.
11. Asmodeus is the spy again. He is a human this time. We should defeat him.
12. Defeat Asmodeus again and then report to the Angel Agent.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Magic Kitchen. \n  Defeat /c$2 Evil Cook /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Gulp Room. \n  Defeat /c$2 Glutton /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Evil Ship. \n  Defeat /c$2 Mamen /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Lost Region. \n  Defeat /c$2 Hicalu 1 /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Horrible Lost Region. \n  Defeat /c$2 Hicalu 1  /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: Defeat the named Devils and prove your ability to Garden Supervisor.\n
pasos: 1. Go to Limitless Tower. \n  Defeat /c$2 Sleeper Sandman /c*\n  and get the certificate.

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王,向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往雲頂聖域,\n  打倒/c$2獅鷲騎士/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王,向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往莉維坦的寢室,\n  打倒/c$2莉維坦/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王,向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往波提神殿,\n  打倒/c$2莉莉絲/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王,向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往撲克城堡,\n  打倒/c$2歌特蘿/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: Defeat the designated demon, and show the Lyceum Inspector what you've got.\n
pasos: 1.Head to Dinosaur Arena,\n  Defeat /c$2Dragon Emperor Rex/c*\n  Acquire proof.

filas.intro: Defeat the designated demon, and show the Lyceum Inspector what you've got.\n
pasos: 1.Head to the Unknown Chambers,\n  Defeat /c$2 Pharaoh Pharaoh Emperor Ottenkhamun/c*\n  and receive the proof.

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王，向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往彩鳳皇宮，\n  打倒/c$2盤絲女帝玉蛛兒 /c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王，向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往寒冰魔堡，\n  打倒/c$2冰晶女王娜堤絲/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王，向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往姆諾戰艦，\n  打倒/c$2異星蟲后艾利安/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: 打倒指定的魔王，向學園督察長證明你的能耐。\n
pasos: 1.前往珞櫻城，\n  打倒/c$2雷霆霸者阿修羅王/c*\n  並取得證明。

filas.intro: The lovely Fairies have suddenly turned very \n mischievous. They have caused a lot of trouble. \n These businessmen are hoping that you can help them to sort this out.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Moon Berry Elf in the River Valley: \n /c$9%8406%/c* /45
2. Report to Walton
3. Talk to Walton again.

filas.intro: In order to get Chameleon skins, Glock went into the River Valley alone. He hopes that you can help him with the hunt.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Chameleons in the River Valley and bring /c$9%8407%/c* /10  Skins back.
2. Claim your rewards from Glock
3. Talk to Glock again.

filas.intro: Because of their breeding season, the Orangutans have \n destroyed the forest. \n Tom is worried and asks you to help him to protect his crops.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Valley Orangutans in the River Valley: \n /c$9%8408%/c* /50
2. The Orangutans have been driven away. Report to Tom
3. Talk to Tom again.

filas.intro: The Bat-killer Mori has come to the \n Secret Den and is planning to \n kill all of the bats in Eden. Will you help him?
pasos: 1. Kill all of the different Bats in the Secret Den: \n /c$9%8409%/c* /40
2. Report to Mori
3. Talk to Mori again.

filas.intro: Mr. Hocken is a legendary person who is \n addicted to capturing Crocodiles.\n He hopes that someone can help him with his passion.
pasos: 1. Kill all of the different of Crocodiles in the Secret Den: \n /c$9%8410%/c* /40
2. Report to Mr. Hocken
3. Talk to Mr. Hocken again.

filas.intro: Nazca, a girl from the original race, is very worried that \n those worms may cause a disaster.\n Only you can stop them peacefully.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Worm Lord in the Secret Den: \n /c$9%8411%/c* /45
2. Report to Nazca
3. Talk to Nazca again.

filas.nombre: Clean up the Source of the Pollution
filas.intro: Rotten Flies are surrounding the camp and \n bringing vile diseases with them. The Soldiers are suffering from many of them.\n We should get rid of those Rotten Flies as soon as possible.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Rotten Fly in the Waterfall Camp: \n /c$9%8412%/c* /40
2. Report to Napalm
3. Talk to Napalm again.

filas.intro:
All of the Beast people hope that 
 they can live at one with nature peacefully. 
 However, the power from Eden 
 has destroyed the delicate balance of the forest...
pasos: 1. Defeat the Earth Fairy in the Waterfall Camp: \n /c$9%8413%/c* /40
2. Report to Nev
3. Talk to Nev again.

filas.intro: The \n Scholar Stanford has found that the Orangutans in the forest have a matriachal system of power.\n So, we can easily solve the problem by defeating the Orangutan Mothers.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Orangutan Mother near the Waterfall Camp: \n /c$9%8414%/c* /40
2. Tell Stanford the results
3. Talk to Stanford again.

filas.intro: The Dark Corpse Flowers have injured many people \n in the Noisy Rain Forest. We can't stand by and do nothing anymore.
pasos: 1. Kill the Dark Corpse Flower in the Noisy Rain Forest: \n /c$9%8415%/c* /50
2. Report to George
3. Talk to George again.

filas.intro: The Naga's, who often hurt animals and human beings live in the Noisy Rain Forest. Mr. White hopes that you will be able to defeat them.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Green Scale Soldier in the Noisy Rain Forest: \n /c$9%8416%/c* /45
2. Report to Mr. White
3. Talk to Mr. White again.

filas.intro: Those Beastmen are causing so much trouble for the army. Mr. Howling Wolf hopes that you will be able to defeat them.
pasos: 1. Drive the Beastman Slave in the Ancient Glide River away: \n /c$9%8417%/c* /40
2. Report to Mr. Howling Wolf
3. Talk to Mr. Howling Wolf again.

filas.intro: The Moths in the forest have been secretly spreading a special powder which \n makes soldiers lazy and faint. Their plan must be stopped.\n
pasos: 1. Kill the Forest Moth in the Ancient Glide River: \n /c$9%8418%/c* /50
2. Report to Dicken
3. Talk to Dicken again.

filas.intro: The ever faithful Tiger Destroyers \n plan to attack the base camp of the Beastmen. It would be better for all if you helped them. \n
pasos: 1. Kill the Beastman in the Half-beast Hamlet: \n  /c$9%8419%/c* /50
2. Report to Mr. Mud
3. Talk to Mr. Mud again.

filas.intro: \n Sousa hopes that you can help him defeat the Naga race \n as they have caused a lot of trouble for the humans and the Beastman race as well.
pasos: 1. Defeat all of the Naga People in the Half-beast Hamlet: \n /c$9%8420%/c* /45
2. Report to Sousa
3. Talk to Sousa again.

filas.intro: \n Sousa hopes that you can help him to defeat the Chameleons \n, as they have been causing a lot of trouble for the humans and the Beastman race as well.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Yellow Clapper Dragon in the Half-beast Hamlet: \n /c$9%8421%/c* /40
2. Report to Sousa
3. Talk to Sousa again.

filas.intro: It would be better if you totally anihilated those \n evil Poisonous Flowers.
pasos: 1. Kill the Poisonous Flower in the Clouding Forest: \n /c$9%8422%/c* /45
2. Claim your rewards from Axel
3. Talk to Axel again.

filas.intro: The flying Moths are continuing to spread their \n magic powder to poison the soldiers. \n It is time for us to defeat them.
pasos: 1. Kill the Giant Forest Moth in the Clouding Forest: \n /c$9%8423%/c* /50
2. Report to Frei
3. Talk to Frei again.

filas.intro: The Birdmen are \n on the way to the Holy Land.\n We cannot go there unless we first defeat them.
pasos: 1. Climb to the Giant Wooden Stairs and defeat the Bird Soldier or the Bird Sharpshooter: \n /c$9%8424%/c* /50
2. Report to the South Pioneer Leader
3. Talk to South Pioneer Leader again.

filas.intro: Those Guard Statues are the Demons' faithful guardians. We should defeat them first if we want to go ahead.
pasos: 1. Destroy the Guard Statue in the Giant Wooden Stairs: \n /c$9%8425%/c* /40
2. Report to Kulidolph
3. Talk to Kulidolph again.

filas.intro: The biggest transportation company, [Eden Express], built a branch in Waterfall Camp and they are badly in need of hands to help them deliver goods.
pasos: 1. Deliver the goods to Seller Walton in the River Valley.
2. Go back to Waterfall Camp and then claim your rewards from the Eden Express Manager.

filas.intro: The Witch Black Rose would like to forge a weapon which can cut souls. She requires fresh blood every day.
pasos: 1. Defeat /c$9%8428%/c* /60 Wistaria Elves in the Noisy Rain Forest.
2. Hand the weapon covered with blood to the Witch Black Rose.
3. Claim your rewards from the Witch Black Rose.

filas.nombre: More in Name than in Reality
filas.intro: An expert who is skilled at removing weeds is in big trouble now because the deadly man-eating flowers are directly in front of him.
pasos: 1. Kill /c$9%8430%/c* /60 Meat-eating Orchids in the Ancient Glide River.
2. Report to Hicks now.
3. Claim your rewards from Hicks.

filas.intro: Alexis is interested in collecting samples. He believes that they will last forever. That's why he goes to the towering Giant Wooden Stairs alone and tries to capture those rare worms.
pasos: 1. Capture /c$9%8432%/c* /60 Wood-eating Worms in the Giant Wooden Stairs.
2. Report to Alexis now.
3. Claim your rewards from Alexis.

filas.intro: The South Pioneer Army must surmount the obstacles in the Limitless Tower first if they want to move on. The battle situation will get better if we can destroy the crystals there.
pasos: 1. Destroy the various crystals in the Limitless Tower: /c$9%8434%/c* /45
2. Report to Ken in the Half-beast Hamlet.
3. Claim your rewards from Ken.

filas.intro: Eden used to be a beautiful continent. However, the environment has steadily deteriorated because of the humans and demons’ destructive actions. It is time to take back the environment now!\n
pasos:
1. Kill the monsters in  Wave Harbor...
  Beachball Jellyfish or Stab Jellyfish:
  /c$9%12597%/c* /75
  Whelk Swordsman: /c$9%12598%/c* /60 
  Whelk Mage: /c$9%12599%/c* /60  
  Angel Fish: /c$9%12600%/c* /45
2. Return to Palm Base and find Villiersas
3. Go to Hell Palace and talk to Lorin

4. Defeat the Riddle City 
  Bishops and find the 
  Black Crystals  /c$9%12602%/c* /80
   then go back to Lorin.
5.Go to the Waterfall Camp and talk to Stuart.

6. Defeat the Earth Fairies 
  and obtain a certain 
  amount of Earth Fruit, 
  try to open them to obtain 
  Elite Cores /c$9%12604%/c* / 10 and
   then go back to Stuart.
7. Return to Palm Base and find Villiersas

8. Defeat the following BOSSes to obtain pieces...
  Sword Jellyfish:  /c$9%12605%/c* / 1
  Leech Mrs. Dorsa: /c$9%12606%/c* / 1
  Hermit Hezon: /c$9%12607%/c* / 1
  Purple Scorpion Issac: /c$9%12608%/c* / 1
  Destroyer Wesley:  /c$9%12609%/c* / 1 
  and then go back to Villiersas!

filas.intro: Eden used to be a beautiful continent. However, the environment has steadily deteriorated because of the humans and demons’ destructive actions. It is time to take back the environment now!\n
pasos: 1. Collect Certain Blue Sea Crystals from the materials in the Colorful Coral Reefs: /c$9%12601%/c* /30
2. Return to Palm Base and find Villiersas
3. Go to Hell Palace and talk to Lorin

4.  Collect certain Black 
  Crystals /c$9%12602%/c* /100 from 
  the materials in Hell 
  Palace and the Underground 
  Square and then go back 
  to Lorin.
5.Go to Waterfall Camp and talk to Stuart.

6. Collect certain Earth 
  Fruit from materials in 
  Waterfall Camp, then try 
  to open them to obtain the 
  Elite Cores /c$9%12604%/c* / 20 
  then go back to Stuart.
7. Return to Palm Base and find Villiersas

8. Collect all the kinds of materials to obtain pieces...
  Colorful Coral Reefs:  /c$9%12605%/c* / 1
  Wave Harbor:  /c$9%12606%/c* / 1
  Underground Square:  /c$9%12607%/c* / 1
  River Valley: /c$9%12608%/c* / 1
  Secret Den:  /c$9%12609%/c* / 1 
  and then go back to Villiersas!

filas.nombre: バレンタインイベント
filas.tipo: チョコスキーのバレンタイン
filas.intro: カカオを集めてチョコスキーの\n為に手作りチョコを作ろう。
pasos: カカオを集めて手作りチョコを作ろう。

filas.intro:
材料を集めて素敵な雛人形を
作成して、アプリコに届けよ
う！
pasos: 材料を集めて「雛人形」を作成してもらおう！

filas.tipo: ホワイトデーイベント
filas.intro:
チョコスキーはホワイトデー
のお菓子の材料が足りなくて
困っているようです。彼を手
伝ってとっおきのアイテムを
もらおう
pasos: 謎の粘液を集めてチョコスキ\n  ーに渡そう。

filas.intro: Lampard is the leader of all the Half-beast Hamlet and is very confident of his power. However, do you know how powerful he really is?
pasos: 1. Talk to Yalakni in the Secret Den.

2. Prove yourself to following groups: /c$9%9315%/c* /200
Beastman Soldiers, Beastman Warriors and Beastman Guards in the Half-beast Hamlet.
Golden Scale Guards and Golden Scale Witches in the Ancient Glide River
Beastman Colonel Mogu /c$9%9316%/c*/1 in the Half-beast Hamlet
  Naga Colonel Zic /c$9%9317%/c*/1 in the Ancient Glide River
3. Talk to Yalakni
4. Try to bait the King of Beasts near the Life Tree of the Giant Wooden Stairs.
5. Talk to Yalakni.

filas.intro: Recently, Yalakni has felt that someone wants to whisper something to her. What's going on?
pasos: 1. Go to investigate Naga's Altar in the Ancient Glide River.

2. Prepare the following materials for the Naga Ghosts.
 Rain Butterfly's Wings: /c$9%9320%/c*/120
 Giant Hook Worm's Meat: /c$9%9321%/c*/120 in the Ancient Glide River
 Ice Flower's Pistils: /c$9%9322%/c*/120
  Poisonous Flower's Liquid: /c$9%9323%/c*/120 in the Clouding Forest
3. Talk to the Naga Ghost
4. Talk to the Naga Ghost again.
5. Defeat the Hicalu Ship 1 in the Horrible Lost Region and bring the Eternity Light back.
6. Talk to the Naga Ghost.
7. Talk to Yalakni

filas.intro: Before you challenge Bazac, you must first forge Bazac's Key. You can obtain the required materials from the Sleeper Sandman. It seems that you have to pay a visit to the Limitless Tower.
pasos:
1. Collect the required materials to forge Bazac's Key in the Limitless Tower.
Holiness Crystal Piece: /c$9%9324%/c*/20
  Rule Crystal Piece: /c$9%9325%/c*/20
  Justice Crystal Piece: /c$9%9326%/c*/20
  Pity Crystal Piece: /c$9%9327%/c*/20
  Goodness Crystal Piece: /c$9%9328%/c*/20
  Ancient Demon's Skeleton: /c$9%9329%/c*/1
  Bazac's Key Model: /c$9%9330%/c*/1
2. Talk to Yalakni

filas.intro: If you would like to finish Yalakni's trial, you must go deep into the Gulp Room and then defeat Bazac…She also mentioned that the switch is hidden in some [statues].
pasos: 1. Defeat Bazac.
2. Talk to Yalakni

filas.intro: It is said that there is a powerful warrior in the [Dragon Field]. If you want to challenge Scissorhands Hanks, you should finish Just Rojam's trial first.
pasos:
1. Go to the [Ancient Front] and prove your abilities.
Pink Lizard: /c$9%12839%/c*/200
Dark Beetle: /c$9%12840%/c*/200
2. Go back to find Just Rojam.
3. Go to Dragon Field and find Scissorhands Hanks.

4. Help Scissorhands Hanks to find something delicious in the Flower Corridor.
Crescent Rabbit Meat: /c$9%12841%/c*/20 shares
Thunder Rabbit Muscle: /c$9%12842%/c*/20 shares
5. You have defeated Scissorhands Hanks. It is time to go back to the Just Rojam.

filas.intro: Just Rojam's equipment is broken. He needs someone to make a new suit for him.
pasos: 1. Talk to Craftsman Granny.

2. Defeat the Blago Miners and Gelu Warriors in the Fantastic Sand City and obtain following items.
Gold Ore: /c$9%12843%/c*/20
Bundles of Wood: /c$9%12844%/c*/20
Defeat the Panda Thieves,  Recluse Wanderers and Red-shirt Women and obtain following items.
Water Mucus: /c$9%12845%/c*/20 bottles
Fire Strings: /c$9%12846%/c*/20
Sand Bricks: /c$9%12847%/c*/20
3. Go back to find Craftsman Granny after you collect all the required materials.

4. Collect the following items.
 Ancient Front: Ancient Dragon Hawe's Heart: /c$9%12848%/c*/1
Flower Corridor: Cat Lord Fay's Soul: /c$9%12849%/c*/1
5. Go back to the Craftsman Granny.
6. Go back to the Just Rojam.

filas.nombre: Tree Elders are Asking for Help!
filas.intro: It was really a mess when I passed the [Giant Wooden Stairs]. What's the matter?
pasos: 1. Talk to Antonventa in the [Giant Wooden Stairs].

2. Retake Antonventa's goods.
Sunshine Palace: Fierce Knight William
Tree's Heart:  /c$9%12851%/c*/1
3. Go back to find Antonventa after you get the Tree's Heart.

4. You have to collect the following materials from the Palace Archers, Palace Swordsmen or Palace Axemen in [Sunshine Palace].
Organic Fertilizer: /c$9%12852%/c*/20 bags
Outdated Milk: /c$9%12853%/c*/20 bottles
Mountain Spring: /c$9%12854%/c*/20 pails
Times of Fertilizing: /c$9%12855%/c*/7
5. Go back to Just Rojam.

filas.intro: Recently, the Evil Lyceum has continued to send more and more troops to attack Eden. Lovely Angels, let's defeat them together!
pasos:
1. Go to the [Leviathan's Bedroom] and kill the following monsters.
Scorp. Emperor Adrian: /c$9%12859%/c*/1
Lantern Chacha: /c$9%12860%/c*/1
Leviathan: /c$9%12861%/c*/1
2. Go back to find Just Rojam.

3. Go defeat these monsters in Sunshine Palace.
Burning Witch: /c$9%12863%/c*/10
Ice Witch: /c$9%12864%/c*/10
Dark Witch: /c$9%12865%/c*/10
Swampy Witch: /c$9%12866%/c*/10
Evil Witch Judy: /c$9%12862%/c*/1
4. Go back to find the Just Rojam.

filas.intro:
Welcome to Eden, Angels! 
 We have some lovely 
 travel plans prepared for you. 
 We hope that you will learn 
 a lot about Eden during the course of your trip.
pasos: 1. After chatting with Recall Angel, go to /c$2Lava Cave/c* and talk with Guild Angel \n (You have one chance to be teleported by Recall Angel.)
2. Go to /c$2Palm Base/c*(Only one chance to be teleported)\n, then talk with Guild Angel.
3. Go to /c$2Waterfall Camp/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
4. Go to /c$2Desert Racetrack/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
5. Go to /c$2Airship Station/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
6. Go to /c$3Sign-up Office/c*\n (Only one chance to be teleported)\n, then talk with Guild Angel.
7. Talk with Terminal Receptionist and he will teleport you to suitable Training place, then the quest is completed.

filas.intro:
Welcome to Eden, Angels! 
 We have some lovely 
 travel plans prepared for you. 
 We hope that you will learn 
 a lot about Eden during the course of your trip.
pasos: 1. After chatting with Recall Angel, go to /c$3Lava Cave/c* and talk with Guild Angel \n (You have one chance to be teleported by Recall Angel.)
2. Go to /c$2Palm Base/c*(Only one chance to be teleported)\n, then talk with Guild Angel.
3. Go to /c$2Waterfall Camp/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
4. Go to /c$2Desert Racetrack/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
5. Go to /c$2Airship Station/c* \n (Only one chance to be teleported) \n, then talk with Guild Angel.
6. Go to /c$3Sign-up Office/c*\n (Only one chance to be teleported)\n, then talk with Guild Angel.
7. Talk with Terminal Receptionist and he will teleport you to suitable Training place, then the quest is completed.

filas.intro:
The Adventure Guild suffered heavy losses at the hands on the demons
 in Lotusia Kingdom! It is now recruiting powerful Angels
 in all the major cities each faction.
 You have come on the orders of Eden
 to investigate the truth!
pasos: 1.Report to /c$2Weldon/c* in Dawn Harbor.
2.Report to /c$2Klaude/c* in Port Cherube.
3.Help the soldiers clear out a pathway:  \n Hog Wraiths /c$9%23671%/c*/ 100.
4. Find the soldiers, then report to \n Galilei.

filas.intro:
Galilei tells you that many soldiers have been seriously injured
, and all they can do is stand guard here
. But they are running short on supplies
. He hopes you can head to Hazelnut Ridge and collect some peaches for them.
pasos: 1.Collect for the soldiers:  \n  Fresh Peaches /c$9%23672%/c*/ 50.
2. Talk to Galilei
3.Give the medicine to Dr. Fleming.

filas.intro:
Dr. Fleming, the authority in science and medicine,
 has made a request.
 He hopes you can bring him a First Aid Box 
 before he starts researching the 2 vials of medicine.
pasos: 1. From the Baby Shrooms, collect: \n  First Aid Box /c$9%23673%/c*/ 100.
2. Talk to Dr. Fleming.
3. Find the Lens Box \n on the Emerald Shores.
4.Give the Lens Box to Dr. Fleming.

filas.intro:
Dr. Fleming has discovered that there are unknown quantities within the medicine,
 but Galilei has delivered and urgent report.
 Several adventurers seems to have turned into monsters.
 He hopes you can investigate.
pasos: 1. Speak to Galilei to understand what is happening.
2. Find the people that transformed into monsters among the Violet Thunderhorns\n.
3. Talk to Freiyer to understand the situation.\n
4. Give the report to Galilei.

filas.intro:
Freiyer's report states that someone trying to sell the Elixir of Youth.
 Rudd turned into a monster after taking the elixir.
 The only clue points toward Gaia Valley.
 Galilei wants you to head there immediately to find out what is going on.
pasos:
1. Ask the residents of Gaia Valley for news:  
  Plume's information:  /c$9%23676%/c*/1 copy
  Ruby's information:  /c$9%23677%/c*/1 Copy 
  Wolryn's information:  /c$9%23678%/c*/1 Copy 
  Kent's information:  /c$9%23679%/c*/1 Copy
2. Using all the information you gathered, find the person that knows how to get the Elixir of Youth.\n
3. Clear the Purply Toasts:  200 /c$9%23680%/c*/
4. Talk to Dan.
5. Retrieve the Elixir of Youth near the Buddha statue at the center of the Angellic Cave.\n
6. Give the Elixir of Youth to Dr. Fleming.

filas.intro:
Dr. Fleming's research has discovered that all the 
 medicine shares a common ingredient,
 and he suspects that is what is causing the transformations.
 He wants you to collect more monster corpses so he can examine them and confirm his theory.
pasos:
1.Collect the following monsters for the Doctor:  
  Kava Horned Turtles in the Emerald Shores:  /c$9%23681%/c*/20 
 Stone Lion Guards in the Angelic Cave:  /c$9%23682%/c*/20
  Thunderers in the Gaia Valley:  /c$9%23683%/c*/20 
 Purply Hoppers in Dyna City:  /c$9%23684%/c*/20 
    Blue Bramblebirds in the Butterfly Garden /c$9%23685%/c*/20
2. Talk to Dr. Fleming.
3. Inform Galilei of the results.

filas.intro:
After hearing about the results, Galilei recalled the rumors of The Empress taking the Elixir of Youth,
 and suspects that 
 someone is trying to harm her. The medicine could already be completed.
 He wants you to clear a path to the Phoenix Palace so the guild can investigate the matter.
pasos: 1. Clear a path to the Butterfly Garden:  \n Eliminate the Flutter Lolitas:  /c$9%23686%/c*/200
2. Report back to Galilei.
3. Clear a path to the Phoenix Palace:  \n  Kill the Nine-day Thunderers:  /c$9%23687%/c*/100 \n  Defeat the Twin Thunders:  /c$9%23688%/c*/100
4. Report back to Galilei.

filas.intro:
After all the effort spent in clearing a path to the Phoenix Palace,
 Galilei tells you that the medicine research has been stolen by monsters.
. He wants you to get it back at all costs!
pasos: 1. Speak to Lil' John.
2.Find Steward Jevon, who has transformed into a Purply Zombie King, and retrieve the Medicine Report.
3. Report to Galilei.
4. Give Archangel Michael the letter from the Evil Lyceum.

filas.intro:
Master Tripeta wishes to trasnport the Sutras he painstakingly copied back to Dyna City,
 but it was stolen by the Monkey Magicians on the way.
 He needs somone to help him recover the stolen Sutras.
pasos: 1. Retrieve from the Monkey Magicians:  \n  Sutra Pages:  /c$9%23690%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Sutra Pages to Master Tripeta.
3. Retrieve the Sutra Cover from Monkey King Ujo.\n
4. Find Von' Bolt at the Resthouse and ask about the necklace.

filas.intro:
Von' Bolt says he had a pet monkey some time ago, 
 but it escaped. If you are willing to help him make Spring Peaches,
 he will show you where the monkey hides his stash.
pasos: 1. Help Von' Bolt collect the ingredients to make Spring Peaches:  \n Sweet Peaches from the Monkey Kid:  /c$9%23692%/c*/ 100 \n  Head to Dyna City and find Yoke to buy Sugar:  /c$9%23693%/c*/1 斤
2. Give the collected ingredients to Von' Bolt.
3. Retrieve the Sutra Cover from the Lantern Wraith in the Angellic Cave.
4. Return the Sutra Cover to Master Tripeta.

filas.intro:
There is a bird that constantly weeps in sorrow.
 Men call it the Bauloo Bird. It cries that its own sister caused it to become a bird,
 and the things that can prove its identity are lost.
 It hopes that someone can help it reclaim its life.
pasos: 1. Recover the Bauloo Bird's 金釵 from the Evil Sprites.
2. Give the hairpin to Old Champ, and tell him about the misfortunes of the Bauloo Bird.\n
3. Get the Mirror of Truth from the Thunderers.
4. Bring the mirror back to Old Champ.

filas.intro:
Old Champ wants you to give the mirror that can reveal the truth to Longine,
 and get him to view his wife and the bird through the mirror
 to discover the truth.
pasos: 1. Bring the mirror to Longine, and ask him to look at his wife Jade and the Bauloo Bird through it.
2. Help Longine catch Battleaxe Soldiers:  \n  /c$9%23697%/c*/ 100 to scare away the imposter.
3. Together with the Battleaxe Solider's, go "speak" to Jade.\n
4. Tell Longine what happened.
5. Retrieve the Wedding Rings from Demonic Turtle Zatan.\n
6. Bring the ring along and tell the Bauloo Bird what Longine said.\n

filas.intro:
Bauloo Bird feels Longine's sincerity,
 but she feels that things can never return to how they were.
 She hopes you will help her return the two Wedding Rings to Longine,
 and hopes that Longine will remember her…
pasos: 1. Retrieve the Wedding Rings from Punkfish King Shreke.
2. Give the two rings to Longine, and tell him what the Bauloo Bird thinks.\n
3. Speak to the Bauloo Bird.

filas.intro:
The bread shop has finally reopened,
 but everyone is so busy that there is no time to make deliveries.
 Pamela hopes you will help her deliver the Steamed Bread to customers
 (This quest is timed.)
pasos:
1. Within the time limit, deliver the steamed bread to:   
 Shaolin Senior in Port Cherube:   /c$9%23701%/c*/ 1 
 Shaolin Junior Juan in Port Cherube:   /c$9%23702%/c*/ 1 
 Shaolin Junior Doo in Port Cherube:   /c$9%23703%/c*/ 1
2. Report back to Pamela.
3. Within the time limit, deliver the steamed bread to:   \n Shaolin Junior Tres in Angellic Cave:  /c$9%23704%/c*/ 1 \n  Shaolin Junior Vorh in Angellic Cave:  /c$9%23705%/c*/ 1
4. Report back to Pamela.
5. Bring the steamed bread back to Kunfu Pann.\n
6. Report back to Pamela.

filas.intro:
Pamela's steamed bread is eaten by everyone within Lotusia Kingdom,
 but now she is facing a shortage of flour and cannot make anymore.
 She needs someone to head to Gaia Valley to check on the supply chain.
pasos: 1. Ask Donn if there is any flour.
2. Clear the terraces of: \n Startled Scarecow:  /c$9%23700%/c*/ 100
3. Report back to Donn.
4. Get the flour from Donn in 5 minutes.
5. Bring the flour back to Pamela.

filas.intro:
Kungfu Pann is an honorable warrior,
 but, weak from hunger,
 he is unable to get rid of the monsters.
  He hopes the angels can help him clear the road so Pamela can deliver the steamed bread to him safely.
pasos: 1. Clear the path of:  \n  Monkey Rayans:  /c$9%23706%/c*/ 100
2. Report back to Kungfu Pann.
3. Give the food basket to Pamela.

filas.intro:
On orders of their master, the skilled Shaolin Brothers have come down from the mountain to rid the land of evil.
 They are spread across the land fighting monsters,
 and they wish there were some way to show their concern for one another.
pasos: 1.Help Shaolin Junor Juan kill:  \n  Raging Bread:  /c$9%23707%/c*/ 100
2. Speak to Shaolin Junior Juan.
3. Help Shaolin Junior Doo collect:  \n Midnight Lantern /c$9%23708%/c*/ 100
4. Give the lanterns to Shaolin Junior Doo.
5. Bring the remaining lanterns to Shaolin Junior Tres in the Angelic Cave.
6. Get Pamela in Dyna City to repair the shoes.\n
7. Give the shoes to Shaolin Junior Vorh in the Angellic Cave.\n

filas.intro:
When the Phoenix Palace fell,
 Lil' James escaped with Lil' John.
 But he keeps thinking about the handkerchief and portrait his mother gave to him before he entered the palace.
 He hopes that the angels can help him retrieve these two items from the palace.
pasos: 1. Get the Fragrant Handkerchief from the Pompom Wraith.
2. Give the handkerchieg to Lil' James.
3. Find the portrait in a cabinet near the entrance to the palace.\n
4. Head back to Lil' James.

filas.intro:
Sampson sells fish for a living,
 but all the fish have become monsters, and there are no normal fish to be found
. Thus, he hopes that the angels can catch some mutated fish for him, so he can slice off the parts that are still fish and continue to make a living..
pasos: 1. Help Sampson collect:  \n Coral Gogglefish/c$9%23710%/c*/100
2. Go back to Sampson.

filas.intro:
Sherryl is complaining that all her bread have become monsters,
 and have even wrecked her stall.
 She wants you to eliminate the bread monsters so she can continue to do business in peace.
pasos: 1. Sherryl kill:  \n  Weeping Bread /c$9%23711%/c*/100
2. Go back to Sherryl.

filas.intro:
Langdon is an artist, and especially like to eat Crab Claws 
. But all the crabs have turned into monsters, resulting in low supplies.
 He hopes the angels can help him gather some more Crab Claws.
pasos: 1. Help Langdon gather :  \n  Golden Crab Claws/c$9%23712%/c*/50
2. Give Langdon the Crab Claws.

filas.intro:
Apple's father has fallen ill, and the doctor says it is an incurable disease.
 Only by drinking soup made from reishi shrooms everyday can he survive.
 She begs all the angels to help collect more reishi shrooms to prolong her father's life.
pasos: 1. Help Apple collect:  \n Lady Shrooms/c$9%23713%/c*/100 stalks
2. Bring the reishi shrooms back to Apple!

filas.intro:
Koko is the boss of a textile factory
, and he wants to make stronger and more durable clothing from fur.
 He hopes the angels can help him collect them, the more the better.
pasos: 1. Help Koko collect:  \n  Thunderwing Fur/c$9%23714%/c*/50\n  Thunderhorn Fur/c$9%23715%/c*/50
2. Return to Koko.

filas.intro:
Little Gin is an adorable ginseng spirit,
 and he wants to have one of the embroided balls worn by the Stone Lions as a toy.
 Hopefully, the angels will help him get one so he can play.
pasos: 1. Retrieve an Embroided Ball from a Stone Lion.
2. Bring it back to Little Gin and surprise him!

filas.intro:
Cowardly Ed needs to pass by Hazelnut Ridge on his way home,
 but ever since the ghosts appeared, he did not dare go near.
 He is desperate for someone to drive off the ghosts so he can go home peacefully.
pasos: 1. Help Cowardly Ed kill:  \n Violet Mystfire /c$9%23717%/c*/100
2. Head back to Cowardly Ed.

filas.intro: The monkeys have gotten more brazen lately,\n even daring to steal food from the kitchen. The Resthouse Waiter hopes that someone will teach them a lesson, so they will not dare do so again.\n
pasos: 1. Help the Resthouse Waiter teach a lesson to:  \n Monkey Kid /c$9%23718%/c*/100
2. Head back to the Resthouse Waiter.

filas.intro:
Herdboy Dave experienced a strange sighting: 
His cows suddenly burst into flames, run around wildly and disappear. 
He hopes you can find his cows. Even if there's just beef jerky remaining. That's fine.
pasos: 1.Help Dave the Herdboy find his cows (or what's left of it):  \n  Well-done Beef Steaks /c$9%23719%/c*/100.
2.Take the Beaf steaks back to Dave the Herdboy.

filas.intro: Zena lost her child recent by accident, and that dealt a huge blow to her. \nTo have her own child disappear before burial and be sighted amongst the undead by someone else; \nnow that was unthinkable! Zena needs someone to verify it! Will you help her?
pasos: 1.Find Zena's child in Lost Hopper.
2.Return the body of Zena's child to Zena.

filas.intro:
Ever since the lanterns started transforming into demons, 
Lantern Seller Dee's luck has been down and out.
I'm sure he'll need some assistance to turn things around.
pasos: 1.Collect these Lanterns for Lantern Seller Dee:  \n  Festive Lantern:  /c$9%23721%/c*/50\n  Dancing Lantern:  /c$9%23722%/c*/50.
2.Return to Lantern Seller Dee with the Lanterns.

filas.intro:
Despite the family's trade in dealing and selling with herbs for generations, 
Herbbie went all out to rescue a Ginseng Spirit and kept it hidden from the family. 
With worry clouding the mind, Herbbie hopes someone drops by and check to see if it's alright.
pasos: 1.Ensure the safety of the Ginseng Spirit.
2.Report the news to Herbbie.

filas.intro:
Pyron has been dabbling with clay since birth. 
 His childhood dream is to create the largest statue. 
Of course, that means he'll need loads of clay - and he's offering a good reward for it!
pasos: 1.Collect Quality Clay from the Giant Imperial Swordsman:  \n  Quality Clay /c$9%23723%/c*/50.
2.Return to Pyron.

filas.intro:
If it's the latest in fashion wear, Jefferon is someone who will not disappoint. 
The recent shortage of raw materials in Lotusia hit her hard, 
but it didn't stop her from getting a new supplier: 
Ghost clothes!
 All she needs now, is someone brave enough to collect it!
pasos: 1.Collect the ghostly attire of the Spirit Concubine:  \n  Ghostly Attire /c$9%23724%/c*/50.
2.Give the attire to Jefferon.

filas.intro: The world-famous spices; the heart of Fortune Court has been impounded by the Queen's maids! \nThat's bad trouble for Chefs! They need it back! Fast!\n
pasos: 1. Enter the Phoenix Palace, take down the Ghost Maid and collect the Brew  Sauce Spices:  \n  /c$9%23829%/c* /15.
2. Return the spices to Waldemar
3.Find Head Chef Waldemar.

filas.intro:
It seems the tyrannic Queen and her cronies have incurred the wrath of Lotusia's loyalists! 
Now everybody wants a piece of them! 
The time has come to return the Kingdom to its formal glory!
pasos: 1. Battle your way into the Phoenix Palace and take down the Wired Zombie Baby, Giant Swordsman, Cloud Thunderer:  \n  /c$9%23830%/c* /60!
2.Update your progress to Yale in Angellic Cave.\n

3.Enter the Phoenix Palace once more and defeat the Purply Zombie King,
, Fallen Lion King, Flutter Ghost Maid,
:  
  /c$9%23831%/c* /40!
4. Find Yale in Angellic Cave and give him your report.\n
5. Talk to Yale in Angellic Cave.\n

filas.intro:
My father has been wrongly accused of a crime 
and is imprisoned within the palace. 
I must save my only family member…and I do hope that someone 
will help me!
pasos: 1. Find Old Man Gert, \nwho has been imprisoned in Phoenix Palace!
2. Once you've saved the old man, hurry back to the Angelic Cave \n and check on both father and son!

filas.intro: The prince loves art and has always wanted to paint the palace grounds. \nBut he's never had a chance to go strolling. \nThe current turmoil in Lotuspia Kingdom may give him a chance to fulfil his heart's desire!
pasos: 1. Go strolling in front of the Snowy Tiger building on the Phoenix Palace grounds.
2. Go strolling in front of the Green Dragon building on the Phoenix Palace grounds.
3. Go strolling in front of the Phoenix building on the Phoenix Palace grounds.
4. Return to the Butterfly Garden and meet up with Young Master Clive.

filas.intro:
Major General Den is descended from a famous general 
 and he doesn't want to let his ancestor down. 
 Now that the Queen has gone mad and the Kingdom is in ruins... 
Perhaps it is now time for the ancient Blazing Bull Blitz to make an appearance again!
pasos: 1. Enter Phoenix Palace and defeat the Cloudfire Ox. \nCapture  \n  /c$9%23832%/c* /35 Strong Bulls
2. Report back to Major General Den in Dyna City.
3. Re-enter the Phoenix Palace, grab the Grand BBQ Bread, \nand get: \n  /c$9%23833%/c* /35 Delicious Buns
4. Report back to Major General Den in Dyna City.
5. Get your reward from Major General Den.

filas.intro:
The four divine beasts that guard Lotusia Kingdom 
have been forced out of the palace by demon magic. 
 But the Snowy Tiger, which fought bravely till the end,
is now corrupted by demonic powers…
pasos: 1. Defeat the Infernal Tornado Tiger \nin the Phoenix Palace.
2. Go to Butterfly Garden and tell Grandmaster Leroy that the Snowy Tiger has been released from its torment.

filas.intro:
The Lance family has been exterminating demons for generations, 
protecting the people from harm. 
But the crazed Queen is resurrecting demons! 
We must hurry and rid our people of these demons!
pasos: 1. Defeat the Acrimon The Destroyer in \nPhoenix Palace.
2. Meet Lance in the Butterfly Garden.

filas.intro: Lotusia Kingdom enjoyed centuries of prosperity before the Queen ruined it by taking the path of darkness… \nThe Kingdom might be ruined, but the land remains. \nWill the land once again be filled with joy and the citizens find peace once more?
pasos: 1. Investigate the Empress Nephile, who lives deep within \nthe Phoenix Palace.
2. Go to Butterfly Garden and tell Grand Secretary Rin about Empress' defeat.

filas.intro:
「魔の厨房」の近くの別荘で
夏休みを過ごしているエリザ
ーベートはベシップの羽音が
うるさくて、快適な夏休みを
過ごせないようです。彼女の
変わりにベシップを懲らしめ
てあげましょう。
pasos: 1.「魔の厨房」でベシップを\n  倒す。
2.エリザベートに報告しよう

filas.intro:
長老ウォードは夏休みにうか
れて暴れている「天空聖域」
のモンスター達に困っている
ようです。彼の変わりに「天
空聖域」のモンスター達を懲
らしめてあげましょう。
pasos: 1.「天空聖域」で紺碧将軍グ\n  レイを倒す。
2.「天空聖域」でグリフォン\n  ナイトを倒す。
3.長老ウォードに報告しよう

filas.intro:
リルティーはポーカー城の「
ゴートラン」にいつもお菓子
を盗まれて困っているようで
す。彼女の変わりにゴートラ
ンを懲らしめてあげましょう
。
pasos: 1.「ポーカー城」でディーチ\n  を倒す。
2.「ポーカー城」でゴートラ\n  ンを倒す。
3.リルティーに報告しよう

filas.intro:
今年の夏はとても暑い！
南国おじさんはこの暑さで夏
休みを快適に過ごす事ができ
ません。彼の為に冷たい石を
取ってきてあげよう！
pasos: 1.南国おじさんに冷たい石\n  200個を渡す。

filas.intro:
歡迎小天使回到伊甸園大陸！
我們準備了精美的旅遊計畫，
希望您在這趟旅途中能夠更加
了解伊甸園大陸目前的發展！
pasos:
1.聽完回娘家天使的介紹後，
  前往/c$2熔岩石窟/c*與導遊天使對
  話。(有一次機會可透過回
  娘家天使進行傳送)
2.前往下一站：/c$2棕櫚基地/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
3.前往下一站：/c$2觀瀑營地/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
4.前往下一站：/c$2荒漠賽道/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
5.前往下一站：/c$2青空飛艇站/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
6.前往下一站：/c$2報名檢錄處/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟終\n  點接待員對話。
7.與終點接待員對話，他會將\n  你傳送到適合練功的地方，\n  任務即算完成。

filas.intro:
歡迎小天使回到伊甸園大陸！
我們準備了精美的旅遊計畫，
希望您在這趟旅途中能夠更加
了解伊甸園大陸目前的發展！
pasos:
1.聽完回娘家天使的介紹後，
  前往/c$2熔岩石窟/c*與導遊天使對
  話。(有一次機會可透過回
  娘家天使進行傳送)
2.前往下一站：/c$2棕櫚基地/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
3.前往下一站：/c$2觀瀑營地/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
4.前往下一站：/c$2荒漠賽道/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
5.前往下一站：/c$2青空飛艇站/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟導\n  遊天使對話。
6.前往下一站：/c$2報名檢錄處/c*(有\n  一次傳送機會)，然後跟終\n  點接待員對話。
7.與終點接待員對話，他會將\n  你傳送到適合練功的地方，\n  任務即算完成。

filas.intro: It's getting colder and colder in the village these days. The children can't withstand the bitter cold, and it's sapping away their energy. If we don't find a way to keep warm soon, they might become deathly ill.
pasos: 1. Enter Blizarro Castle, and defeat Laughing Snowballs to get Winter Cozy Packs: /c$9%26099%/c* /20
2. Give the Winter Cozy Packs to Frost Princess Ashlyn in Snowball Village.

filas.intro: I've never seen such an evil monster before… It actually stole Traveller Abzu's most valuable silver mirror. The evil that permeates the atmosphere in this forest sends chills down your spine!
pasos: 1. Go to Blizarro Castle and defeat the evil Frosty Guards: /c$9%26100%/c* /50
2. Tell Traveller Abzu that the silver mirror is nowhere to be found.
3. Go back to Blizarro Castle and search the even more frightening Frozen Mech Golems.
4. You've found the silver mirror! Go tell Traveller Abzu the good news right not!

filas.intro: Shiny Kururu's childhood playmate, Playful Deer, was lured away by the Sundae Monster and has been imprisoned in the castle for many years. Shiny Kururu wishes that someone would help save Playful Deer.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Giant Sundaes in your way: /c$9%26101%/c* /50
2. Talk to Playful Deer inside Blizarro Castle.
3. Tell Shiny Kururu what happened.

filas.intro: Miss Reiki has been in charge of the family's finances since she was little. In order to help support the family, she wants to get some rare flowers from the castle and plant them at home so that she can sell them for a profit. She hopes that someone will help her.
pasos: 1. Go to the corridors of Blizarro Castle and look for rare flowers.
2. Defeat the Bomber Mice that like to nibble on the flowers:  /c$9%26102%/c* /30
3. Return to Subzero Market and tell Miss Reiki about the results of your search.

filas.intro: As a descendant of a great merchant, Kito wishes to generate even more wealth. He needs an Angel to help him search for castle treasure. Even if there's no treasure to be found, killing a few monsters is bound to give him luck!
pasos: 1. Enter Blizarro Castle to try your luck. Search Palace Ferret Priests: /c$9%26103%/c* /30
2. Return to Subzero Market and look for Kito.
3. Go back to Blizarro Castle and bring Kito's spell with you. Search Palace Ferret Priests to get: /c$9%26104%/c* /10 Priceless Crystals!
4. Bring the Priceless Crystals back to Kito.

filas.intro: The /c$2Icewalker Anvecald/c* was sealed away by the Mirror of Truth. But now that the Queen has broken the mirror, the monster is now free again, and we have no choice but to use violence…
pasos: 1. Use violence to settle violence! Go to Blizarro Castle and defeat the Icewalker Anvecald!
2. Go to the Silver Wing Cable Car Station and tell Kerston The Puppet the good news.

filas.intro: The Winter Deer Family has always been favored by the King. But the King has now turned into a demonic dragon, and the Winter Deers need your help. Fight the dragon and get its blood, Battle Valor, for it shall save them…
pasos: 1.Enter Blizarro Castle and fight Ice Dragon King Gaelin.
2. Bring the Battle Valor back to the Silver Wing Cable Car Station and meet up with Deer King Troia.

filas.intro: This land has always been joyous and peaceful but in the blink of an eye, the Queen has destroyed it all by breaking the Mirror of Truth and setting free an evil god. The Queen herself is hysterical. We need the power of Angels to calm her down!
pasos: 1. Teach Frost Queen Natisse the value of true kindness and beauty!
2. Return to Silver Wing Cable Car Station and report to Seer Sade!

filas.intro:
ファラオ村にいるプノーリの主
人「フィフス」におやつを届け
よう。
pasos: フィフスにおやつを届けよう

filas.nombre: ニャンタのクリスマス
filas.intro:
エンジェル学園のニャンタに
は悩みがあるようです。彼の
頼みを聞いてあげましょう。
pasos: 奪われたプレゼントを取り返そう。

filas.nombre: Save The Kingdom Of Frost Mirror
filas.intro: A girl named Felika has arrived from the Kingdom of Frost Mirror. The Queen of her homeland broke the Mirror Of Truth and set free an evil god. And now Felika is traveling to the four main cities to ask brave adventurers to save the Kingdom.
pasos: 1. Take the Dragon Scale to Feather Leaf Forest and look for Flame Priest Firedance.
2. Search Frost Fawns for an Icy Cold Soul.
3. Give the Icy Cold Soul to Firedance.

4. While Firedance is casing his spell, defeat the attacking monsters: 

Dancing Devils: /c$9%26404%/c*/ 100

Apple Sundaes: /c$9%26405%/c*/ 100

Assault Mice: /c$9%26406%/c*/ 100
5. Report back to Firedance.

filas.intro: Firedance has accomplished her task and tells you that in order to break the Ice Queen's spell, you need to find Water Priest Jelli of Iceberg Lake. She will help you collect an item that can break the spell.
pasos: 1. Find Water Priest Jelli of Iceberg Lake and ask her about an item that can break the spell.
2. Search /c$9%26407%/c* / 100 Ghost Assassins to find the Water Relic.
3The Ghost Assassins have thrown the Water Relic into the lake. Go tell Jelli the news now.
4. Find Hawkes to scoop up the relic.

5. Protect Hawkes while he is trying to scoop up the relic. Kill:

Snowball Babies: /c$9%26408%/c*/ 150

Glacier Imps: /c$9%26409%/c*/ 150
6. Get the Water Relic from Hawkes.
7. Give the Water Relic to Jelli.

filas.intro: After Jelli has given you the spell-breaking item, she tells you to collect a Fragment of Mirror of Truth from the Illusory Maze and give it to the Wind Priest Hurricane.
pasos: 1. Look in the Illusory Maze for a Fragment of Mirror of Truth.

2. Defeat the monsters that were attracted to the Fragment of Mirror of Truth:

Ancient Fanged Dragons: /c$9%26410%/c*/ 150

Weathered Mice:
/c$9%26411%/c*/ 150
3. Take the Fragment of Mirror of Truth to Hurricane.

filas.intro: Hurricane tells you that the last spell-breaking item you need is Unmelting Ice. He says you have to go to the Radiant Cave to look for Earth Priest Shatterstar and ask him to craft Unmelting Ice.
pasos: 1. Go to Radiant Cave and look for Earth Priest Shatterstar.

2. Search Polar Snowmen for:

Ice Crystal Gems: /c$9%26412%/c*/ 100
3. Give the Ice Crystal Gems to Shatterstar.

4. While Shatterstar is casting his spell, defeat the monsters prowling about nearby:

Crystal Imperial Guards: /c$9%26413%/c*/ 150

Giant Lime Sundaes: /c$9%26414%/c*/ 150
5. Report back to Shatterstar.

filas.intro: The Ice Queen was always a gentle queen, but she has suddenly changed 180 degrees, and the four priests hope that you can help them find out what has caused this.
pasos:
1. Gather Magic Fragments in Feather Leaf Forest, Snowball Village, Illusory Maze and Radiant Cave:

Defeat Harp Lambs to get: /c$9%26415%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

Defeat Cutlass Dolls to get: /c$9%26416%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

Defeat Hooved Watchmen to get: /c$9%26417%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

Defeat Prism Soldiers to get: /c$9%26418%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

2. Gather Magic Fragments at Iceberg Lake, Subzero Market and Silver Wing Cable Car Station: 

Defeat Penguin Supervisors to get: /c$9%26419%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

Defeat Iceheart Soldiers to get:  /c$9%26420%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments

Defeat Ruddy Ice Ferrets to get: /c$9%26421%/c*/ 50 Magic Fragments
3. Put all the Magic Fragments into one of the ice mirrors inside the Illusory Maze.
4. Tell Shatterstar what happened.

filas.intro: Shatterstar is unable to accept the idea that the Ice Queen has anything to do with an evil god, but he knows that the Ice Queen's lady-in-waiting Girna has run away and is now in hiding. He hopes that you can find her and ask her some questions.
pasos: 1. Go to Subzero Market and look for Girna.

2. Defeat monsters to gain her trust:

Hooved Rangers: /c$9%26422%/c*/ 200
3. Talk to Girna.

4. Defeat more monsters to get her trust:

Ice Shard Imps: /c$9%26423%/c*/ 200
5. Talk to Girna again.
6. Break the Ice Queen's spell and activate the Silver Wing Cable Car Station.
7. Go ask Aito for help.

filas.intro: Repair Engineer Aito has agreed to help you repair the cable car, but you have to help him find all the parts that have been damaged, stolen and scattered by the monsters first!
pasos: 1. Search Goldbrick Card Soldiers at the Silver Wing Cable Car Station for:  /c$9%26424%/c* / 100 Electric Cables
2. Give the Electric Cables to Aito.
3. Search the Suicide Bomber Mice for: /c$9%26425%/c* / 100 Boxes Of Screws.
4. Give the Boxes of Screws to Aito.
5. Go to Subzero Market and look for Achaery.
6. Take the Spanner back to Aito.

filas.intro: The repairmen work really hard and soon the damaged cable car has been restored. You can now bring the items the priests gave you into Blizarro Castle to find out more about the Queen's ailment.
pasos:
1. Collect four different kinds of enchanted runes:

Search Plum Card Soldiers for:  /c$9%26426%/c* / 10 Fire Runes.

Search Zippy Snowballs for:  /c$9%26427%/c*/ 10 Water Runes.

Search Iceland Bigfoots for:  /c$9%26428%/c*/ 10 Wind Runes.

Search Magic Crystal Knights for: /c$9%26429%/c*/ 10 Earth Runes.

2. Find the four priests for their blessings:

Blessing of bravery: /c$9%26430%/c* / 1

Blessing of intelligence: /c$9%26431%/c* / 1

Blessing of virtue: /c$9%26432%/c* / 1

Blessing of kindness: /c$9%26433%/c* / 1
3. Defeat Frost Queen Natisse and find out the truth from her.
4. Place the Sacred Mirror Energy into the alter in the Illusory Maze.

filas.intro: Klundo is about to marry his long-term girlfriend and wants to hold a grand wedding reception. He hopes that you can help him deliver the invites to all his friends.
pasos:
1. Deliver Klundo's invites to all of his friends:

Aury in Snowball Village:  /c$9%26434%/c*/ 1 invite

Vandocre in Subzero Market:  /c$9%26435%/c*/ 1 invite

Haast in Silver Wing Cable Station: /c$9%26436%/c*/ 1 invite

2. Help Klundo's friends get wedding presents for him:

Search Frost Fawns for: /c$9%26437%/c*/ 1 Fortune Crystal

Search Harp Lambs for:  /c$9%26438%/c*/ 1 Lucky Green Feather 

Search Rainbow Conches for:  /c$9%26439%/c*/ 1 Silvery Shell
3. Report back to Klundo for your reward.

filas.intro: Klundo wishes to build a brand new Snowball House before his wedding. But the ice used to build it has to be hard and heat resistant. He hopes you'll help him collect and manufacture the ice blocks.
pasos: 1. Search Snowball Village for: /c$9%26440%/c* / 50 Ice Cubes.
2. Bring the Ice Cubes to Ice Carver Cinder of Snowball Village.

3. Help Ice Carver Cinder teach these monsters a lesson:

Trooper Mice: /c$9%26441%/c*/ 200
4. Talk to Ice Carver Cinder.
5. Bring the Ice Bricks back to Klundo.

filas.intro: The historian of the Kingdom of Frost Mirror, Felle, has dedicated her life to researching the kingdom's history. She wishes that someone could help her uncover the secrets of the land.
pasos:
1. Search the Evil Faeries of Snowball Village for: 

Script Carvings: /c$9%26442%/c*/ 100
2. Bring the Script Carvings back to Felle.
3. Search the Ice Princess Rilina of Snowball Village for Deep Blue Shards.
4. Bring the Deep Blue Shards back to Felle.

filas.intro: Historian Felle wants to fid out more about the Deep Blue Shards, as well as investigate the monsters inside the Illusory Maze. She is hoping that the monsters will give her some useful information.
pasos:
1. Search the monsters in the Illusory Maze for information:

Search the back of Crystal Core Fairy: /c$9%26444%/c*/ 1 strange mark.

Search the leg of the Hooved Watchman for:  /c$9%26445%/c*/ 1 strange line.

Search the chest of the Wooly Hat Snowball for:  /c$9%26446%/c*/  1 strange scar.
2. Tell Felle what you found.
3. Go ask Melix for help.
4. Find an ice mirror inside the Illusory Maze and paste the fragments  onto the mirror within the time allocated.
5. Ask Melix about what you saw.
6. Report back to Felle.

filas.intro: Historian Felle has found out that the marks on the monsters are a type of ancient magic used to control the monsters. She needs you to get more clues.
pasos: 1. Find out if there is a mark on Horn Hunter Faye.
2. Return to Angel Lyceum to look for the Magic Professor.
3. Defeat the Ice Ferret Sage of Snowball Village and check to see if there is a similar badge.
4. Talk to Felle.

filas.intro: After hearing the news, Felle is now wondering what is being guarded here. So she asks you to dig for more clues.
pasos:
1. Collect what looks like ancient items: 

Search Crystal Defenders for: /c$9%26449%/c*/ 100 Magical Ice Runes

Go to Iceberg Lake and find:  /c$9%26450%/c*/ 1 Draco Fossil.
2. Ask Melix for help.
3. Take the two items to  an ice mirror in Illusory Maze to test them out.
4. Examine the statue of the goddess on the altar.
5. Return to Angel Lyceum and talk to the Magic Professor.
6. Tell Felle about what you found out.

filas.intro: Frost Roses grow in the depths of the Radiant Cave. Miss Medley works at the floral boutique and has received an order for a bridal bouquet. She is thinking of using Frost Roses to make the bouquet and hopes that you will help her get some.
pasos: 1. Search Polar Snowmen for: /c$9%26451%/c*/ 99 Frost Roses.
2. Bring the Frost Roses back to Medley.
3. Get wrapping paper from Penguin Chief Flippa.
4. Give the wrapping paper to Medley.
5. Give the bouquet to Mitchian.

filas.intro: Once every few years, the Kingdom of Frost Mirror holds a trial to select new priests. But head priest Vorina has no time to test the content, and hence would like to find an adventurer to do it.
pasos:
1. Help test the content of the trial:

Defeat /c$9%26453%/c*/ 200 Seaweed Sundaes.
2. Tell Vorina the test results.

3. Help test the content of the trial:

Search Volanka Bigfoot for a Medal of Strength.
4. Tell Vorina the test results.

filas.intro: Once every few years, the Kingdom of Frost Mirror holds a trial to select new priests. Head priest Tia would like you to help test the content and see if it's too difficult.
pasos: 1. Listen to Tia's riddle and guess which monster it refers to. Then find it and defeat it.
2. Report back to Tia.
3. Search Swimmer Mice for a Chain Of Intelligence.
4. Bring the Chain Of Intelligence back to Tia.
5. Answer Tia's three questions.

filas.intro: Once every few years, the Kingdom of Frost Mirror holds a trial to select new priests. Head priest Atklos would like you to help test the content, to see if a trial participant would understand the meaning of bravery after going through the trial.
pasos: 1. Challenge Card Captain Aito to a fight and get the  Ring Of Bravery.
2. Bring the Ring Of Bravery to Atklos.
3. Before the Fairy Glow disappears, defeat  /c$9%26458%/c* / 200 Basket Flowers. You must not die in the process.
4. Report back to Atklos.

filas.intro: After the Mirror Of Truth was shattered, Gerda's friend, Kai, was taken away by Frost Queen Natisse. He's been missing since then. Gerda hopes that you can help find him.
pasos: 1. Find Kai at the Silver Wing Cable Car Station.
2. Find Gerda and tell her about Kai's situation.

1. Bring these things to Kai to test his reaction to them:

Search the Grape Sundaes of Subzero Market to get: /c$9%26459%/c*/ 200 Flat Pebbles

Search the heads of Jadeite Imps in Subzero Market to get: /c$9%26460%/c*/ 1 Snowflake Bloom.
4. Bring the Flat Pebbles and the Snowflake Bloom to Kai.
5. Tell Gerda about Kai.
6. Search the Icy Xanatis of Subzero Market to get the Blue Crystal Necklace.
7. Bring the Blue Crystal Necklace to Kai.
8. Bring the Rainbow Quartz Ring to Gerda.

filas.intro: The tributary to Iceberg Lake has been polluted, and hence a lot of animals have fallen ill. Blue Lil' Puri hopes that someone can help keep the monsters away from the water source, to slow down the rate of pollution.
pasos:
1. In order to protect the water source of Iceberg Lake:

Defeat /c$9%26462%/c*/ 100 Goldbrick Card Soldiers

Defeat /c$9%26463%/c*/ 100 Snowland Bigfoots

Defeat /c$9%26464%/c*/ 100 Green Ice Ferrets
2. Report back to Blue Lil' Puri.
3. Get the Sunken Crystal from General Hardt's body.
4. Find a good spot on the shores of Iceberg Lake to throw the Sunken Crystal into the lake.
5. Report back to Blue Lil' Puri.

filas.intro: The Kingdom of Frost Mirror has seven legends. One of them claims that if you pick a green needleleaf that just sprouted at the break of dawn, you will get one day of good luck. Jandy hopes that you will help her get one.
pasos: 1. Search the Harp Lambs for a green needleleaf.
2. Give the green needleleaf to Jandy.

filas.intro: Basket Grass Sap is really dangerous to insects, but to Pamela, it is a truly precious beauty essence. She wishes to harvest a large amount of it for cosmetic purposes.
pasos:
1. Search Dry Basket Grass to get: 

Basket Grass Sap: /c$9%26467%/c*/ 100 bottles
2. Give the Basket Grass Sap to Pamela.

filas.intro: It's nearly time for the Kingdom of Frost Mirror's annual Ice Floating Contest. Riki wants an adventurer to get the legendary Silvery Ice Shard so that her child will be able to win the contest.
pasos: 1. Search Evil Faeries for a Silvery Ice Shard.
2. Give the Silvery Ice Shard to Riki.

filas.intro: Sonya, Sona and Sonry are triplets. While everybody else is worrying about worldly problems, they are happily playing hide and seek. Sonya wants you to help her find her sisters who are hiding.
pasos:
1. Find the two sisters:

Talk to Sona: c$9%26469%/c*/ 1

Talk to Sonry: /c$9%26470%/c*/ 1
2. Tell Sonya where her sisters are hiding.

filas.intro: The legendary Virtuolux blooms represent the goddess. They can free the dead from their pain and sooth the hearts of those still living. Alician wants you to get him some Virtuolux Blooms to offer to his wife who has passed away.
pasos:
1. Search the Crystal Core Fairies for: 

Virtuolux Blooms: /c$9%26471%/c*/ 50
2. Give the Virtuolux Blooms to Alician.

filas.intro: The wealthy merchant Alberto, from Bazto Kingdom, wants to collect the softest, lightest Polar Hide to make knitting wool that can be used for a high quality top. He plans to use it himself, and perhaps to sell some for a huge profit as well!
pasos:
1. Defeat Wooly Hat Snowballs to get: 

Polar Hide: /c$9%26472%/c*/ 100 pieces
2. Bring the Polar Hides back to Alberto for a handsome reward.

filas.intro: Of the 7 legends, the Fantasia Runes contains enough power to create energy crystals to run cable cars. As most of the energy crystals have been destroyed by the monsters, a large amount of Fantasia Runes is needed to create more energy crystals to allow the cable cars to operate again.
pasos: 1. From the body of the Crystal Defender collect: Fantasia Runes: /c$9%26473%/c*/ 100.
2. Return to the Cable Car Technician for your reward.

filas.intro: The court artist of the Kingdom of Frost Mirror Ashev is working on a glimmering and colorful crystal window pane but he needs someone to collect the remaining materials to complete this exquisite piece of art.
pasos: 1. Bring Ashev the material that you have collected: From the Icicle Soldiers: Color Crystals/c$9%26474%/c*/ 50. From the Prism Soldiers: Transparent Crystals/c$9%26475%/c*/ 50.
2. Bring the material back to Ashev.

filas.intro: Michelle's child is sick and she hopes that she can collect the legendary Windblown Speck. It is said that the moment the Windblown Speck is added to the patient's medication, the patient will recover rapidly. You need to help this mother out at once!
pasos: 1. Recover the Windblown Speck off of the Ghost Assassin.
2. Quickly return the Windblown Speck to Michelle.

filas.intro: Recently the pollution of the lake has gotten worse. The newly-appointed priest Pluma had discovered the source of pollution to be a group of monsters frolicking in the lake. Hopefully an adventurer would come and off help to get rid of the monstersand preserve the purity of the lake.
pasos: 1. Fight off the monsters frolicking in the lake: Chase off the Special Swimmer Mice:  /c$9%26477%/c*/ 50. Chase off the Penguin Supervisors: /c$9%26478%/c*/ 50.
2. Report to Pluma to receive the reward.

filas.intro: From the 7 legends, Ceylan is the goddess known to bring snow to the land. As a result, the people present sundaes as a form of offering during her festival. The Ritual Priest hope that an adventurer will offer help to collect the sundaes so that the festival may proceed on time.
pasos: 1. Collect a large amount of Sundae: Blueberry Sundae: /c$9%26479%/c*/ 50. Grape Sundae: /c$9%26480%/c*/ 50.
2. Report to the Ritual Priest to receive the reward.

filas.intro: There is nothing Noddy the Clown can smile about with this problem. The Fantasia Masks that he is planning to sell at the Festival of Ceylan had been stolen by monsters. If nobody is going to help him out with this, his livelihood will be affected!
pasos: 1. From the body of the Jadeite Imps collect: /c$9%26481%/c*/ 100 Fantasia Masks.
2. Bring the mask back to Noddy the Clown.

filas.intro: The last of the 7 legends of the Kingdom of Frost Mirror mentions that as long as Earthly Crystals are added, it will ensure a good harvest of crops. Zyna sells these crystals but her Suicide Bomber Mice have all escaped. Thus, she is looking for somebody to help her collect the crystals.
pasos: 1. Collect from the claws of Suicide Bomber Mouse: Earthy Crystals/c$9%26482%/c*/ 50.
2. Bring the Earthly Crystals back to Zyna.

filas.intro: Seeing that the cable cars had been damaged, the Cable Car Master have no choice but to come out of retirement. During his repairs, the Cable Car Master have encountered monsters who hinder and disrupts his job. If there is anyone out there who is willing to help him out, he will be sure to reward them well.
pasos: 1. Ensure the safety of the Cable Car Master: Prevent /c$9%26483%/c*/ 50 Ruddy Ice Ferret from approaching. Prevent /c$9%26484%/c*/ 50 Green Ice Ferret from approaching.
2. Report to the Cable Car Master and receive your reward.

filas.intro: 魔の厨房をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「魔の厨房」で溶岩魔神モ\n  ートンを倒す。
2.「魔の厨房」でベシップを\n  倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: デビルガレットをクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「デビルガレット」で岩霸\n  王レガットを倒す。
2.「デビルガレット」で暴食\n  のベシップを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 忘却の場所をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「忘却の場所」で赤いフィ\n  ーゲル試作機を倒す。
2.「忘却の場所」でフィーゲ\n  ル01を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 邪霊船をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「邪霊船」でマーモンを倒\n  す。
2.「邪霊船」でセルンを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 無限の塔をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「無限の塔」でイヘリを倒す。
2.「無限の塔」で夢魔ザント\n  マンを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 天空聖域をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「天空聖域」でベリエルを\n  倒す。
2.「天空聖域」でグリフォン\n  ナイトを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 蛇神の閨をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「蛇神の閨」で蠍大帝アー\n  サーを倒す。
2.「蛇神の閨」でリウェイタ\n  ンを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: ボッティ神殿をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「ボッティ神殿」で血蹄マ\n  ノンを倒す。
2.「ボッティ神殿」でリリス\n  を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: ポーカー城をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「ポーカー城」でディーチ\n  を倒す。
2.「ポーカー城」でゴートラ\n  ンを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 恐竜コロシアムをクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「恐竜コロシアム」でカタ\n  ストロフィーを倒す。
2.「恐竜コロシアム」で暴龍\n  皇帝レックスを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 失われた密室をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「失われた密室」で砂嵐皇\n  后グリベラを倒す。
2.「失われた密室」でツタン\n  ニャアメンを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 彩鳳皇宮をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「彩鳳皇宮」で行天宮グラ\n  ッジを倒す。
2.「彩鳳皇宮」で女帝蜘蛛白\n  麗妖を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 氷獄の城をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「氷獄の城」で氷龍王シグ\n リムを倒す。\n
2.「氷獄の城」で氷晶女王ナ\n ティスを倒す。\n
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 隠遁洞付近でモンスターと戦ってレベルを86にしよう。\n
pasos: レベル86になったらLv85冒険者に報告しよう

filas.intro: 滝の野営地付近でモンスターと戦ってレベルを91にしよう。\n
pasos: レベル91になったらLv90冒険者に報告しよう

filas.intro: 隠遁洞付近でモンスターと戦ってレベルを96にしよう。\n
pasos: レベル96になったらLv95冒険者に報告しよう

filas.intro: 半獣人村付近でモンスターと戦ってレベルを101にしよう。\n
pasos: レベル101になったらLv101冒険者に報告しよう

filas.intro: 戦艦ムーノをクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「戦艦ムーノ」でゼソンナイトを倒す。
2.「戦艦ムーノ」で異星種王ｱｲﾘｱﾝﾇを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 桜花城をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「桜花城」で夢幻の妖狐タマモを倒す。
2.「桜花城」で雷鳴の阿修羅王を倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 皇蜂の秘巣をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「皇蜂の秘巣」でギガコブ・レインを倒す。
2.「皇蜂の秘巣」で女王蜂・ミストを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro:
A cop has arrived from one of the valleys in the west. 
 He's searching the four main cities for brave warriors 
 to help save his hometown, which has been embroiled 
 in a battle with extra-terrestial forces. 
 We must save Eden from the aliens!
pasos: 1. Bring the Recruitment Notice to Steam Town\n and look for Carios.
2. Look for Captain Weldon at Goldhill. \n Ask him if he needs any help.
3. Officer: \n Eliminate Petal Spheres: /c$9%28031%/c*/ 100 \n Eliminate Dazed Cacti: /c$9%28032%/c*/ 100
4. Tell Carios about the situation at Goldhill.
5. Investigate Withervine Odifal to see\n if there's anything strange about him.
6. Report to Carios.

filas.intro: To help lessen the severity of the injuries the cops are getting, \n Carios wants you to go to the Yeeha Bar to consult an experienced magic caster. \n He wants to find out if there's a way to dispel the enemy's magical buffs.
pasos: 1. Bring the Magic Intensifer to the Yeeha Bar \n and talk to Nolance.

2. Find Notti Cacti and Blue Robodogs for 
 the stuff that Nolance wants: 
 Research Components: /c$9%28034%/c*/ 100 
 Research Notes: /c$9%28035%/c*/ 100
3. Pass the Research Components and the Research Notes\n to Nolance.
4. Test the Anti-Intensifier: \n Droplet Dolls: /c$9%28036%/c*/ 100 \n Walking Beer Barrels: /c$9%28037%/c*/ 100
5. Tell Nolance about the test results.
6. Talk to Nolance 30 minutes later \n to get the Official Anti-Intensifier.
7. Give the Anti-Intensifier to Iradox.

filas.intro:
After getting the Anti-Intensifier, 
 Iradox would like you to help replenish the food supplies, 
 so that the others will have energy to keep on fighting. 
 And then he discovers something important…
pasos:
Collect the following materials from Brown Shoe Detectives, Eagle Eye Shooters
 and Mageflame Elders: 

Wild Meat: /c$9%28039%/c*/ 50 

Frosted Bones: /c$9%28040%/c*/ 50 

Pasaya Leaves: /c$9%28041%/c*/ 50
2. Give the ingredients to the Wild Game Chef.
3. Talk to the Wild Game Chef 10 minutes later \n to get Bronco Soup.
