4. Give the Bronco Soup and Mystery Chip\n to Iradox.

filas.intro: Iradox wants you to go to the Desolate Ruins \n to ask Hooke about the Mystery Chip. \n He might know something.
pasos: 1. Take the Mystery Chip to the Desolate Ruins \n and talk to Hooke.
2. Get the Chip Reader from Armaphage Dogs.
3. Give the Chip Reader to Hooke.

4. Collect the required materials from Pink Turbo Cannons
 and Deep Sea Octomen:

Lazias: /c$9%28045%/c*/ 100

Raitings: /c$9%28046%/c*/ 100
5. Pass the materials over to Hooke.
6. Tell Iradox about the contents of the Chip.

filas.intro:
The Chip's contents are just what we need to save Eden!
 Iradox wants you to go to the Forbidden Sector
 and ask Dixley about the Source Star
 and the [Starcore]. We need to figure out a way to find the [Starcore]
 and destroy it.
pasos: 1. Look for Dixley in the Forbidden Sector.
2. Look for Kreldo in the Desolate Ruins\n to get the latest archaeological finds.

3. Help eliminate: 

Assault Barrels: /c$9%28047%/c*/ 100

Unholy Knights: /c$9%28048%/c*/ 100

Viridian Hounds: /c$9%28049%/c*/ 100
4. Once the threat is gone, talk to Kreldo\n to get the items that were dug up recently.
5. Report back to Dixley.

filas.intro: After passing the item over to Dixley, \n he asks you to look for Shala the researcher,\n and to ask him about the research progress.
pasos: 1. Find Shala and ask him about the research progress.

2. Search the Agysical Tunnel and the Sunset Valley for: 

Citrus Cannoneer's Chest A: /c$9%28051%/c*/ 50

Bony Soldier's Chest B: /c$9%28052%/c*/ 50

Graystone Sprout's Chest C: /c$9%28053%/c*/ 50

Lakeside Doll's Chest D: /c$9%28054%/c*/ 50
3. Give all the Chests to Shala.
4. Get a Spare Key from Jaral.

5. Drive away the aliens surrounding the office:\n
Stealth Searchers: /c$9%28055%/c*/ 200\n
One-eyed Trackers: /c$9%28056%/c*/ 200
6. Report to Jaral.
7. Give the Spare Key to Shala.

filas.intro:
Shala says that his sister,Shada, is in charge
 of all the research on the Source Star. 
He wants you to go ask her if there's a way to
 destroy the [Starcore].
pasos: 1. Ask Shada if there is a way to destroy\n the [Starcore].

2. Find the following items:

Combateer Paroti's Life Core: /c$9%28058%/c*/ 1

Royal Dalwa's Life Core: /c$9%28059%/c*/ 1

Commander Taiter's Life Core: /c$9%28060%/c*/ 1
3. Give the Life Cores to Shada.

4. Help eliminate: 

Dual Axemen: /c$9%28061%/c*/ 100

Falconia Thieves: /c$9%28062%/c*/ 100

One-eyed Bandits: /c$9%28063%/c*/ 100
5. Report to Shada.

filas.intro:
Shada has crafted a nuclear device 
that can destroy the [Starcore]. 
But when she went to look for Shala, she discovered that
 someone had stolen both the Source Star and the [Starcore]!
 The Source Star's activation count-down has already started,
, and time is of the essence!
 Go get it back now!
pasos: 1. Get the real [Starcore] from Shala.

2. Interrogate:\n
Vampy Flowers: /c$9%28064%/c*/ 200
3. Defeat ET Queen Aylena\n and get both the [Starcore] and the Source Star back.
4. Place the [Starcore] inside the Nuclear Device.
5. Report to Shada.
6. Report to Archangel Michael.

filas.intro:
Experienced miner Cavando has mined
 some rare Crystal Gold Ore.
 But it has been stolen and he wants you to help him get it back,
 and then deliver it to someone very important to him.
pasos: 1. Get the Crystal Gold Ore from the Brown Treemen.
2. Take the Crystal Gold Ore to Steam Towm\n and give it to Dorasha.
3. Take the Head Scarf and look for Cavando.

filas.intro:
Dorasha thinks that Cavando must be
 having a tough time working at the mine.
 She has decided to send him something to cheer him up.
 Help her deliver it!
pasos:
1. Collect fresh ingredients: 

Needlegrass: /c$9%28069%/c*/ 100 stalks

Meat: /c$9%28070%/c*/ 100 pieces

Flaming Alcohol: /c$9%28071%/c*/ 1 bottle
2. Pass the ingredients to Dorasha.
3. Get a Pocket-sized Barrel\n from the Red Woodman or Flametree Imp.
4. Give the Pocket-sized Barrel to Dorasha.
5. Take the Romantic Lunchbox to Cavando.

filas.intro:
Agysical Tunnel's Foreman Rice
 has discovered a new vein that yields
 rare ore. But he's run into a problem and
 he hopes that you can help him solve it.
pasos:
1. Help look for the stuff that the\n Crimson Rune Dogs stole:\n
Mining Journal Pages: /c$9%28074%/c*/ 200
2. Give the Mining Journal Pages to Rice.

3. Check the situation at the mine:\n
Talk to Jess: /c$9%28075%/c*/ 1 \n
Talk to Jeb: /c$9%28076%/c*/ 1
4. Report to Rice.
5. Give the letter to the mine owner Zodo.

filas.intro: Now that the mining has started on the secret vein,\n Zodo needs more manpower and resources. \n He hopes you can help.
pasos: 1. Give the Resource Request List to Mayat.

2. Help drive away the creatures that\n are interfering with Mayat's work:\n
Brown Shoe Detectives: /c$9%28079%/c*/ 100
3. Talk to Mayat.
4. Talk to Zodo.
5. Get the Manpower Request List from Rice.
6. Give the Manpower Request List to Zodo.

filas.intro: Mayat is gathering resources, but he's simply way too busy.\n Go help him out!
pasos: 1. Ask the secretary Zasha what's missing from the resources collected so far.

2. Help collect the following resources:

Defeat Woodsorrel Skaters to get Alien Metal: /c$9%28081%/c*/ 50 pieces

Dig up Red Dusty Clay: /c$9%28082%/c*/ 30 heaps

Defeat Beanie Sprouts to get Trans Nectar: /c$9%28083%/c*/ 50 vials

Defeat Purple Shoe Detectives to get Spoked Rocks: /c$9%28084%/c*/ 50

Defeat Lakeside Dolls to get Shiny Threads: /c$9%28085%/c*/ 50
3. Talk to Zasha.

4. Clear a safe path:\n
Defeat Mageflame Elders: /c$9%28086%/c*/ 100
5. Talk to Mayat.

filas.intro: Jones is always busy helping out the people in town.\n But now he needs some help himself!\n Why don't you go help this poor cowboy?
pasos: 1. Get Jones' pistol back from the Violet Shooter.
2. Return Jones' pistol back to him.

3. Get the following from Viridian Hounds:\n
Star Nutri Oil: /c$9%28088%/c*/ 50 vials
4. Give the Star Nutri Oil to Jones.

filas.intro: Now that you've helped Jones out, \n he thinks that you'd make an excellent cowboy.\n He asks if you're willing to take the cowboy test.
pasos: 1. Get a recommendation letter from the Mayor.
2.將推薦信交給亞克警長。

3. Get cowboy badges:

Bravery Badge: /c$9%28090%/c*/ 1

Heroic Badge: /c$9%28091%/c*/ 1

Carefree Badge: /c$9%28092%/c*/ 1
4. Give the badges to Sergeant Yahk.

5. Collect materials for the medal:\n
Fine Steel Flakes: /c$9%28093%/c*/ 50\n
Desert Crystals: /c$9%28094%/c*/ 50
6. Give the materials to Sergeant Yahk.

filas.intro: The Mayor heard that you've been through the test\n and that you're now a cowboy.\n He has a mission for you.
pasos:
1. Eliminate the aliens in the Yeeha Bar

Pinky Babes: /c$9%28095%/c*/ 100

Blue Barrel Cannons: /c$9%28096%/c*/ 100

Eliminate the aliens in the Agysical Tunnel

Fanged Pink Hound: /c$9%28097%/c*/ 100

Grassy Cannoneers: /c$9%28098%/c*/ 100
2. Report to the Mayor.
3. Talk to Heindal at the Desolate Ruins.

4. Help collect research materials: \n
Energy Blocks: /c$9%28099%/c*/ 100\n
Spikey Stems: /c$9%28100%/c*/ 100
5. Give the materials to Heindal.
6. Hand the Research Report over to Paulika\n in the Forbidden Sector.

filas.intro:
ETT is a well known archaeologist.
 He is extremely interested in the spaceship that crashed here a thousand
 years ago and hopes that he can have a sharing session
 with the researchers in the Forbidden Sector.
pasos: 1. Give the Introductory Letter to Head Ramoya\n at the Forbidden Sector.
2. Pass the message to ETT.

3. Help collect research materials: 

Go to the Sunset Valley to get

Rust Feathers: /c$9%28103%/c*/ 200

Go to the Desolate Ruins to get

Pure Aegian: /c$9%28104%/c*/ 200

Go to the Forbidden Sector to get

Gamma Rocks: /c$9%28105%/c*/ 200
4. Give the research materials to ETT.
5. Get the Research Report from ETT one hour later.
6. Give the Research Report to Ramoya.
7. Hand the Temporary Exchange Pass over to ETT.

filas.intro: The Desolate Ruins is over-run with aliens and monsters,\n so when Yasha was told to go there to collect research samples,\n he got really scared and is looking for help!
pasos:
1. Collect the following before you run out of power:\n
Defeat Blue Range Cannons\n to get Laser Blasters: /c$9%28108%/c*/ 200
2. Give the Laser Blasters to Yasha.
3. Get the Planetary Energy Source from the\n Brilliant Nawalya.
4. Give the Planetary Energy Source to Yasha.
5. Give the Research Sample Box to Dekosta\n in the Forbidden Sector.

filas.intro:
Researcher Dekosta of the Forbidden Sector
 wants to build a powerful robot to aid in the battle
 against the aliens in order to help save his comrades.
 He wants your help.
pasos: 1. Go to Goldhill and talk to Camille\n to get the Dense Iron Dekosta ordered.
2. Give the Dense Iron to Dekosta.

3. Collect the required materials:\n
Exo Liquid: /c$9%28112%/c*/ 200 vials\n
Liquefied Tiron: /c$9%28113%/c*/ 200
4. Give the Exo Liquid and Liquefied Tiron\n to Dekosta.
5. Get the Lasting Battery from\n Commander Taiter.
6. Give the Lasting Battery to Dekosta.
7. Defeat the prototype robot.
8. Talk to Dekosta for a reward.

filas.intro:
Aliens have invaded Goldhill! 
On Potterson's very first day of work at the mine,
 his pickaxe was snatched away by an Orange Leafy Sphere.
 Potterson might very well lose his job if you don't get it back!
pasos: 1. Get the Pickaxe from the Orange Leafy Sphere.
2. Give the Pickaxe to Potterson.

filas.intro:
Every weekend, the people at Goldhill
 hold a hotpot gathering. But miner Reio
 has noticed intruders at the party this time.
 He hopes that you can drive them away so that the party can go on.
pasos:
1. Drive away the following:\n
Chainsaw Cacti: /c$9%28117%/c*/ 100
2. Talk to Reio.

filas.intro:
There is a legend in Steam Town. It says that
 if you have a Crimson Crystal with you when you confess
 your love, your crush will accept you. Nashian
 wants someone to help her find a Crimson Crystal.
pasos: 1. Get a Crimson Crystal from the Tomato Gator.
2. Give the Crimson Crystal to Nashian.

filas.intro:
The Flax Thorns of the desert are resistant to windblown sand,
 and are fairly tough, which makes them good rope material.
 Harriot wants you to help him collect some of these thorns,
 so that he can make a hardy rope for the next cowboy contest.
pasos:
1. Defeat Purple Shoe Investigators to get: \n
Flax Thorns: /c$9%28127%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Flax Thorns to Harriot.

filas.intro:
The annual Beer Festival has begun. 
Bartender Mozzie is having a headache arranging everything.
 He would like someone to help him collect Agisand Flowers
 and Starwater Crystals to give away as prizes during the festival.
pasos:
1. Help collect the following Beer Festival prizes:

Defeat Dessicated Singers for

Agisand Flowers: /c$9%28128%/c*/ 50

Defeat Droplet Dolls to get

Starwater Crystals: /c$9%28129%/c*/ 50
2. Give the prizes to Mozzie.

filas.intro:
Barrels of beer have been going missing from the cellar
 of the Yeeha Bar. Investigations have revealed that the culprits are
 none other than Walking Beer Barrels. Mirror hopes you can teach them a lesson
 and prevent the bar from suffering huge losses.
pasos:
1. Teach the Beer Barrels a lesson:\n
Walking Beer Barrels: /c$9%28130%/c*/ 100
2. Talk to Mirror to get your reward.

filas.intro: A large group of aliens are wrecking havoc in the Agysical Tunnel.\n Luki hopes that you can help get rid of these intruders,\n so that the miners can work in peace.
pasos:
1. Eliminate the intruders:\n
Get rid of the Citrus Cannoneers: /c$9%28131%/c*/ 100
2. Talk to Luki to get your reward.

filas.intro:
Avan always carries his family photos around with him,
 but he accidentally dropped the photo of his newborn son
 and a Raging Bignonia ran off with it. Avan is hoping that
 someone will help him get it back!
pasos: 1. Get Avan's family photo back from the\n Raging Bignonia.
2. Give the photograph back to Avan.

filas.intro: Runego brought his three brothers to Sunset Valley to play.\n But when it was time to go home for dinner, all three boys had vanished.\n He hopes that you'll help find them.
pasos:
1. Find the playful brothers:

Talk to Runeson: /c$9%28134%/c*/ 1

Talk to Runet: /c$9%28134%/c*/ 1

Talk to Runek: /c$9%28135%/c*/ 1
2. Talk to Runego.

filas.intro:
The sandstorms are getting worse. Nilo
 has discovered that the Purple Shoe Detectives and Violet Shooters are to blame.
 He's so angry, he's offering a reward for anyone willing to drive these intruders
 away.
pasos:
1. Drive away the valley intruders:\n
Purple Shoe Detectives: /c$9%28136%/c*/ 50\n
Violet Shooters: /c$9%28137%/c*/ 50
2. Talk to Nilo to get your reward.

filas.intro:
Moresha is a wandering artist from a far-away kingdom.
 She found some unique art materials in the Desolate Ruins,
 and would like someone's help to collect them,
 so that she can craft a new piece of art.
pasos:
1. Help collect the art materials:\n
Starsteel Boards: /c$9%28138%/c*/ 50\n
Space Glass: /c$9%28139%/c*/ 50 sheets
2. Give the materials to Moresha.

filas.intro:
Mushroom And Potato Delight is one of the Wild Game Chef's
 creations. The food that Perry ordered is finally ready.
 But just as he was going home, a bunch of Redclaw Aliens
 snatched his food away. Help him get it back!
pasos:
1. Search Redclaw Aliens to find:\n
/c$9%28140%/c*/ 100 Mushroom and Potato Delights.
2. Give the food back to Perry.

filas.intro:
Researcher Imuelia of the Forbidden Sector thinks that
 the Fiery Dual-Wielders have really powerful weapons.
 If someone could help get him some for analysis,
 he might be able to make an even more powerful weapon.
pasos:
1. Search Fiery Dual-Wielders for:\n
Planetary Weapons: /c$9%28141%/c*/ 50
2. Give the Planetary Weapons to Imuelia.

filas.intro: The aliens keep attacking, so Terry just can't\n concentrate on his research. He's willing to give a reward\n to anyone who can drive the aliens away.
pasos:
1. Eliminate:\n
Ruby Shooters: /c$9%28142%/c*/ 50\n
One-eyed Trackers: /c$9%28143%/c*/ 50
2. Talk to Terry to get your reward.

filas.intro: 東の国の事件を調べているお\nかしの調査員を訪ねてみよう
pasos: 1.ふわふわポートのおかしの\n調査員に話しかける。
2.千仏洞のおかしの調査員に\n話しかける。

3.8時間後に千仏洞のおかし
の調査員に話しかける。
※ログアウト中は時間のカウ
ントが進みません。
4.蝶の花園のおかしの調査員\nに話しかける。
5.彩鳳皇宮で肉まんを入手し\n蝶の花園のおかしの調査員に\n報告する。肉まん：/c$9%28231%/c*/ 1
6.エンジェル学園のダカハー\nに報告する

filas.intro:
納涼！？夏祭りイベントの宣伝
の為、作成したチラシを各国の
担当者に渡して欲しいとお願い
された！
pasos:
1.エンジェル学園に居る

　「キョンちゃん」にチラシ

　を届ける

filas.intro:
夏祭りの何か？に使う材料を確
保して欲しいと頼まれた！
会場の外周に居る「お祭りマァン」
を倒して、材料を確保しよう！
pasos:
1.「古代の戦場」に居る

　「お祭りマァン」を倒して

　「謎の粘液」/c$9%28272%/c*/ 10 個を集めよう!
2.おっちゃんに報告しよう。

filas.intro: 夏祭りゲーム。\n４姉妹を順番に回って、\nスタンプを集めよう！
pasos: 2.スタンプを集めきった！\n\n　長女のところへもどろう！

filas.intro: 東の国の事件を調べているお\nかしの調査員を訪ねてみよう
pasos: 1.翠艶河畔の血締一族に話し\nかける
2.桃の小道の血締一族に話し\nかける。

3.8時間後に桃の小道の血締
一族に話しかける。
※ログアウト中は時間のカウ
ントが進みません。
4.繁華古城の血締一族\nに話しかける。
5.蝶の花園で秘薬を入手し\n繁華古城の血締一族に報告\nする。秘薬/c$9%28423%/c*/ 1
6.血締マノンに薬を渡す

filas.intro:
A spaceship has descended from the skies,
 and taken the livestock that the farmers rely on for a living.
 Rumours say that the poor animals are being experimented on.
 We must save them!
pasos: 1. Investigate the Mundo Warship.

2. The captured animals have all been hideously mutilated!

You must defeat and save: 

/c$9%28431%/c* /30 animals inside the robotic dogs

/c$9%28432%/c* /30 animals inside the robotic cats
3. Bring the rescued animals back to Davon\n in Steam Town.
4. Accept Davon's gift of gratitude.

filas.intro: The aliens have far superior weapons\n and they have pushed us to the limit… Our only chance\n is to find a way to attack their armory!
pasos:
1. Destroy the alien weapons. 

Charge into the Mundo Warship and defeat:

/c$9%28433%/c* /35 Carnivorous Flora Type A

/c$9%28434%/c* /35 Titanium Brains
2. Once the mission is accomplished, return to the Yeeha Bar\n and talk to Matteson.
3. Get your reward from Matteson.

filas.intro: Attempting risky missions in a dangerous place\n is something only the extremely brave would do.\n Only someone that brave can help the understaffed cops now!
pasos:
1. The aliens keep wrecking havoc. We need to
 launch a vicious attack to put a stop to them:

Defeat /c$9%28435%/c* /50 Saturn Visitors

Defeat /c$9%28436%/c* /50 Mars Visitors
2. Once the mission is accomplished, return to the Forbidden Sector\n and talk to Daniel.
3. Talk to Daniel at the Forbidden Sector again.

filas.intro:
Alien technology is way more advanced than
 the technology on Eden. A lot of scientists are
 interested in finding out more. Will forbidden experiments
 revamp our knowledge systems, or will they
 end in tragedy?
pasos:
1. Enter the right wing of the Mundo Warship\n and retrieve the following from the Culture Trough:\n
Experimental Body: /c$9%28437%/c* /1
2. Carefully bring the Experimental Body back to\n the Yeeha Bar and give it to Clarke.
3. Once you've finished your mission, talk to Clarke to get your reward.

filas.intro:
Nelbo and his father were captured
 by the aliens and subjected to
 the most horrific experiments and torture.
 Who will go avenge them?
pasos: 1. Enter the left wing of the Mundo Warship,\n and defeat the cruel Jazone Knight!
2. Tell Nelbo at Goldhill that\n you have avenged them.

filas.intro:
A human adventurer from the Aurora clan
 has been captured by the aliens.
 They have performed surgery on him to make him look like a cat.
 Do you think you can help him?
pasos: 1. Destroy the Mech Brain Galin in the right wing\n maintenance room of the Mundo Warship!
2. Tell Vanson that the Mech Brain has\n been destroyed.

filas.intro:
The legendary sacred lands have been
 desecrated by aliens nesting on the land.
 The townsfolk and the cops are overpowered and lack the will to survive…
 The people desperately need heroes to save them!
pasos: 1. Head into the inner chambers of the Mundo Warship and\n destroy the ET Queen Aylena!
2. After the battle, return to Steam Town and\n report to Elder Dasent.

filas.intro: 秘薬の効果で、暴走している\n血締一族を正気に戻そう
pasos: 1.東妖皇宮マップの血締一族\nを正気に戻す。/c$9%28760%/c*/ 50人
2.おかしの調査員に報告する

filas.intro: 銀雪観光スタンプラリー！\nプリモ4姉弟を順番に回って、\nスタンプを集めよう！
pasos: 2.スタンプを集めきった！\n\n　観光大使のところへもどろう！

filas.intro: Young Yoi has been ordered to retrieve some valuable Gem Ore from the Pharaoh Village. On the way back, the cart fell over and the Withered Maneaters, that have been eyeing the travellers, picked up the Gem Ore pieces and ran away. Poor Yoi is hoping that someone will help him recover the ore.
pasos:
1. Defeat Withered Maneaters to recover:
Gem Ore: /c$9%30396%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Gem Ore to Yoi to get your reward.

filas.intro: Artios the wandering bard was taking a nap under the tree in the summery heat, and when he woke up, he realised that his Fiddlewood Flute was gone! He hopes that someone will follow the footprints left behind by the thief and get his flute back.
pasos: 1. Get the Fiddlewood Flute back from the Glowlake Kappa.
2. Give the Fiddlewood Flute to Artios.

filas.intro: The boutique owner Mayna has designed a beautiful Kimono for the annual celebrations. She discovers, however, that there isn't enough of the right material at hand. Mayna hopes that someone can help her collect materials so that she can finish the Kimono in time for the celebrations!
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Bunsen Sprites:
Rainbow Thread: /c$9%30398%/c*/ 100 strands
2. Give the Rainbow Thread to Mayna.

filas.intro: Edo was badly damaged by the war and repairworks are being carried out all over the city. Engineer Kashter has noted that a large amount of materials is required to complete the repairs, and hopes that someone will help collect the relevant materials.
pasos:
1. Defeat Redrune Vase Imps to collect:
Redrune Steel: /c$9%30399%/c*/ 100 pieces
2. Give the construction materials to Kashter.

filas.intro: The latest dish created by the talented chef, Cooke, has been so well received at the Joy Festival that he is rapidly running out of ingredients. Cooke hopes that someone can help him get more ingredients so that everyone can have a portion!
pasos:
1. Collect the following ingredients:
Chives: /c$9%30400%/c*/ 50
Fresh Prawns: /c$9%30401%/c*/ 50
2. Give the ingredients to Cooke to get your reward.

filas.intro: The lively atmosphere of the celebrations has attracted a bunch of trouble-making creatures. While stall owners are distracted by the crowds of customers, the creatures sneak off with various items and prizes. Stall owner Kipra wishes that someone would just chase these troublemakers away, so that he can run his business in peace.
pasos:
1. Chase away the following troublemakers:
Strawberry Pongs: /c$9%30402%/c*/ 50
Black Kappa Soldiers: /c$9%30403%/c*/ 50
2. Talk to Kipra to get your reward.

filas.intro: Since the weather was so lovely, Chii decided to bring her younger siblings out for a stroll in the Sakura Valley. But the minute they got there, before Chii could warn them to watch out, they'd run off! Chii hopes that someone can go warn them that they must get back to the valley entrance before sunset.
pasos:
1. Talk to the playful siblings:
Talk to Meii: /c$9%30404%/c*/ 1
Talk to Wane: /c$9%30405%/c*/ 1
Talk to Lanny: /c$9%30406%/c*/ 1
2. Talk to Chii again.

filas.intro: Legend says that there is a Sakura Spirit sleeping in the Sakura Valley. Every year during sakura season, the spirit will awaken and scatter petals filled with the power of love.  Nettie hopes that someone will help her collect these petals so that she can give them to her boyfriend.
pasos:
1. Search Toxic Earth Sprites to collect:
Magical Petals: /c$9%30407%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Magical Petals to Nettie.

filas.intro: It's great to soak in a hot spring during cold weather. But a bunch of monkeys have barged into the place and they're scaring the customers away. The boss hopes that someone will help chase these monkeys away, or his business will be ruined!
pasos:
1. Defeat Mossy Monkeys to collect:
Monkey Tails: /c$9%30408%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Monkey Tails to Spada.

filas.intro: The Hot Spring Pavilion has obtained some local Samara, which are healthy and nutritious. Unfortunately, a bunch of Tub Monkeys appear to have broken into the storage area and eaten half the yummy fruit. The landlady hopes that someone will stop these monkeys from munching on any more fruit.
pasos:
1. Get rid of the greedy monkeys:
Tub Monkeys: /c$9%30409%/c*/ 100
2. Talk to Zariya to get your reward.

filas.intro: The high priest said that the shrine's wishing board has been defaced with graffiti. An investigation has revealed that the culprits are monsters up to mischief and the high priest wants someone to help get rid of these pesky monsters.
pasos:
1. Get rid of the pesky monsters:
Ghostly Snails: /c$9%30410%/c*/ 50
Creepy Dolls: /c$9%30411%/c*/ 50
2. Talk to Pippa to get your reward.

filas.intro: Legend says that the Redrune Hound beside the shrine possesses a mysterious power. Its hide can be used to craft a protection charm that will shield you from harm. Lumia wishes that someone could help her get a piece of the hide, so that she can give her boyfriend a charm for his upcoming journey.
pasos: 1. Get a piece of Redrune Hide from the Redrune Hound.
2. Give the hide to Lumia.

filas.intro: Ninja Land is the secret hideout for various ninjas. There lie weapons discarded by ninjas over the years. Archaeologist Oska hopes that someone could help him collect weapon pieces from there so that he analyse them.
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Brown Draconans and Green Dracomums:
Claw Fragments: /c$9%30413%/c*/ 50
Blade Fragments: /c$9%30414%/c*/ 50
2. Give the pieces to Oska.

filas.intro: Legend says that an elderly ninja hid his secret manual somewhere in Ninja Land. Many ninjas have searched the place for this manual but all they've found are tattered scrolls. Khaos hopes that someone can help him collect these tattered scrolls in case the secret lies within them...
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Fuzzy Monkeys and Bluesea Monkeys:
Tattered Sky Scrolls: /c$9%30416%/c*/ 50
Tattered Earth Scrolls: /c$9%30417%/c*/ 50
2. Give the tattered scrolls to Khaos to get your reward.

filas.intro:
代表愛、勇氣以及希望的拉芙
妖精，在情人節前夕神聖降臨
天使學園，為了迎接這充滿粉
紅色氣息的美妙日子，她特地
將愛神的祝福煉化成拉芙蜜之
光，想要以此傳播到伊甸園大
陸的每個角落，小天使快來當
傳遞愛情的信使吧！
pasos:
1.將拉芙蜜之光傳送出去：
  與千佛石窟的拉芙專使對話：/c$9%30488%/c*/ 1 次。
  與雪球村的拉芙專使對話：/c$9%30489%/c*/ 1 次。
  與蒸氣小鎮的拉芙專使對話：/c$9%30490%/c*/ 1 次。
2.與拉芙妖精對話。

filas.intro: The Angel Raziel has suddenly appeared in the four main cities, bringing a petition for help from the long-lost Jade Tassel City. Warriors are needed to hold off the monsters attacking the city.
pasos: 1. Go to the Samara Woods and look for Onmyouji Skye.

2. Collect colored Magatama from the following creatures:
Withered Maneaters: /c$9%30751%/c* / 25 Red Magatama
Greencap Mushrooms:
/c$9%30752%/c* / 25 Blue Magatama
Grassy Hedgehogs: /c$9%30753%/c* / 25 Yellow Magatama
Prune Onigiri: /c$9%30754%/c* / 25 Green Magatama
Glowlake Kappa: /c$9%30755%/c* / 25 White Magatama
3. Give the Magatamas to Onmyouji Skye.

4. Defeat the Threeway Kappa: 
/c$9%30756%/c* / 75
5. Talk to Onmyouji Skye to get your reward.

filas.intro: Onmyouji Skye has received a message from Edo City. Apparently, monsters have been wrecking havoc in the city and he wants you to go find out the cause behind the disturbance.
pasos: 1. Go to Edo City and talk to Fuyuki.
2. Obtain a strange device from the Redrune Vase Imps.
3. Talk to Fuyuki again.

4. Find the remaining Strange Devices:
Bunsen Sprites: /c$9%30758%/c*/ 1 Strange Device
Jumpy Blue Brollies: /c$9%30759%/c* / 1 Strange Device
5. Talk to Fuyuki to get your reward.

filas.intro: It wasn't easy to get rid of the strange devices, and now there's more bad news. Monsters have been launching attacks at the Joy Festival and in the Sakura Valley. Fuyuki wants you to go help drive the monsters away.
pasos: 1. Talk to Kaine at the Joy Festival.

2. Defeat the following monsters:
Green Smilies: /c$9%30760%/c* / 100
Prawn Sushi: /c$9%30761%/c* / 100
Kitsune Boys: /c$9%30762%/c* / 100
3. Talk to Kaine.

4. Defeat these monsters:
Twin Candle Ghosts: /c$9%30763%/c* / 200
5. Find the survivors nearby to get your reward.

filas.intro: Nanako says that she saw a black shadow carrying something suspicious and talking to some monsters before slowly making its way into the depths of Sakura Valley…
pasos: 1. Just beat them up until they're willing to talk! Defeat Moss Sprites: /c$9%30764%/c* / 200
2. Take the missive to Onmyouji Skye.

3. Defeat the monsters guarding the Poison Brewer.
Orange Kitties: /c$9%30765%/c* / 100
Pink Kitties: /c$9%30766%/c* / 100
4. Get rid of the poison inside the Poison Brewer.
5. Talk to Onmyouji Skye.

filas.intro: Onmyouji Skye frowns and tells you that if you want to find out more, you'll have to go to the Fox Shrine to talk to the priestess called Moonless. If you can get her to trust you, you'll be able to find out why the Evil Lyceum wants this weapon.
pasos: 1. Talk to Priestess Moonless at the Fox Shrine.

2. Defeat the invading monsters:
Green Snails: /c$9%30767%/c* / 100
Creepy Dolls: /c$9%30768%/c* / 100
Redrune Hounds: /c$9%30769%/c* / 100
3. Report to Moonless.

4. Defeat the invading monsters:
Restless Accursed: /c$9%30770%/c* / 100
Accursed Damon: /c$9%30771%/c* / 1
5. Talk to Moonless to get your reward.

filas.intro: The Thunderspear has been the cause of many wars in the past. Moonless wishes to destroy the Thunderspear and end all the bloodshed. The deity probably left behind a way to destroy the spear when the spear was placed on mortal realms. Moonless hopes that you can help her find it.
pasos: 1. Find the words written on the back of the hidden tablet in the Hot Spring Pavilion.
2. Look for any strange markings on the Blueflame Pups.
3. Tell Moonless about what you discovered.

4. Examine the Tub Monkeys to find: /c$9%30773%/c* / 1 Red Marking
Examine the Fandance Foxes to find: /c$9%30774%/c* / 1 Green Marking
5. Talk to Moonless to get your reward.

filas.intro: After Moonless has deciphered the deity's message, she tells you that a supremely tough anvil and a powerful hammer have to be made for the purpose of destroying the Thunderspear. She suggests that you enter Ninja Land and ask the smith named Sakon if he can craft these items.
pasos: 1. Give the list to Sakon in Ninja Land.

2. Collect the materials for the anvil:
Thunderdrake Raimu: /c$9%30775%/c* / 1 Deco Belt
Green Dracomums:
/c$9%30776%/c*/200 Front Teeth
3. Give the materials to Sakon.

4. Collect the materials for the hammer:
Ghostly Sanosuke: /c$9%30777%/c* / 1 Sharp Talon
Kitty Thieves: /c$9%30778%/c*/200 Fur Coats
5. Ask Ukon to craft the hammer.

filas.intro: The anvil and the hammer are now ready, but the Thunderspear is protected by a layer of magic. After investigating, Ukon tells you that you'll have to collect Halos Wine, Tamamono Fur and King Ashuro's Relic in order to dispel the magic.
pasos: 1. Talk to Malfy at the Fox Shrine.

2. Collect the following items:
Defeat Killer Maids at the Fox Shrine to find:
/c$9%30779%/c* / 1 bottle of Halos Wine
Defeat Kitty Bandits in Ninja Land to find: 
/c$9%30780%/c* / 1 bunch of Tamamono Fur
Defeat Fanholder Foxes at the Hot Spring Pavilion to find:
/c$9%30781%/c* / 1 King Ashuro's Relic
3. Head towards the shadowy top lefthand corner of Ninja Land and destroy the Thunderspear there.
4. Take the ruined pieces of the weapon to Moonless.

filas.intro: The pharmacist's son, Aika, has been told to gather ingredients from the woods. But he's way too inexperienced to complete his task and hopes that someone will help him.
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Greencap Mushrooms:
Mushroom Caps: /C$9%30723%/C*/ 200
2. Give the Mushroom Caps to the pharmacist named Andoga in Edo City.
3. Give the list to Aika in the Samara Woods to get your reward.

filas.intro: Pharmacist Andoga thinks that his son must be tired out from working all day, so he wants to brew a nourishing concoction for Aika. It would be nice of you to lend Andoga a hand!
pasos:
1. Collect the ingredients for the Energizer Brew:
Lively Droplets: /C$9%30725%/C*/ 100
Lively Rice Grains: /C$9%30726%/C*/ 100
2. Give the ingredients to Andoga.
3. Get the Magical Vase from Phantasm Reian.
4. Give the Magical Vase to Andoga.
5. Give the Energizer Brew to Aika to get your reward.

filas.intro: Mimai is descended from General Tokko and she wishes that someone could help her find out more about the general as well as the things that took place here.
pasos: 1. Defeat /c$9%30782%/c*  / 200 Jumpy Blue Brollies to look for clues about the Scroll Of Records.
2. Defeat Centennial Storm to get the Scroll Of Records.
3. Give the Scroll Of Records to Mimai.

filas.intro: After reading the Scroll Of Records, Mimai now knows more about the general. And now she hopes that you can help her talk to the ninja elders to find out more about the agreement with Raziel that was made in the past.
pasos: 1. Look for Tsukiga.
2. Eliminate /c$9%30784%/c* / 200 Raging Wanderers.
3. Talk to Tsukiga to get the Agreement Records.
4. Look for Tokiya.

5. Search Redrune Hounds to find: 
/c$9%30785%/c* / 1 Agreement Scroll A
Search Killer Maids to find:
/c$9%30786%/c* / 1 Agreement Scroll B
6. Give the Agreement Records to Mimai.

filas.intro: History is about to repeat itself. The Agreement Records mention King Oni, Fox Spirit Tamamo and King Ashuro. Their minions might know more, so Mimai hopes that you could conduct a thorough investigation.
pasos:
1. Search the following monsters:
Get King Oni's Orders from:
/c$9%30787%/c* / 50 Tub Monkeys
Get Fox Spirit Tamamo's Missive from:
/c$9%30788%/c* / 50 Fanholder Foxes
Get King Ashuro's Letter from:
/c$9%30789%/c* / 50 Blueflame Pups
2. Give all the documents to Mimai.
3. Use the Lunar Mirror to investigate the memories left behind in Hot Spring Pavilion.
4. Tell Mimai about what the Lunar Mirror showed you.

filas.intro: Now that you have retrieved the ancient memories of King Oni, Fox Spirit Tamamo and King Ashuro, Mimai has one last request for you. She hopes that you can find out more about the entrance seal.
pasos: 1. Search Awkward Maids to find the Seal Document.
2. Give the document to Mimai.

3. Look for the following items mentioned in the document:
Defeat the Massive Duraga in Edo City to get: 
/c$9%30791%/c* / 1 Yellow Seal
Defeat the Monkey Lord Yoni at the Hot Springs Pavilion to get:
/c$9%30792%/c* / 1 Green Seal
Defeat the Hound Deity Sha at the Fox Shrine to get: /c$9%30793%/c* / 1 Red Seal
4. Talk to Mimai to get your reward.

filas.intro: Security Chief Anton has received news about a group of monsters that have suddenly appeared to the northeast. He hopes that someone will help him find out more about the current situation from the patrolmen in that area.
pasos: 1. Head northeast to talk to the patrolman named Shayan.

2. Eliminate the following:
Green Smilies: /C$9%30729%/C*/ 100
3. Talk to Shayan.

4. Eliminate the intruders:
Poison Prawn Sushi: /C$9%30730%/C*/ 100
5. Talk to Shayan.
6. Give the letter to Chief Anton.
7. Go to Sakura Valley and talk to Scout Nayo to get your reward.

filas.intro: Scout Nayo is injured and he's stuck in a monster-infected area. Go save him now!
pasos:
1. Get the following medicinal supplies:
Earth Essence: /C$9%30733%/C*/ 100
Bugtrap Leaves: /C$9%30734%/C*/ 100
2. Give the medicinal supplies to Scout Nayo.
3. Deliver the letter to the Supplies Officer Caito at the Joy Festival.
4. Bring the equipment to Scout Nayo to get your reward.

filas.intro: A thick mist has suddenly appeared and is filling up the valley. The monsters in the valley have suddenly gone berserk as well and biologist Baelor hopes that someone could hunt down some of those monsters so that he can analyze them.
pasos:
1. Hunt for the following research items:
Crandeer Hide: /C$9%30737%/C*/ 100 pieces
Kitty Tails: /C$9%30738%/C*/ 100
2. Give the items to Baelor.
3. Get the Bio Serum from Biologist Dano at the Fox Shrine.
4. Give the Bio Serum to Baelor.
5. Inform Dano of the test results.
6. Talk to Baelor to get your reward.

filas.intro: Lilu's boyfriend walked into Ninja Land ten days ago and hasn't been back. Lilu is really worried about him and hopes that someone will help her find him.
pasos: 1. Go to Ninja Land and look for Duga.

2. Get the following from Dark Jumpy Brollies:
Old Cotton: /C$9%30741%/C*/ 200 pieces
3. Give the cotton to Duga.
4. Obtain Dragonic Wood from Ghostly Sanosuke.
5. Give the Dragonic Wood to Duga.
6. Talk to Lilu to get your reward.

filas.intro: Tavi the adventurer asked his friend to go adventuring with him in Ninka Land. But he's been waiting all day and still hasn't seen any sign of his friend. Tavi is hoping that someone would go to Ninja Land to see if his friend is already there.
pasos: 1. Go to Ninja Land and look for Tanu.

2. Get the following from Unearthly Warriors:
Warrior Blade Pieces: /C$9%30744%/C*/ 200
3. Give the pieces to Tanu.
4. Get the gem from the Red General Fusho.
5. Give the gem to Tanu.
6. Talk to Tavi to get your reward.

filas.intro: Chihiko is trying to get someone to help her get some rare antlers. She needs them to treat her parents who have fallen ill. Unfortunately, the stuff can only be found deep within Jade Tassel City!
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Megantler Deer:
/c$9%30794%/c* / 50 Rare Antlers
2. Give the antlers to Chihiko.

filas.intro: The world famous sushi chef named Yondai wants to modify some palace cuisine to suit the masses. To do that, he needs someone to bring him some palace cuisine as well as the palace recipe book so that he can start experimenting!
pasos: 1. Go to Jade Tassel City and look for the box that contains the Palace Recipe Book.
2. Read the Palace Recipe Book carefully.

3. Collect the following from Minty Riceballs:
/c$9%30796%/c* / 50 Shiny Rice Grains
Collect the following from Tea Tako Sushi:
/c$9%30797%/c* / 50 lumps of Tako Stuffing
4. Give the ingredients to Yondai.

filas.intro: Miyuki's son hates to take baths and says that he'll only take a bath if a group of monkeys keep him company. Miyuki simply can't persuade him otherwise, so she has no choice but to get someone to help her some [trained] monkeys to keep him company.
pasos:
1. [Train] some monkeys:
/c$9%30798%/c* / 25 Hot Spring Monkeys
/c$9%30799%/c* / 25 Bigfist Monkeys
2. Bring the trained monkeys back to Miyuki.

filas.intro: Musashi is investigating something bizarre. His fiancee Yuko has been dreaming about a bell chiming every night, which prompted her to go to Jade Tassel City, and she went missing soon after. How is Jade Tassel City related to her disappearance?
pasos:
1. Find out more from the monsters:
Defeat /c$9%30800%/c* / 50 Soulcatcher Foxes.
2. Find Yuko inside the secret chamber.
3. Talk to Musashi to get your reward.

filas.intro: Onmyouji Kishi is looking for the Cat Spirit Takanohana that he's raised for many years. According to people who've escaped from Jade Tassel City, there is a cat spirit in the city called Takanohana. It might just be the one that Onmyouji Kishi is looking for.
pasos: 1. Defeat Takanohana and then talk to it.
2. Deliver Takanohana's letter to Onmyouji Kishi.

filas.intro: Momotaro tried to defeat King Oni but failed, and turned into a vengeful spirit. He will not be able to rest in peace until someone places King Oni's Ghostly Chopper on Momotaro's grave.
pasos: 1. Defeat the powerful King Oni and get his Ghostly Chopper.
2. Visit Momotaro's grave with the Ghostly Chopper.

filas.intro: Before Fox Spirit Tamamo was turned into a demonic creature, it used the last of its strength to send Tohru out of Jade Tassel City. Tohru knows that Tamamo can no longer return to its original form, so he hopes that someone will help put Tamamo to rest.
pasos: 1. Defeat Fox Spirit Tamamo.
2. Tell Tohru what happened.

filas.intro: King Ashuro used to stand guard over Jade Tassel City, but he has not turned into an evil tyrant intent on destroying the city. Head Ninja Kamakura hopes that someone will defeat King Ashuro and save the city.
pasos: 1. Defeat the tyrant King Ashuro.
2. Report to Kamakura.

filas.intro:
For some strange reason, the Fruity Tribe
 was attacked by the Royalbee Tribe,
 their fellow guardians of Sequoia, and the tribe is now in danger!
 Honey Peachy went to seek help...
pasos: 1. Go to the Sweet Orchard located northwest\n of Jade Vale and negotiate with Maroon.
2. Drive away those ruining the scenery:\n Violet Grassball: /c$9%33760%/c* / 200\n Cavendish Dancer: /c$9%33761%/c* / 200
3. Tell Maroon that you have cleared the scene.
4. Help Maroon pick up\n Lippy Sweets: /c$9%33762%/c* / 50
5. Pass the Lippy Sweets to Maroon.
6. Talk to Maroon now that he has regained consciousness.

filas.intro:
The weirdo Artist Maroon who has the key to the whereabouts of the King
 has discovered the strange state of the entire
 forest. This may be a sign of further
 invasion. Actions have to be taken...
pasos: 1. Keep defeating the Carrot Boys in Sweet Orchard\n and get Thick Honey: \n /c$9%33763%/c* / 1 Jar
2. Pass the extremely sweet-smelling Honey to\n Maroon.
3. Help Maroon pass the strange, thick Honey\n  to Taern in Fruity Village to analyze.

4. Forcefully grab the following
 from Bluegrass Elves
 outside Fruity Village:
 /c$9%33764%/c* / 50 Stink Grass
5. Pass the Stink Grass to Taern.

6. Spray the Neutralizer on the giant radish
 in the northwest part of Sweet Orchard
 before it loses effect!
 (If the Neutralizer evaporates, you can get another one from Taern in Fruity Village.)
7. You've succeeded in dispelling the sweet-smelling poison.\n Return and talk to Maroon.

filas.intro:
Under the waves of attack from the Royalbee Tribe,
 only Fruity Village, the toughtest village in the Fruity Tribe,
 is still holding up... To find the missing King,
 you'll have to help Fruity Village through this ordeal
 and gain the trust of the royal guard!
pasos: 1. Hurry to Fruity Village and ask Guard Rustor\n about the whereabouts of the King.
2. Defeat those endangering the village:\n Greedy Ant: /c$9%33766%/c* / 200\n Shy Ant: /c$9%33767%/c* / 200
3. Activate the Barrier Control hidden in the warehouse\n at the east of Fruity Village and ensure the village's safety.
4. All done. Report back to Guard Rustor\n in Fruity Village.

filas.intro:
In Sequoia, Jade Garden is an
 important agricultural land. It has the most fertile soil and the purest
 water, and fruits grown there are healthy and have
 the taste most excellent. Alas, war is wrecking chaos
 in this blessed land...
pasos: 1. Proceed to Jade Garden and find Honey Peachy's\n twin sister: Spring Peachy!
2. Trace the King and defeat Cooked Cornies\n in the Jade Garden to look for Clues: /c$9%33770%/c* / 1.
3. Find the Prophet mentioned in the Clues.

4. Collect pesticide materials from the monsters
 in Jade Garden:
 Officer Ryaon /c$9%33771%/c* / 1
 Sobbing Onion /c$9%33772%/c* / 200
5. Get Prophet Fungi to make the Pesticide.

5. Spray the Pesticide in the 5 main plots
 of land in Jade Garden:
 Land 1: /c$9%33773%/c* / 1
 Land 2: /c$9%33774%/c* / 1
 Land 3 
/c$9%33775%/c* / 1
 Land 4 /c$9%33776%/c* / 1
 Land 5 /c$9%33777%/c* / 1
7. Report back to Prophet Prophet Fungi.
8. Talk to Prophet Fungi again.

filas.intro:
The Fruity Tribe is losing ground under the invasion,
 and even within the Tribe there are people who are disoriented. Things are in jeopardy with both internal and external
 pressure. What is the cause of this chaos...?
pasos: 1. Proceed to Luscious Grange and find Foreworker\n Jenny.
2. Thoroughly search the monsters' items:\n Blueberry Baby: /c$9%33778%/c* / 100\n Sweetie Honey: /c$9%33779%/c* / 100
3. Let Foreworker Jenny examine the toxin\n that the monsters carry.
4. Seek help from Scholar Taern in\n Fruity Village.
5. Return to Luscious Grange and inform\n Foreworker Jenny of the results of the analysis.
6. Look for suspicious people next\n to the Refining Machine in Luscious Grange!\n Get the Venom used to poison /c$9%33780%/c* / 1.
7. Having intercepted the villain and\n snatched the Venom, bring the proof back to\n Jenny.
8. Talk to Foreworker Jenny again.

filas.intro:
The truth is coming to light. Evil forces are
 eyeing Sequoia's power of creation
 and the Royalbee Tribe was merely a pawn...
 It's time to head to Sequoia!
pasos: 1. Find General Butorfie at Branch Way as instructed\n in the King's secret letter.
2. Clear the obstructing:\n Leader Ulala /c$9%33781%/c* / 1\n Sunflower Aboriginal /c$9%33782%/c* / 200
3. Emerge victorious and report back to\n General Butorfie.
4. Clear the enemies on the path to the Lost Trail:\n Brutal Ape /c$9%33783%/c* / 200
5. Tell General Butorfie\n of your victory.
6. Hurry to Lost Trail and assist General Chuckus\n who is struggling in battle.

filas.intro:
It turns out that the exiled King of Fruity Tribe has
 been busy cleansing the corruption within
 Sequoia. Now he is all ready!
pasos: 1. Defeat the Crying Red Onions in Lost Trail\n and collect the King's Diary's Pages:\n /c$9%33784%/c* / 200
2. Piece together the King's Diary and deliver\n it to General Chuckus.

3. Collect the medicine needed to cleanse Sequoia!
 Fragrant Dew /c$9%33785%/c* / 50
 carried by Clover Elves in Fruity Village
 Magic Mud /c$9%33786%/c* / 50
 carried by Golden Porcupines in Jade Garden
 Spring Sprig /c$9%33787%/c* / 50 
 carried by Spring Deermen in Branch Way
 Scorching Embers /c$9%33788%/c* / 50 carried by Dragonfruit Porcupines in Lost Trail.
4. Hand the medicine needed to cleanse Sequoia\n to Maid Evearn at Buzzing Stopover.
5. Meet King Fruity who has been hiding at\n the Buzzing Stopover.

filas.intro:
The great Sequoia, believed to have created Eden,
 is now being wrecked by the demons!
 Angels, your mission is to protect the world.
 You shall heal the wounds left by the demons
 and return the land to its rightful state!
pasos:
1. To heal the wounds of corruption in Sequoia,
 the creatures in the territory have to be cleared first...
 Shy Bee /c$9%33789%/c* / 100
 Guardian Ant /c$9%33790%/c* / 100
2. Inform the King that the job is done.
3. Pour the Purifying Medicine on Sequoia's Core\n in the middle of the Buzzing Stopover.

4. Intercept the monsters coming
 to disrupt the ceremony:
 Sunflower Samurai /c$9%33791%/c* / 200
 Ant Warrior Jack /c$9%33792%/c* / 1
5. Report to the King that the cleansing was successful.
6. Talk to Sequoia's Conscious.
7. Return to Buzzing Stopover and receive\n King Fruity's commendation.

filas.intro:
Sequoia is a natural forest of wonders,
 filled with mysteries and some say miracles. 
 Scientists and researchers have been fastidiously studying
 its every smell and every flavor.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Glow Frogs in\n the Sweet Orchard and collect:\n Zesty Apple /c$9%33793%/c* / 200 pieces
2. Deliver the mountain of Apples\n to Researcher Tyler.
3. Extract the following from the Warm Grassballs\n in the Sweet Orchard: Sugar Grass /c$9%33794%/c* / 50
4. Deliver the Sugar Grass to Researcher Tyler.
5. Collect your paycheck from Researcher Tyler.

filas.intro:
Travelers from a wine appreciation group
 ventured deep into the forests of Sequoia in search of
 its legendary wine ingredients.
pasos:
1. Collect the following from the Maroon Crabs
 and Leaf Owls near Fruity Village:
 Perfume Pear /c$9%33795%/c* / 50
 Fragile Lemon /c$9%33796%/c* / 50
2. Give Madam Bonna the fruits\n you gathered for the wine.
3. Collect Candy Orange Water from\n the Citrus River east of Fruity Village.
4. Collect your reward from Madam Bonna\n for gathering all the ingredients.

filas.intro:
Rampaging monsters have made
 the world a dangerous place for the Fruity Tribe,
 yet a little boy has wandered off by himself!
 Find him quickly before any harm befalls him!
pasos: 1. Help Mikaela find her child, Bobi.
2. Help fend off the monsters surrounding Charlotte:\n Dull Spider /c$9%33797%/c* / 200\n Crab Gabe /c$9%33798%/c* / 1
3. Inform Mikaela that her child and pet are safe.
4. Talk to Mikaela again.

filas.intro:
The Royalbee Tribe is acting strangely.
 The tribe just keeps attacking Sequoia. Guard Vicks,
 who is the Guard Captain in charge of guarding Sequoia's roots,
 is in dire need of assistance!
pasos: 1. Defeat the assailants:\n Blue Mushiroom /c$9%33799%/c* / 200\n Kung Bamboo /c$9%33800%/c* / 200
2. Give your battle report to Guard Vicks.
3. Search for Deputy Larry.
4. Eradicate the attackers:\n Kiwi Porcupine /c$9%33801%/c* / 100\n Mr Know-It-All /c$9%33802%/c* / 1
5. Report back to Deputy Larry.
6. Continue talking to Deputy Larry.

filas.intro:
It is strange indeed for the Royalbee Tribe
 to wage war for no reason. Something mysterious
 is taking place behind all this bloodshed.
 Find out what is happening!
pasos: 1. Go to Luscious Grange and check to see if Nasha\n is different from the other Royalbees.
2. Defeat the contaminators: \n Twin-head Chimera /c$9%33803%/c* / 200\n Mutated Chimera /c$9%33804%/c* / 200
3. Inform Nasha of your victory.

4. Deliver clean food to:
 Naeve /c$9%33768%/c* / 1 portion
 Nally /c$9%33769%/c* / 1 portion
(If the Vanilla disappears, more can be collected from Nasha at Luscious Grange)
5. Report to Nasha on your successful deliveries.
6. Receive a reward from Nasha.

filas.intro:
Evil forces have controlled the minds
 of several Royalbees
 and enslaved them.
 This all started with the food contamination.
pasos: 1. Assist Evertina who is deep in the Branch Way\n and join forces with the Royalbee Tribe against evil forces.
2. Defeat Chef Carrots and\n collect Honey Dippers: /c$9%33806%/c* / 100
3. Give the Honey Dippers you gathered\n to Evertina.

4. Defeat enemies of
 the Royalbee Tribe: 
 Sunflowerian Resident /c$9%33807%/c* / 100
 King Merdell /c$9%33808%/c* / 1
5. Head to the Lost Trail and\n report the situation to Royalbee Commander Peggie.
6. Receive Peggie's rewards.

filas.intro:
Despite falling into great chaos,
 the high and mighty Royalbee soldiers still hold fast to their pride
 and will not accept any help...
 Will they be able to get through this?
pasos:
1. Since Peggie is able to cope
 with the situation, provide
 assistance to her subordinate, Ferlyn.
2. Destroy the monsters that surround Peggie:\n Green Woodcutter /c$9%33809%/c* / 200\n Banana Diva /c$9%33810%/c* / 200
3. Report your victory to Ferlyn.
4. Quickly dispatch the assassins: \n Bloody Croc /c$9%33811%/c* / 100\n Oliveback Croc Gulio /c$9%33812%/c* / 1
5. Destroy any ambushes\n and confirm Peggie's safety.
6. Receive Peggie's commendation.

filas.intro:
The situation is chaotic. All supplies
 are in severe shortage, including the fertilizers needed for farming.
 But nothing is too tough for seasoned farmers to handle!
pasos: 1. Pop the Half-cooked Cornies /c$9%33813%/c* / 100\n and turn them into fertilizer!
2. Smoosh the Red Mushirooms /c$9%33814%/c* / 100\n and turn them into fertilizer!
3. Juice the Fu Bamboos /c$9%33815%/c* / 100\n and turn them into fertilizer!
4. Chop up the Wailing Onions /c$9%33816%/c* / 100\n and turn them into fertilizer!
5. Inform Farmer Sean that\n the fertilization is complete.
6. Share in Farmer Sean's joy.

filas.intro:
The Fruity Tribe is in turmoil and many people have fled.
 Factories are suffering a severe manpower shortage
 and have stopped operations.
 Your priority: restore peace to the Fruity Tribe!
pasos: 1. Trash the rioters at Luscious Grange:\n Sweet Flute /c$9%33817%/c* / 100\n Wildberry Baby /c$9%33818%/c* / 100
2. Report the work progress to Sister Jen.
3. Wallop the troublemakers at Luscious Grange: Berry Owl /c$9%33819%/c* / 200
4. Report your work progress to Sister Jen again.
5. Beat the stuffing out of these monsters: \n Rainbow Owl /c$9%33820%/c* / 100\n Cacaou /c$9%33821%/c* / 1
6. Overtime work completed. Report to Sister Jen.
7. Receive your pay from Sister Jen.

filas.intro:
The painter lost his paints
 and is anxious to get them back.
 To him, his paints seem 
 more important than his life...
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Autumn Deermen
 and Jade Lions: 
 Auburn Rose /c$9%33822%/c* / 100
 Jade Stone /c$9%33823%/c* / 100
2. Return the paint to Darlee quickly.
3. Hurry and retrieve from\n Cook Corrats: Purple paint /c$9%33824%/c* / 1 bottle
4. Return the paint to Darlee.
5. Commiserate with Darlee.

filas.intro:
With the recent increase in demand
 for wedding photographs, the photography business
 is flourishing. One of the best locations
 is Sequoia, however, monsters there
 do not like visitors.
pasos: 1. Find the camera set: /c$9%33825%/c* / 1\n Keep beating down Purple Woodcutters until you find it.
2. Return the camera set to Little Chan.
3. Chase away the disrupters: \n Ranana Diva: /c$9%33826%/c* / 100\n Assassin Bamboo Cin: /c$9%33827%/c* / 1
4. Job complete. Report back to Little Chan.
5. Talk to Little Chan again.

filas.intro:
Tiffania Beauty International Pte. Ltd. is currently
 expanding, and the CEO is eyeing
 the high quality nutrients produced by Sequoia.
pasos:
1. Chase away the surrounding monsters
 and ensure the safety of the employees: 
 Passionate Bee: /c$9%33828%/c* / 200
 Watcher Ant: /c$9%33829%/c* / 200
2. Report the situation to the boss, Tiffania.
3. Knock the tops off the Fresh Mint Jars\n at the Buzzing Stopover and collect Sequoia Dew: \n /c$9%33830%/c* / 100 drops
4. Update the boss with a progress report.

5. Defeat powerful monsters at Buzzing Stopover: 
Red Lightning Werande and Royal Honey Tessy
 Collect the following from them: 
 Kaleidopollen: /c$9%33831%/c* / 1 bottle
 Tangy Sap: /c$9%33832%/c* / 1 can
6. Report the results to the boss.
7. Collect your pay from your boss, Tiffania.

filas.intro:
Wicky bought many bags of Fruit Seeds
 from the Floating Market. However, on the way home,
 the Carrot Boys snatched them from him. Please teach
 the Carrot Boys a lesson and help Wicky
 get his Fruit Seeds back!
pasos: 1. Retrieve from the Carrot Boys: \n Fruit Seed:/c$9%32470%/c*/ 100
2. Return the Fruit Seeds to Wicky, the rightful owner.

filas.intro:
Chef Charmaine has invented a new dish that
 can restore huge amounts of energy. She calls it
 "Fruit Pur?e"! Unfortunately, she needs two more ingredients.
 Please help Charmaine get the ingredients
 so that she can perfect this
 mouthwatering dish!
pasos: 1. Collect these ingredients: \n Saccharine Fruit:/c$9%32471%/c*/ 50 pieces\n Lemongrass:/c$9%32472%/c*/ 50 pieces
2. Give the ingredients to Chef Charmaine.

filas.intro:
Greedy Ants and Leaf Owls
 are raiding Fruity Village's
 food supplies. Chief Roluck hopes that
 someone will help them
 get back their supplies.
pasos: 1. Retrieve from Greedy Ants: Flour:/c$9%32473%/c*/ 50 sacks\n Retrieve from Leaf Owls: \n Grain: /c$9%32474%/c*/ 50 sacks
2. Return the supplies to Chief Roluck.

filas.intro:
Tiva has returned from a faraway land
 and would like to distribute the gifts he brought for everyone.
 To help distribute his gifts quickly,
 Tiva would like a helping hand. Do you want to help him?
pasos:
1. Distribute the presents:
 Talk to Katner: /c$9%32475%/c*/ 1 time.
 Talk to Saige: /c$9%32476%/c*/ 1 time.
 Talk to Perliss: /c$9%32477%/c*/ 1 time.
2. Report back to Tiva.

filas.intro:
The garden has unwelcome visitors
 eating away at the vegetables.
 But Carla worked really hard to plant those vegetables!
 Someone please chase these pests away!
pasos: 1. Chase away these pests:\n Kiwi Porcupine: /c$9%32478%/c*/ 50\n Wailing Onion: /c$9%32479%/c*/ 50
2. Report back to Carla.

filas.intro:
In a bid to protect the vegetables in Jade Garden,
 Exterminator Caden has been spraying pesticide on the crops.
 Alas, he has run out of pesticide!
 Exterminator Caden needs help collecting ingredients
 to make more pesticide.
 Can you help him?
pasos: 1. Collect pesticide ingredients:\n Sandalwood Powder: /c$9%32480%/c*/ 50 lumps\n Birch Branch: /c$9%32481%/c*/ 50 sticks
2. Give the pesticide ingredients to Exterminator Caden.

filas.intro:
Wildberry Babies love collecting anything and everything shiny,
 including Fruit Processor Parts!
 Micasa is very angry and really needs somebody to help her 
 get those parts back.
 Can you help?
pasos: 1. Retrieve the Fruit Processor Parts from the Wildberry Babies.
2. Return the Fruit Processor Parts to Micasa.

filas.intro:
Luxona is in a hurry to make as many
 canned fruits as possible for the village's annual celebrations.
But he has run out of Metal Sheets and cannot continue!
 Can you help Luxona get more?
pasos: 1. Retrieve from Sweetie Jams:\n Metal Sheet: /c$9%32483%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Metal Sheets to Luxona.

filas.intro:
A group of Brutal Apes is causing trouble
 by attacking travelers. Now, because of them,
 no one dares to come to our village!
 Mucas hopes that someone will stop them.
pasos: 1. Get rid of the troublemakers:\n Brutal Ape: /c$9%32484%/c*/ 100
2. Report back to Mucas.

filas.intro:
While running away from the Autumn Deermen,
 Timberjacker Lucarlos dropped his toolbox!
 He is in despair.
 Please help him get it back!
pasos: 1. Retrieve the toolbox:\n Take the toolbox back from the Autumn Deermen.
2. Return Lucarlos' Toolbox to him.

filas.intro:
Carine wants to bake delicious Hibiscus Cakes for everyone!
 However, Carine still needs more ingredients.
 Please help Carine get more ingredients
 so that everyone can enjoy Carine's wonderful treat!
pasos: 1. Collect cake ingredients:\n Bloody Croc Egg: /c$9%32486%/c*/ 100.
2. Give the ingredients to Carine.

filas.intro:
Merchant Fernado's business is booming
 because the fur coats he makes are so comfy,
 everyone wants one! With so many requests for fur coats,
 Fernado does not even have time to collect the wool needed to make them.
 Please give Fernado the help he needs!
pasos: 1. Collect various furs:\n Greenfruit Porcupine Fur: /c$9%32487%/c*/ 50\n Dragonfruit Porcupine Fur: /c$9%32488%/c*/ 50
2. Give the furs to Merchant Fernado.

filas.intro:
Therapist Lambert has concocted a special honey drink
 that is very effective for healing wounds.
 Just drink! In order to create
 as much Manuka Honey as possible,
 Lambert needs more ingredients.
 Would you like to help?
pasos: 1. Collect from Aromatic Honey Jars and Sunny Elves: \n Honey: /c$9%32489%/c*/ 50\n Nectarine: /c$9%32490%/c*/ 50
2. Give the Honey and Nectarine to Lambert.

filas.intro:
Monsters keep attacking,
 so Walter wants to build fortifications around the village
 to prevent further assaults.
 Can you help gather the materials needed?
pasos: 1. Gather from Guardian Ants: \n Metal Plate: /c$9%32491%/c*/ 100
2. Give the Metal Plates to Walter.

filas.intro:
Bug King Wartoz is a thousand-year old
 giant worm that cannot metamorphose due to its steel-like carapace.
 After listening to false rumors from the Evil Lyceum,
 it has gone on a rampage, consuming angels
 to evolve. All Angel Pickets have been deployed to stop
 this demonic bug!
pasos: 1. Defeat the rampaging Bug King Wartoz\n and prevent harm from befalling the angels.
2. Report your victory to the\n Angel Inspector.

filas.intro:
Wayrane was constantly bullied.
 After he obtained powers in Sequoia,
 he joined the Royalbee Tribe.
 His friends deeply regret their past actions
. They wish to make amends
 and turn Wayrane away from the path of violence.
pasos: 1. Subdue the enraged Wayrane.
2. Return to Fruity Village and talk to Mel.

filas.intro:
When the Queen Bee
 fell under an evil spell,
 she built a fort in the depths
 of Sequoia. Peggie decided
 to assault the Queen Bee one more time
 to try to break the spell!
pasos: 1. Infiltrate the deepest part\n of the Queen Bee Hideout and defeat\n the minion of evil, Queen Bee Femirse!
2. Return to the Lost Trail and\n give Peggie the good news.

filas.intro:
The sentinels have revolted!
 This saddens Trainer Aden deeply.
 Help him suppress
 the rebels and save their reputation.
pasos: 1. "Re-train" the Royalbee rebels:\n Sweet Ant: /c$9%33833%/c*/ 120
2. Report the results of the "re-training" to Aden.
3. Talk to Aden again.

filas.intro:
Little children have always hated the taste of bitter medicine,
 so parents usually have a hard time giving them medicine.
 But this special honey
 shall make the world a better place!
pasos: 1. Defeat the Honey Elves in the Queen Bee Hideout\n and collect the delectable special honey:\n /c$9%33835%/c*/ 10 bottles
2. Bring the honey back to\n Old Man Kivi to make syrup.
3. Accept Old Man Kivi's humble thanks.

filas.intro:
Forced to take the rap
 for the company's Demon Food scandal,
 Employee Yared decides to gather evidence
 to clear his name and
 mete out justice.
pasos: 1. Defeat the Blaboo Warriors in the Queen Bee Hideout\n and collect Tainted Honey Blocks as evidence: \n /c$9%33836%/c*/ 25 pieces
2. Hand over the incriminating evidence to Yared.
3. Watch as Yared takes his revenge.

filas.intro:
Apart from starting a war, the Royalbee Tribe
 is also distributing Demon Additives
 throughout Eden.
 They are a great threat to everyone's health and
 must be stopped at all costs!
pasos:
1. Search every corner of the Queen Bee Hideout and
 destroy any Additives you find: 
 Demon Cloudifiers: /c$9%33837%/c* / 1 box
 Demon Sweets: /c$9%33838%/c* / 1 box
 Demon Cottonseed Oil: /c$9%33839%/c* / 1 pot
2. Destruction complete, return to Fruity Village\n and look for Jannkin.
3. Listen to Jannkin's words of appreciation.

filas.intro:
A lady alchemist, full of zeal and passion,
 traveled all over the world
 and finally arrived at Sequoia
 in search of an elixir for eternal youth...
pasos: 1. Enter the Queen Bee Hideout and collect Sequoia Leaves from\n Diva Banasis, Golden Sunflowerian and Pretty Miruru: \n /c$9%33834%/c* / 3
2. Give the Sequoia Leaves to Melanie.
3. Accept Melanie's gifts.

filas.intro: 「Lv.1クエストポーション」を精\n製して報告しよう！
pasos: 1.Lv.1クエストポーションを初級精製トレーナーに納品しよう

filas.intro: 「Lv.2クエストポーション」を精\n製して報告しよう！
pasos: 1.Lv.2クエストポーションを中級精製トレーナーに納品しよう

filas.intro: 「Lv.3クエストポーション」を精\n製して報告しよう！
pasos: 1.Lv.3クエストポーションを上級精製トレーナーに納品しよう

filas.intro: 「Lv.4クエストポーション」を精\n製して報告しよう！
pasos: 1.Lv.4クエストポーションを高級精製トレーナーに納品しよう

filas.intro: 「Lv.5クエストポーション」を精\n製して報告しよう！
pasos: 1.Lv.5クエストポーションを超級精製トレーナーに納品しよう

filas.intro: 水晶配布
pasos: 水晶配布

filas.tipo: ころとんコラボイベント
filas.intro: 金色のジェルを集めて金ずきんちゃんに持っていこう
pasos: 金色のジェルを集めて金ずきんちゃんに持っていこう

filas.intro: 「忘却の都」にある別荘で夏休みを過ごしているエリザーベートは快適な夏休みを過ごす為、近くにある「蛇神の閨」が気になるようです。彼女の変わりに見てきてあげましょう。
pasos: 「蛇神の閨」でリウェイタンを倒す。
依頼管理者に報告しよう

filas.intro: ホークヘッド祭司は夏休みにうかれて暴れている「失われた密室」のモンスター達に困っているようです。彼の代わりに「失われた密室」のモンスター達を懲らしめてあげましょう。
pasos: 「失われた密室」でスフィンクスを倒す。
「失われた密室」でツタンニャアメンを倒す。
依頼管理者に報告しよう

filas.intro: フェルカは氷獄の城の「氷晶女王ナティス」をいつも心配しています。彼女の代わりに様子を見てきてあげましょう。
pasos: 「氷獄の城」で氷獣アンフェルドを倒す。
「氷獄の城」で氷晶女王ナティスを倒す。
依頼管理者に報告しよう

filas.intro: 今年の夏はとても暑い！\n南国おじさんはこの暑さで夏休みを快適に過ごす事ができません。彼の為に冷たい石を取ってきてあげよう！
pasos: 依頼管理者に冷たい石200個を渡す。

filas.intro: トロール禁域をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「トロール禁域」で結晶獣\n  ゲレオンを倒す。
2.「トロール禁域」で大地神\n  ゲルミルを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: ﾅｲﾄﾒｱｻｲﾚﾝﾄをクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「ﾅｲﾄﾒｱｻｲﾚﾝﾄ」で\n  現ナイトメアジーを倒す。
2.「ﾅｲﾄﾒｱｻｲﾚﾝﾄ」で\n  混沌熊王ベルトﾙを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 諸星の聖宮をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「諸星の聖宮」でゼウスを倒す。
2.「諸星の聖宮」で暗黒剣士オウリルを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro: 淵海獣の巣をクリアして報酬をもらおう！\n
pasos: 1.「淵海獣の巣」で鋼尾の機蛇ヨルムンガンドを倒す。
2.「淵海獣の巣」で淵海の魔獣ルマスハージャを倒す。
3.ﾀﾞﾝｼﾞｮﾝ天使に報告しよう

filas.intro:
A mysterious monk in strange robes
 from Bayan City
 has arrived at the four cities.
 Rumors say that this ancient city
 is being besieged by monsters.
 The monk has come to seek aid
 in the hopes of rescuing his people from
 this unprecedented crisis.
pasos: 1. Bring the letter to Shuwa Market and look for Nadora.
2. Eradicate: \n Navy Seal: /c$9%36594%/c*/ 200\n Mutated Pink Fruit: /c$9%36595%/c*/ 200
3. Report the battle results to Nadora.
4. Defeat the leader, Captain Banjeowl.
5. Give the Rune Orb you found\n to Nadora.
6. Check if Lifeguard Orklo\n has any similar orbs.
7. Report back to Nadora.

filas.intro:
Nadora carefully examined the Rune Orbs
 but is unable to make anything of them.
 She said that Sage Jude at Mariam Waterway
 might know something and
 wants you to take
 the Rune Orbs to him.
pasos: 1. Bring the Rune Orbs to Mariam Waterway\n and look for Sage Jude.
2. Capture: \n Pastel Baby Seal: /c$9%36598%/c*/ 200
3. Hand over the captured\n Pastel Baby Seals to Sage Jude.
4. Collect: \n Energy Orb：/c$9%36599%/c*/ 200
5. Give the Enegy Orbs to Sage Jude.
6. Toss the Energy Orb\n into the Waterway.
7. Report back to Sage Jude.

filas.intro:
The Energy Orb has been placed in the river
 for some time now, and Sage Jude finds
 that monster activities nearby have gradually reduced.
 He would like someone
 to verify if the monsters'
 aggression has lessened.
pasos: 1. Check the status of Treasure Pearl Carly.
2. Give the darkened Rune Orb to Sage Jude.
3.  Head to Bayan Villlage to request\n for Monk Zander's help.
4. Get Monk Zander's Prayer Beads back from the Playful Elephant.
5. Return the Prayer Beads to Monk Zander.
6. Collect some Millennium Water.
7. Give the Millennium Water to Monk Zander.

filas.intro:
Monk Zander purified the Purifying Pearl with water
 from the Millennium Spring. While purifying,
 he discovered texts belonging to
 a 1000-year old prophecy.
 He would like to collect as many orbs
 as possible to complete the prophecy.
pasos: 1. Retrieve darkened Rune Orbs from\n powerful monsters in the Deserted Ruins: /c$9%36604%/c*/  3
2. Give the darkened Rune Orb\n to Monk Zander.
3. Head to Siam Square and talk to Eunice.
4. Collect: \n Pink Pearl: /c$9%36605%/c*/ 200\n Soft Petal: /c$9%36606%/c*/ 200
5. Give the materials to Eunice.

filas.intro:
Eunice is delighted to have
 obtained information about the man
 who was pacing about the temple.
 Her sister, Eunitta,
 picked up a letter that the man dropped.
 Investigating that letter might
 lead you to some clues.
pasos: 1. Head to Bayan Village to collect the letter from Eunitta.
2. Return to Miriam Waterway again\n and request for help from Sage Jude.
3. Collect the following broken pieces of the Formation Gear: \n Blessed Feather: /c$9%36608%/c*/ 200\n Crystal Dew: /c$9%36609%/c*/ 200 bottles
4. Give the materials to Sage Jude.
5. Head to Bayan Village and talk to Monk Zander.
6. Collect the following: \n Tough Thread: /c$9%36611%/c*/ 1 spool\n Lotus Wood: /c$9%36612%/c*/ 1 piece
7. Give the materials to Monk Zander.

filas.intro:
Now that Monk Zander has the materials
 to create new Prayer Beads, use his Prayer Beads
 to destroy the Black-wings' ambitions
 and save Bayan!
pasos: 1. Head to Siam Square and\n locate the Magic Formation.
2. Get rid of obstacles:\n Deathly Torcher: /c$9%36613%/c*/ 200\n Magician Foream:/c$9%36614%/c*/ 1
3. Place the broken Formation Gears\n and the Prayer Beads in the Magic Formation.
4. Give the Magic Core\n to Monk Zander.

filas.intro:
Sashae loves to make necklaces and strives to 
 become the world's best artisan 
. She has decided to craft 200 necklaces daily 
 as part of her training.
 Help her gather the required materials!
pasos:
1. Collect these materials
 Bright Pearl: /c$9%36616%/c*/ 200. 
 Vibrant Feather: /c$9%36617%/c*/ 200. 
 Polished Fang: /c$9%36618%/c*/ 200.
2. Give the materials to Sashae.

filas.intro:
Flu cases are on the rise due to the terrible weather. 
Pharmist Rico managed to produce a prototype flu medicine -「Flumo」. 
However, he does not have enough materials to make 200 bottles daily! 
 Help him gather the required materials!
pasos: 1. Collect the ingredients for the medicine\n Trunk Shroom: /c$9%36620%/c*/ 200. \n Tail Weed: /c$9%36621%/c*/ 200.
2. Give the ingredients to Pharmist Rico.
3. Collect some medicine bottles: \n Chilled Flask: /c$9%36622%/c*/ 200.
4. Give the bottles to Pharmist Rico.

filas.intro:
Recently, many travelers have been attacked on Mariam Waterway.
 After a long investigation, Patrol Allie
 finally uncovered the true identities of the attackers
 and is currently looking for warriors to apprehend them!
pasos: 1. Defeat the attackers: \n Canal Diver: /c$9%36624%/c*/ 200. \n Dream Fowl: /c$9%36625%/c*/ 200.
2. Return to Patrol Allie.
3. Pass the Task Book to Sergeant Wales.

filas.intro:
Luluca, the owner of a fast food chain in Shuwa Market 
, only uses the freshest ingredients for cooking. 
 He takes pride in serving his customers warm, tasty food fresh from the stove!
 As his business is now booming, Luluca wants to hire a part-time worker!
pasos: 1. Collect fresh ingredients: \n Clam G: /c$9%36627%/c*/ 200. \n Sliced Kiwi: /c$9%36628%/c*/ 200.
2. Give the ingredients to Luluca.
3. Collect the lunchbox from Luluca after 10mins.
4. Give the warm lunchbox to Mimica.
5. Collect your salary from Luluca.

filas.intro:
Yaer, the guild master of Shuwa Market's Community Guild,
 is a compassionate man who always helps the needy.
 A hoard of monsters invaded the town one day,
 resulting in chaos.
 Yaer is unable to repel all the monsters by himself. Help him!
pasos: 1. Defeat their leader - Sergeant Tremu.
2. Report to Yaer.
3. Help to repel the monsters\n Meowpire: /c$9%36631%/c*/ 200. \n Meovil: /c$9%36632%/c*/ 200.
4. Report to Yaer for your reward.

filas.intro:
Shuwa Market holds 50% sales at random timings daily.
 However, Wando never gets to buy anything as he is way too slow.
 So he has decided to hire a runner to sweep up all the bargains for him!
pasos:
1. Buy the following items within 5 min: 
 Top Quality Fruits from Ian Hanz: /c$9%36634%/c*/ 1
 Organic Veggies from Virian: /c$9%36635%/c*/ 1
 Prime Steak from Slokov: /c$9%36636%/c*/ 1
2. Report to Wando.
3. Pass the items you have bought to Xando\n to receive your reward.

filas.intro: Monsters are ravaging the village, destroying houses and pillaging the granaries.\n As a result, the villagers are running low on food supplies. Sensing the urgency, Chief Jelad is frantically looking for brave warriors to drive the monsters away!\n
pasos: 1. Exterminate the guards: \n Furry Spider: /c$9%36638%/c*/ 200。
2. Recover the Rice: /c$9%36639%/c*/ 200 bags.
3. Retrieve the supplies: /c$9%36640%/c*/ 200 boxes.
4. Give the supplies to Chief Jelad.

filas.intro:
Bayan used to be a peaceful village until the monsters' invasion.
 Enraged by the plight of the village, Wendell has promised a hefty reward 
 for any warrior who can give the monsters a good spanking!
pasos: 1. Teach Seamstress Wella a lesson.
2. Defeat Magician Kas.
3. Defeat Cutter Meister.
4.Report to Wendell.

filas.intro:
The village patrol team cannot cope with the invading monsters.
 Officer Garland has decided to recruit more patrolmen.
 All applicants are welcome!
pasos: 1. Eliminate the monsters: \n Hammer Bearer: /c$9%36646%/c*/ 200. \n Bat Yaksha: /c$9%36647%/c*/ 200.
2. Report to Officer Garland.
3. Report to Cherie.
4. Defeat Bud Elves: /c$9%36648%/c*/ 200.
5.Report to Cherie.

filas.intro:
Archaeologist Xenja wandered into the Deserted Ruins a few months ago
 and realized that many ancient artifacts within
 have been defiled by rampaging monsters.
 She needs someone to help her
 drive the monsters away in order to preserve the artifacts.
pasos: 1. Drive the Prankster Wolves away: /c$9%36650%/c*/ 200
2. Return to Xenja.
3. Collect the artifacts: \n Tome Scrap:  /c$9%36651%/c*/ 200. \n Torn Page: /c$9%36652%/c*/ 200.
4. Give the retrieved artifacts to Xenja.
5. Send the Daily Report to Yinki.
6. Collect your reward from Xenja.

filas.intro:
Koron is a photographer from Aurora City.
 Mesmerized by the beautiful scenery, he chose Deserted Ruins
 as the theme for his new photo album.
 However, the monsters in the area are too tough for him to handle.
 Koron is currently looking for someone who can help him.
pasos: 1. Drive the Carnival Elephants away: /c$9%36654%/c*/ 200
2. Return to Koron.
3.Repel Patty Soldiers: /c$9%36655%/c*/ 200. \n Repel Feline Boboro: /c$9%36656%/c*/ 1.
4. Check on Yeaven.
5. Return to Koron to collect your reward.

filas.intro:
Evie chanced upon the Deserted Ruins
 during his training journey across the world.
 Intrigued by the ritual circles
 he found in the Deserted Ruins,
 he has decided to investigate the
 Deserted Ruins thoroughly.
 He is currently looking for adventurers
 to assist him in his investigations.
pasos: 1. Collect Magic Waves in the eastern region.
2. Collect Magic Waves in the southern region.
3. Collect Magic Waves in the western region.
4. Collect Magic Waves in the northern region.
5. Give the Magic Waves you collected to Evie.
6. Gather Magical Emblems: /c$9%36662%/c*/ 200
7. Give the Magical Emblems to Evie for your reward.

filas.intro:
Since her brother's untimely death, Rachel has been
 selling handmade flowers at Siam Square for a living.
 However, poor Rachel hasn't been able to sell any of her flowers lately
 because tourists are shunning the monster-infested square.
 Help her drive the monsters away!
pasos: 1. Drive the monsters away: \n Brawler Wolf: /c$9%36664%/c*/ 200. \n Knitting Spider: /c$9%36665%/c*/ 200.
2. Report to Rachel.
3. Collect materials: \n Aqua Paint:  /c$9%36666%/c*/ 200 bottles. \n Honey Lotus Petals:  /c$9%36667%/c*/ 200.
4. Give the materials to Rachel.

filas.intro:
Due to the sudden surge of monsters, the troops at
 Siam Square are running low on supplies.
 Quartermaster Jeffery is looking for someone
 who is willing to procure supplies on his behalf.
pasos: 1. Gather the resources: \n Sturdy Skin: /c$9%36669%/c*/ 200. \n Chilly Thread: /c$9%36670%/c*/ 200.
2. Give the resources to Jeffery.
3. Collect Fiery Meat: /c$9%36671%/c*/ 200.
4. Give the meat to Jeffery.

filas.intro:
The monster invasion resulted in a worldwide shortage of medical supplies.
 Worried by the situation, Maline, the medical officer of Siam Square,
 spent her own savings on medical supplies.
 Now she needs a kind adventurer to help
 deliver the supplies to the affected regions.
pasos: 1. Deliver the medical supplies to \n Medic Sun at Deserted Ruins.
2. Deliver the medical supplies to \n Medic Sho at Bayan Village.
3. Deliver the medical supplies to \n Medic Brin at Shuwa Market.
4. Deliver the medical supplies to \n Medic Len at Mariam Waterway.
5. Report to Maline for your reward.

filas.intro:
Narges, the songstress of Mahal Altar
 lost her instruments when monsters raided the temple.
 Now homeless, she needs your help to find her instruments in order to earn a living.
pasos:
1. Find the instruments: 
 Razor Guard: 
 Azure Flower/c$9%36990%/c*/ 20. 
 Victorious Tulito: 
 Flaming Hoop/c$9%36991%/c*/ 1.
2. Return the instruments to Narges.

filas.intro:
Lole's father who used to be a cleaner in Mahal Altar,
 was badly injured by a pack of monstrous wolves
 when the temple was attacked.
 He needs your help to exterminate the wolves
 to prevent them from hurting anyone again.
pasos:
1. Defeat the monsters: 
 Dark Fighter: /c$9%36992%/c*/ 20. 
Ironfist Master: /c$9%36993%/c*/ 20.
 Flame Hunter Syber: /c$9%36994%/c*/ 1.
2. Report to Lole for your rewards.

filas.intro:
Lady Gina,16th generation descendant
 of General Tokko of Jade Tasset City,/n heard of an anti-aging oil-cleansing facial mask
 that can be found in Mahal Altar. Vain as she is,
 she is determined to find the mask to preserve her beauty for eternity.
 Help her collect the ingredients for the mask!
pasos:
1. Collect the materials: 
 Carnivore Clam: 
 Ashen Pearl/c$9%36995%/c*/ 25. 
 Tangerine Diva: 
 Sweet Pollen/c$9%36996%/c*/ 25.
2. Give the ingredients to Lady Gina.

filas.intro:
Even the King of Muay Thai has his troubles!
 Sates is frustrated with his disciple Aden after an argument
 over Muay Thai. In his attempt to prove that speed
 is the essence of Muay Thai,
 he wants you to help him collect materials for speed training.
pasos:
1. Collect the materials for Sonic Gauntlet: 
 Pastel Knight: 
 Red Feeler/c$9%36997%/c*/ 25. 
 Knitting Soldier: 
 Blue Feeler/c$9%36998%/c*/ 25.
2. Give the materials to Sates.

filas.intro:
Aden, disciple of Sates the King of Muay Thai,
 doubts his master's teaching after losing a match.
 Aden has decided that strength is the true essence of Muay Thai,
 and is looking for someone to help him prove his theory.
pasos:
1. Collect the materials for Super Gauntlet: 
 Diver Croc: 
 Sharp Croc Fangs/c$9%36999%/c*/ 25. 
 Killer Croc Syn: 
 Crimson Croc Fangs/c$9%37000%/c*/ 1.
2. Give the materials to Aden.

filas.intro:
When disaster fell upon Bayan, the ray of brilliance
 emitted from the White Peacock King illuminated
 the night sky. Peafowlian Saeren is looking
 for someone to investigate Mahal Altar
 to find out more.
pasos: 1. Gather from Poison Elves: \n Tattered Scriptures/c$9%37001%/c*/ 25.
2. Give the Tattered Scriptures to Saeren.
3. Collect from Elderly Clams: \n Rainbow Pearl/c$9%37002%/c*/ 25.
4. Find the Mini Throne on\n the lakeside of Mahal Altar.
5. Give the Mini Throne to Saeren.

filas.intro:
Thanks to the investigations,
 the history between the White Peacock King and
 Mahal Altar has been revealed. Saeren hopes
 that you can help retrieve the Peahen Scroll and find a girl
 named Haka in Mahal Altar.
pasos: 1. Defeat Guardian Yasha to obtain\n the Peahen Scroll.
2. Destroy Beast Guardians: /c$9%37005%/c*/ 25.
3. Pass the Peahen Scroll to Haka.

filas.intro:
With the Peahen Scroll in her hands,
 Haka shall proceed to the chambers of White Peacock King
 in order to cleanse Mahal Altar of the evil presence.
 Defeat the corrupted statues that block her path in Mahal Altar.
pasos: 1. Defeat King Lanka.
2. Defeat Beast Fyane.
3. Report to Haka.
4. Give the Black Peacock Feather to Saeren.

filas.intro:
ピザを作るだけで精一杯の
ますたのんの代わりに、ピザを
「Mr.ビックスノウ」に届けて欲しい
とお願いされた！
pasos:
1.エンジェル学園に居る

　「Mr.ビックスノウ」にピザ

　を届ける

2.いずれかの街の

　「ますたのん」に配達の完了

　を報告する

filas.intro:
Since time immemorial, the elusive wood sylphs would scavenge from the Steel Faction. 
They would then recycle their finds in Florentia, their homeland beneath the desert.
 One day, the sylphs requested for Eden’s aid. 
Could this be related to the Earth Goddess, Rhea’s disappearance?
pasos: 1. Head over to the Metal Scrapyard (located beneath the Scrap Iron Village), \nand assist Captain Tauro with the battle.

2. Defeat the Hopeful's enemies!\n
Midori Snippers：/c$9%40462%/c*/ 125\n
Cherry Sprites：/c$9%40463%/c*/ 125
3. Report back to Tauro.
4. Defeat Prickly Maus to get the key.
5. Bring the Cuffs Key to Tauro.

6. Find and rescue 3 captives from the Metal Scrapyard:

  Camellia：/c$9%40464%/c*/ 1

  Lily：/c$9%40465%/c*/ 1

  Narcissus：/c$9%40466%/c*/ 1
7. The rescue was successful. Report to Tauro.
8. Collect your reward.

filas.intro: A civil war has broken out in Florentia. \nBlessed by the Earth Goddess, the Sleepers are easily overwhelming their enemies.\n With the Goddess' aid, the land will soon fall apart!
pasos: 1. Head to Rusty Pipe Lane to help Lupin.
2. Ask the Ailment Sage for an antidote to the\nZ-Drug that is affecting the Earth Goddess.
3. Deliver the antidote to Lupin.

4. Stop the Sleepers' march!\n
  Perfume Fairies：/c$9%40467%/c*/ 150
5. Report to Lupin.

6. Defeat Devil's Snares and collect Pulse Bombs:\n /c$9%40468%/c*/ 10
 Blow up the Sleepers' supplies located west of Rusty Pile Lane!
7. Supplies destroyed. Report to Lupin.
8. Collect your reward.

filas.intro: The sudden change in the Earth Goddess brought chaos upon Florentia. \nThe country, once known for its beautiful flora and fauna, \nis nothing but fire and rubble now.
pasos: 1. Head to Joaquin and assist Raiden Weis with the rescue efforts.

2. Defeat the Sleepers' troops!\n
  Withered Beans: /c$9%40469%/c*/ 150\n
  Jade Butterfly Fae: /c$9%40470%/c*/ 175
3. Inform Raiden Weis that peace has been restored.

4. Defeat the Mad Squirrels in the outskirts of Joaquin and collect\n
  Evening Dew: /c$9%40471%/c*/ 99
5. Bring the Evening Dew to Raiden Weis.

6. Defeat the Sleeper guard outside Joaquin：\n
  Cherubic Babe
7. Inform Raiden Weis that the Sleepers have been driven off.
8. Speak to Raiden Weis again.

filas.intro:
The young wood sylphs wanted to contact the Goddess,
 but they are not well versed in the ancient ways. 
When all hope seemed lost, someone remembered the quirky Elder Stone. 
Surely the Elder would know how to contact the Earth Goddess!
 The tricky part is to convince him...
pasos: 1. Look for Elder Stone in Scrap Iron Works,\n located on the outskirts of town.

2. Check the sand mounds around Scrap Iron Works and collect\n
  Steel Gears: /c$9%40472%/c*/ 40
3. Hand the Steel Gears over to Elder Stone.

4. Defeat the rowdy\n
  Walking Seed Spitters: /c$9%40473%/c*/ 100\n
  Youthful Seamstresses: /c$9%40474%/c*/ 150
5. Check if Elder Stone has any other requests for you.
6. Inform Raiden Weis in Joaquin that Elder Stone failed to persuade the Earth Goddess.
7. Receive Raiden Weis' thanks.

filas.intro:
The Hopefuls were unable to accept the Earth Goddess’
 decision to sacrifice their kingdom. 
They attempted to negotiate with the goddess, 
but were ultimately forced to raid her palace when she stubbornly refused to listen.
 Can the angels make the right decision in time?
pasos: 1. Look for Captain Shiffy in Sylvan Gardens, \nlocated west of Joaquin.
2. Ambush the Green Apple Jellies: /c$9%40475%/c*/ 200
3. Inform Captain Shiffy that the task is complete.

4. Burn the 3 largest flowers in Sylvan Gardens!

  Huge Lily：/c$9%40476%/c*/ 1 

  Huge Sunflower：/c$9%40477%/c*/ 1 

  Huge Narcissus：/c$9%40478%/c*/ 1
Report to Captain Shiffy.

6.Take down the escaping enemies!\n
  Rouge Flutterflies：/c$9%40479%/c*/ 150 \n
  Purple Budsies：/c$9%40480%/c*/ 150
7. Peace has been restored to Sylvan Gardens. Report to Captain Shiffy.
8. Collect your reward from Captain Shiffy.

filas.intro:
With the angels' help, the tides were turned. 
However, the Sleepers still had a card up their sleeves! 
Mechanized troops created with parts stolen from the Iron Castle were stationed at the kingdom’s largest port. 
There, they began a bloody counterattack...
pasos:
1.Defend the harbor!\n
  Ocean Nautilus：/c$9%40481%/c*/ 200\n 
  Beryl Pixies：/c$9%40482%/c*/ 200
2. Prevent the enemy from unloading the cargo. \nReport back to Captain Shiffy.

3.Defeat the enemy commanders!\n
  Fearless Ablo：/c$9%40483%/c*/ 1 \n
  Sir Pitter Pan：/c$9%40484%/c*/ 1
4. Enemy commanders defeated. \nReport to Captain Shiffy in Sylvan Gardens.
