5. Return to Paua Shell Harbor and capture the fleeing Team Leader Dendrob.
6. Bring Team Leader Dendrob to Minister Roselia via Drip-drop Passage.
7. Minister Roselia praised you.

filas.intro:
After a long battle, you’re finally at the Earth Goddess’ palace. 
A dejected goddess stands before you. She works with neither the angels nor the demons. 
What is she after? Is it peace? Or never-ending war? 
To uncover the truth and save the land from destruction, you’ll have to jump into battle!
pasos:
1.Clear a path for the Hopefuls by defeating the Earth Goddess' minions!\n
  Rusty Crocodiles：/c$9%40485%/c*/ 200 \n
  Tendrillons：/c$9%40486%/c*/ 200
2. Mission completed. Report to Minister Roselia.

3.You'll need the following items to break the palace's barrier:

  Withered Glories' Sun Forged Crystals：

  /c$9%40487%/c*/ 10

  Empress Padine's Earth Stone Wheel：

  /c$9%40488%/c*/ 1
4. The sacred items have been gathered.\n Hand them to Minister Roselia.
5. The scouts that went into Floral Palace have yet to return. \nEnter the palace and find them!
6. Inform Minister Roselia that the rescue mission was successful.
7. Collect your reward from Minister Roselia.

filas.intro: When Greenie was still a child, she got lost in the Floral Palace’s walkways. \nThe Earth Goddess found her and led her out.\n If only their goddess would smile upon the people with that warm and gentle smile again...
pasos:
1.Enter the Floral Palace and map out the garden maze.

  Central Parterre：/c$9%40489%/c*/ 1

  North Parterre：/c$9%40490%/c*/ 1

  East Parterre：/c$9%40491%/c*/ 1

  South Parterre：/c$9%40492%/c*/ 1
2. Give Greenie the map of Floral Garden.
3. Lend a listening ear to Greenie.

filas.intro: A soldier from a northern country has joined Eden’s rescue squad. \nAlthough the warm climate is different from his frigid motherland, \nit won't stop him from completing this mission.
pasos:
1.Defeat Floral Palace's\n
  Eightwings：/c$9%40493%/c*/ 40
2. Mission completed. Report back to Dmitri.
3.  Mission Completed. Report to Dmitri.

filas.intro: Eden’s rescue squad has restored peace to Florentia. \nSector by sector, they pushed the goddess’ army back . \nWatching her army retreat was a blow to her ego.
pasos:
1. Defeat the monsters in the south part of Floral Palace!\n
  Rainbow Ferns：/c$9%40494%/c*/ 25\n
  Bihorn Crocodiles：/c$9%40495%/c*/ 20
2. Report to Kayusha.
3. Mission completed. Report to Kayusha.

filas.intro: Warrior Leford never thought that he would have to point his sword at the Earth Goddess...  \nMemories of her flooded through his mind as he barged through the Floral Palace. He wouldn't succumb to his wounds just yet. \n Justice shall prevail!
pasos:
1.Defeat the enemies obstructing the warrior's path!\n
  Elite - Bouncy Leafballs：/c$9%40496%/c*/ 35
2. Inform Warrior Leford that the obstacles have been removed.
3. Accept Warrior Leford's thanks.

filas.intro: In a fit of madness, Queen Franca released the evil demon, Jabberku, from confinement.  \nIt has destroyed much of the ecosystem, leaving barren wastelands in its wake. \n In order to protect this land, you must destroy this demonic bug!
pasos: 1.Exterminate Razor Jabberku in Floral Palace!
2. Crisis averted. Report to Bombabi

filas.intro:
When the Earth Goddess stopped communicating with the people,  
the queen decided to protect the goddess at all costs. 
 She secluded herself within the Floral Palace and raised an army of elite troops.  
If the queen is not defeated, the country will continue spiralling into chaos!
pasos: 1.Defeat Queen Franca and restore peace to the land!
2. Report to Yelos.

filas.intro:
The Sleepers refused to surrender despite their dwindling numbers.  
To prevent further bloodshed,  
the Hopefuls decided to send an elite squad to negotiate with the Goddess.  
If she lifts the seal, the war will finally end.
pasos: 1. Brave the obstacles of the Floral Palace \nand speak with Earth Goddess Rhea!\n If words cannot reach her, use force!
2. Convince the Earth Goddess and report to Minister Roselia.

filas.intro: It's only natural for those from the desert to appreciate the beauty of lush vegetation.  \nBut when one goes too far trying to create the perfect flora, \n the results may be regrettable...
pasos:
1. Destroy the genetically modified plants:\n
Elite - Turret Plant /c$9%40497%/c*/ 30.
2. Biological hazard eliminated. Notify Botanist Knowles.
3. Sign Botanist Knowles' receipt and collect the reward.

filas.intro: Smith Polo maintains Scrap Iron Village's defensive facilities.  \nHowever, he lost his tools in the recent monster attack. \n Help him complete the maintenance.
pasos:
1. Drive the monsters out and collect the materials: 

Fuzzy Squirrels /c$9%40368%/c*/ 100.

Collect Screws /c$9%40369%/c*/ 50. 

Collect Nuts /c$9%40370%/c*/ 50.
2. Return to Polo and collect your reward.

filas.intro: Hershy is the mischievous kid from Scrap Iron Village.  \nThe monsters that fall prey to his vicious pranks seldom bother the village again.  \nHelp Hershy gather the equipment for his latest prank.
pasos: 1. Defeat Muddy Man-eaters and look for signs of vines.
2. Give the suspicious looking vines to Hershy.
3. Defeat Pollutias and look for signs of firm vines.
4. Give the vines to Hershy.

filas.intro:
Monsters are disrupting the peace in Rusty Pipe Lane.  
The area chiefs, Bummer and Nehru,  
are putting up a resistance but they can't hold out forever.  
Please help them!
pasos: 1. Drive away the Buzzflies wreaking havoc in the east: \n/c$9%40375%/c*/ 50
2. Report to Bummer.
3. Find Nehru.
4. Get rid of the Tentablooms in the west:\n /c$9%40376%/c*/ 100.
5. Report to Nehru.

6. A swarm of monsters has appeared! \n
Destroy Rust Flies: /c$9%40377%/c*/ 200.
7. Return to Nehru to collect your reward.

filas.intro: A girl wearing a strange flower as a hat appears to be dying from starvation.  \nCan you help her?
pasos:
1. Collect Fresh Prunes from Perfume Fairies:\n
/c$9%40379%/c*/ 100.
2. Give the Fresh Prunes to Yummy Yummy.
3. Speak to Yummy Yummy after she finishes her meal.

4. Clear a path for Yummy Yummy to return home: \n
Defeat Stealth Chameleons: /c$9%40380%/c*/ 100.
5. Return to Yummy Yummy to collect your reward.

filas.intro: A little boy watches you with curious eyes.  \nTry talking to him!
pasos:
1. Put a stop to the Mad Squirrels: \n
/c$9%40382%/c*/ 100.
2. Return to Chomp Chomp to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Joaquin may be mesmerizing,  \nbut Dia thinks she can make it even more beautiful! \n All she needs is a helper.
pasos:
1. Collect suitable fertilizer: \n
Greenish Essence /c$9%40384%/c*/ 50.\n
Purplish Essence /c$9%40385%/c*/ 50.

2. Let's spice up this place:

Apply fertilizer in the east

/c$9%40387%/c*/ 1.

Apply fertilizer in the south

/c$9%40388%/c*/ 1.

Apply fertilizer in the west

/c$9%40389%/c*/ 1.

Apply fertilizer in the north

/c$9%40390%/c*/ 1.
3. Return to Dia to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Despite the repairs,  \nthe pipes in Scrap Iron Works are still emitting weird noises.  \nHelp Penway locate the problem.
pasos:
1. Defeat Walking Seed Spitter: 

/c$9%40391%/c*/ 100. 

Collect Spare Parts: 

/c$9%40392%/c*/ 10.
2. Repair the broken pipe.
3. Report to Penway.
4. Defeat Dragan the Guard.
5. Return to Penway to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Muty is troubled by the number of tools that were loaned out but not returned.  \nHelp him recover them.
pasos:
1. Recover the loaned tools:

Blunt Drill 

/c$9%40395%/c*/ 1.

Curved Screwdriver 

/c$9%40396%/c*/ 1.

Toothless Scissors 

/c$9%40397%/c*/ 1.
2. Return to Muty to collect your reward.

filas.intro: The scent of Sylvan Gardens has recently attracted some vile creatures.  \nDo not let these creatures taint this pure land!
pasos:
1. Defeat Swift Spitters: \n
/c$9%40399%/c*/ 50.
2. Report to Kazey.
3. Find Parcopak and pass on Kazey's message.
4. Collect Delicious Nuts: /c$9%40400%/c*/ 50.
5. Return to Parcopak to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Sylvan Gardens is a land of treasures to travelling botanists like Mida.  \nHowever, the gardeners do not take kindly to outsiders. \n Help Mida break the ice!
pasos: 1. Defeat Worrisome Gardeners: /c$9%40402%/c*/ 50.
2. Report to Mida.

3. Collect the seeds to be used for research.

Scattered Seeds 

/c$9%40403%/c*/ 100.

Precious Seedlings 

/c$9%40404%/c*/ 1.
4. Report to Mida.
5. Return the seeds and seedlings to Kapu.
6. Return to Mida to collect your reward.

filas.intro: The artisan, Shana, heard that rare shells can be found at Paua Shell Harbor.  \nTo gather the materials needed to make a necklace,  \nshe needs someone who can get past the monsters.
pasos: 1. Defeat Naughty Rakusa: /c$9%40406%/c*/ 100.

2. Collect the necklace materials:

Beautiful Shells 

/c$9%40408%/c*/ 10.

Mystic Shells 

/c$9%40409%/c*/ 10.
3. Return to Shana to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Zac, a skilled mechanic, has lost his precious tool bag while on duty!  \nPlease help him retrieve it!
pasos: 1. Recover the lost tool: /c$9%40410%/c*/ 1.
2. Return to Zac to collect your reward.

filas.intro: A grand eating contest will be held soon and Champ Champ  \nwill be able to showcase his ability to eat.  \nEnsure that the contest won't be cancelled!
pasos:
1. Gather the necessary ingredients for the contest:\n
Alligator Meat /c$9%40412%/c*/ 100.\n
Juicy Vegetables /c$9%40413%/c*/ 100.
2. Return to Champ Champ and hand over the ingredients.
3. Help Champ Champ drive away Berserker Brad.
Return and talk to Champ Champ to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Treasure hunter Verna has heard rumours of treasure lying within Drip-drop Passage.  \nAssist her on her treasure hunt!
pasos: 1. Defeat Naughty Flies: /c$9%40416%/c*/ 50.
2. Return to Verna and help her open the treasure chest.
3. Speak to Verna about deciphering the strange words.

4. Defeat the specified monsters to break the seal:

Explosive Audrey /c$9%40418%/c*/ 1.

Jelly Diane /c$9%40419%/c* 1.

Passionate Rosie /c$9%40420%/c*/ 1.
5. Try opening the treasure chest again.
6. Return to Verna to collect your reward.

filas.intro: Vulcania is situated on a volcanic mountain by Goblin Valley. The cheery inhabitants usually spend their days peacefully and joyfully in this quiet town. But the animals on the mountain have suddenly gone berserk, and the townspeople are pleading for help. We must hurry!
pasos: 1. Hurry to the Brilliant Boneyard by the Goblin Valley, and talk to Captain Rezz for more details.

2. Help the Captain drive away the following:
Pirty: /c$9%42657%/c* / 50
Bonfur: /c$9%42658%/c* / 50
3. Report back to Captain Rezz.

4. Defeat the invaders:
Treeker: /c$9%42659%/c* / 150
5. Tell Captain Rezz that the enemies have been defeated.
6. Defeat the mighty Midorix, and obtain its precious stone.
7. Hand over the loot to Captain Rezz, and you'll get a reward.

filas.intro: The townsfolk have venerated the Hellfire Razorex for years, but it has suddenly flown into a violent rage. Perhaps this is the reason why the animals in the area have gone berserk. Right now, our top priority is to put an end to the unrest. But you can't help wondering if there's more than meets the eye...
pasos: 1. Go to Ivory Forest, hand over the gem to Pilgrim Cantobur and tell him what happened, to set his mind at ease.

2. Defeat Pilgrim Cantobur's enemies:
Tackie: /c$9%42661%/c* / 150
3. Report back to Pilgrim Cantobur.

4. Scare off the enemies:
Mocha Woof: /c$9%42662%/c* / 100
5. Tell Pilgrim Cantobur that you've dealt with the naughty woofies.

6. Defeat the one who planned the arson attempt:
Maddi Brawler
7. Mission complete! Report back to Pilgrim Cantobur to get your reward.

filas.intro: The unrest and the disappointment with Razorex has affected worshippers, and the temple is no longer wrathed in incense. But rumors say that an outsider is still standing guard near the temple. If we go look for that loyal worshipper, we might be able to find info that will give us hope.
pasos: 1. Proceed to the neglected Razorex Temple to look for Scholar Duffel. You might be able to get more info from him.
2. You can't get into the shrine. This calls for an investigation.
3. Ask the Magic Teacher if there's a way to get into the shrine...

4. Exterminate the monsters around the shrine first:
Goldilocks: /c$9%42666%/c* / 100
Sunpetal Crab: /c$9%42667%/c* / 100
5. Sprinkle the dispel potion on the shrine.
6. Tell Scholar Duffel about the situation at the temple. He might know what's going on behind the scenes...
7. Defeat the powerful Ragey Kraver, and retrieve the research notes.
8. Now that you have the precious research notes, hand them to Scholar Duffel to get your reward.

filas.intro: The animals' unrest really is linked to Razorex's rage after all. And there might be more to the story too. To save Vulcania and the rest of Eden, we must put out the flames, and find out the truth...
pasos: 1. We're getting closer to the truth, but first, we must go to Whitefang Village to get more info from Firefae Sazzy.

2. Get the stones you need to revive Firefae Sazzy:
Brilliant Boneyard Gem: /c$9%42670%/c* / 1
Razorex Temple Gem: /c$9%42671%/c* / 1
3. Hurry! Give these gems to Firefae Sazzy now!

4. Protect everyone by defeating the monsters attacking Whitefang Village:
Firazard: /c$9%42672%/c* / 150
Charming Clyde: /c$9%42673%/c* / 100
5. Tell Firefae Sazzy that Whitefang Village is safe now.
6. Give the research notes to Practitioner Katos in Ivory Forest, and obtain the Icy Cactus.
7. Give the Icy Cactus to Firefae Sazzy in Whitefang Village, and obtain your reward.

filas.intro: Evil whispered in the ears of the Hellfire Razorex, driving it wild, and the same evil has affected the animals too. We must put a stop to it now, before the taint spreads. For everyone in Vulcania, and all our comrades!
pasos: 1. Now that we've determined what's driving Razorex mad, we must hurry to Sleepy Spring to talk to Elder Kaji.

2. Prove you're worthy by defeating the monsters surrounding Sleepy Spring:
Mithribot: /c$9%42675%/c* / 125
Scalded Chimp: /c$9%42676%/c* / 125
3. Tell Elder Kaji that Sleepy Spring's surroundings are now safe.

4. Prove how patient you are by retrieving Crystal Water from the spring:
Crystal Water: /c$9%42677%/c* / 40 vials
5. Now that you've collected enough Crystal Water, it's time to report back to Elder Kaji.
6. Prove your powers of concentration by defeating the impressive Captain Slashazard, and retrieving the Razorex Badge.
7. Give the Razorex Badge to Elder Kaji to get your reward.

filas.intro: The only way to put an end to it all is to defeat Hellfire Razorex. To do that, we must first find a way to weaken it. With immense effort, we've managed to procure Ephemeral Ice and Crystal Water, the two items we need for this task. But before we begin, we must find someone...
pasos: 1. Now that we have these two precious items, it's time to pay a visit to Lord Wulfe at Transient Waters, to update him on the situation at hand.

2. Defeat the monsters surrounding the lake:
Kyaru Molly: /c$9%42679%/c* / 200
Gardenix: /c$9%42680%/c* / 200
3. Report to Lord Wulfe, and tell him that the monsters have been defeated.

4. Maybe there's still hope left. Help Lord Wulfe to retrieve something needed for the ceremony from Limehot Dogs.
Mustard Stick: /c$9%42681%/c* / 20
5. Give the juicy Mustard Sticks to Lord Wulfe.
6. Talk to Lord Wulfe to get your reward.

filas.intro: Hellfire Razorex may be near, but prayers can no longer reach it. We have no choice; we must solve this via violent means. Once we've completed the weakening ceremony, we may be able to save Vulcania and all of Eden. The final battle is about to begin!
pasos: 1. Since Lord Wulfe has already made up his mind, help him pass his message to Priestess Opheria.

2. You need to get the key from Halefire Baston in order to unlock the temple mechanism:
Temple Key: /c$9%42682%/c* / 1
3. Now that you have the key, report back to Priestess Opheria.

4. Defeat the following monsters so that they won't harass Priestess Opheria:
Ashen Mudmon: /c$9%42684%/c* / 200
Rocker Wuff: /c$9%42685%/c* / 150
5. Now that you've driven away those monsters, it's time to report back to Priestess Opheria.

6. To weaken Razorex, you must first sprinkle Crystal Water at the following spots: 
Razorex's Thoughts: /c$9%42686%/c* / 1
Razorex's Calm: /c$9%42687%/c* / 1
Razorex's Regard: /c$9%42688%/c* / 1
Razorex's Kindness: /c$9%42689%/c* / 1
7. Now that you've dampened Razorex's rage, return to the temple to place the Ephemeral Ice and the Brilliant Shell.
8. The ceremony is now complete. Return to Priestess Opheria for your reward.

filas.intro: Chef Sasha has come to Brilliant Boneyard in search of inspiration. Unfortunately, he has no hunting skills to speak off, even though his cooking skill is superb. Let's help him get ingredients!
pasos:
1. Chef Sasha wants you to get the following ingredients for him:
From Pweetys:
Juicy Bone: /c$9%42691%/c* / 25
From Pitchie Blues:
Nutritious Leaf: /c$9%42692%/c* / 25
2. Return to Chef Sasha for your reward.

filas.intro: Barrie is always boasting to his friends. That's not the kind of behavior we should encourage, but he's in a pretty sad state anyway, so why don't we help him out?
pasos: 1. Defeat Treekanes to get Treeka Trophies: /c$9%42694%/c* / 20
2. Once you've collected enough, give them to Barrie.
3. Defeat Barbaleaf Clubbers to get Barba Trophies: /c$9%42695%/c* / 15
4. Give the Trophies to Barrie to get your reward.

filas.intro: Florami simply loves flowers. But ever since that scary attack in Ivory Forest, she's been too scared to pick any flowers. Let's cheer her up by sending her some flowers!
pasos:
1. Help Florami get flowers from the Ivory Forest:
Pretty Flower: /c$9%42697%/c* / 50
2. Give the flowers to Florami, and she'll give you a warm smile.

filas.intro: Peter Woofe has been running around in the woods ever since he was a kid. His top peeve is that his shoes spoil way too easily. What's more, the recent chaos has made it impossible to move freely through the woods. Help him regain his carefree, energetic life!
pasos:
1. Hunt Matcha Woofs to get the materials you need: 
Soft Fur: /c$9%42699%/c* / 10 pieces
2. Give the Soft Fur you've collected to Peter Woofe.

3. Drive away the monsters in Ivory Forest:
Granite Crab: /c$9%42700%/c* / 75
4. Report back to Peter Woofe to get your reward.

filas.intro: Howle is a pious member of Vulcania. He used to visit the temple once every two days, and then started visiting daily to pray for his senior when his senior left. However, the recent unrest has kept him home out of fear for his safety. Help him clear the path, so that he may visit the temple again!
pasos:
1. Defeat the monsters roaming the Razorex Temple:
Tofu Chix: /c$9%42702%/c* / 100
2. Report back to Howle to reassure him, and get your reward.

filas.intro: Ray's job is to keep the Razorex Temple clean. But ever since the animals started acting up, he has been forcing himself to sweep the corridors despite fearing for his life. Cleaning might be his job, but we shouldn't let him face this every day! Let's go give him a hand.
pasos:
1. Collect the following:
Get from Captain Bluies:
Extra Strong Detergent: /c$9%42704%/c* / 40 packs
Get from Snowilocks:
Soft Cloth: /c$9%42705%/c* / 40 pieces
2. Give the supplies to Ray.

3. Start cleaning the statue:
Magnificent Statue: /c$9%42706%/c* / 1
4. Return to Ray for your reward.

filas.intro: Merchant Mich once fainted while travelling, and was found by two Whitefang villagers. He wants to express his gratitude by giving them food supplies, but he needs your help to distribute them.
pasos:
1. Hunt Roasty Crabs for:
Yummy Meat: /c$9%42708%/c* / 50 pieces

2. Secretly deliver the meat to the villagers.
Chiwa's Home: /c$9%42709%/c* / 1
Miyo's Home: /c$9%42710%/c* / 1
3. Report back to Merchant Mich. Let him know that the food has been distributed, and get your reward.

filas.intro: Sazzy was born with a natural birth defect, and that made her feel insecure about herself, so she left home. But she couldn't help thinking of her sister Sammi, so she secretly protects her. Help Sazzy keep Sammi safe by driving away the monsters near Sammi.
pasos:
1. Help Firefae Sazzy defeat these monsters:
Smiling Mudmon: /c$9%42712%/c* / 75
2. Talk to Firefae Sazzy again.

3. Help Firefae Sazzy defeat these monsters:
Chillihot Dog: /c$9%42713%/c* / 75
4. Talk to Firefae Sazzy to get your reward.

filas.intro: Sparky loves soaking in hot springs. He really didn't expect to find monkeys spoiling his stay at Sleepy Spring though. Help him get rid of the monkeys so that he can enjoy a good long soak!
pasos:
1. Teach those monkeys a lesson:
Grumpy Chimp: /c$9%42715%/c* / 50
2. Report back to Sparky.
3. Get the soap back from the Punkazards: /c$9%42716%/c* / 1 block
4. Take the soap back to Sparky to get your reward.

filas.intro: Wayne is a geologist. He's visiting Vulcania to study the hot springs here. Unfortunately, he's misplaced the research records that his team leader gave him. Help him get them back again!
pasos: 1. Get the research records from the Sunburnt Hunters: /c$9%42718%/c* / 1 page
2. Give the page to Wayne.
3. Get the glasses from Kyaru Mixies: /c$9%42719%/c* / 50 pairs
4. Give the records and the glasses to Wern, the research team leader.
5. Talk to Wayne to get your reward.

filas.intro: Postbird Ozzie has always delivered messages to Nate on time. But Nate hasn't seen Ozzie all day, and he can't leave the bridge without permission. Help Nate find out what happened to Ozzie!
pasos: 1. Help Nate look for Ozzie in Transient Waters.
2. Look for the missing postal bag from Hyper Harries: /c$9%42721%/c* / 1 bag
3. Give the bag to Ozzie.
4. Tell Nate what happened to get your reward.

filas.intro: Felix's grandfather and great grandfather were famous fishermen. He wants to uphold the family reputation by becoming one himself, and to do that, he'll have to catch a Rainbow Carp. Unfortunately, he doesn't have enough bait to achieve his dream. Let's help him out!
pasos:
1. Get the following from Bluebeat Knights:
Fresh Bait: /c$9%42723%/c* / 50
2. Give the bait to Felix.

3. Get the following from Smart Simons so that you can strengthen your fishing equipment:
Super Glue: /c$9%42724%/c* / 10
4. Give the super glue to Felix to get your reward.

filas.intro: When there's a war, there's bound to be a merchant selling war supplies. Natalie wanted to sell weapons here to earn some cash, but her cargo has been stolen! Let's help her get her goods back.
pasos:
1. Retrieve the following from Pichizards:
Razor Sharp Weapons: /c$9%42726%/c* / 75
2. Give the weapons to Natalie.

3. Retrieve the following from Tinder Squirrels:
Sturdy Shields: /c$9%42727%/c* / 75
4. Give the shields to Natalie to get your reward.

filas.intro: Morris is a magic fanatic. Not only is he obsessed with spells, he dreams of creating powerful magic that can rid the world of all evil. Well, no one knows if that's actually possible, but surely we must help out with such a glorious dream!
pasos:
1. Prove your worth by defeating the following monsters:
Blood Mozzie: /c$9%42729%/c* / 100
2. Report back to Morris.

3. Defeat the following monsters to get the ceremonial items:
Ghastly Moski: /c$9%42730%/c* / 1
Viva Tentawok: /c$9%42731%/c* / 1
4. Report back to Morris to get your reward.

filas.intro: Elder Howld of the Whitefang Village is Razorex’s loyal disciple. He see it as his duty to protect Flamefang Sanctum. However, a group of rowdy monsters seek to defile it. Help the elder dole out divine punishment!
pasos:
1. Head down to Flamefang Sanctum and banish some monsters in the front chamber!
Lava Mudmon: /c$9%43307%/c*/ 15
Bunsen Mudmon: /c$9%43308%/c*/ 15
2. Report back to Elder Howld to receive your reward.

filas.intro: The gourmand, Phil, is on a food pilgrimage, wandering the world in search of delicious food to satiate his appetite. Rumors have it that a delectable morsel is cooking in Vulcania, and he decides to stop by for a bite or two. However, the road is full of vicious monsters. Help Phil obtain that elusive delicacy!
pasos:
1. Head out to the deepest part of Flamefang Sanctum and obtain the following from Mintihot Dogs:
 Fresh Sausage: /c$9%43309%/c*/ 20
2. Let Phil know that you've collected the food items.

filas.intro: Monsters wreaking havoc across the lands has corrupted Vulcania’s hot spring. This sudden turn of events is causing much grief to Mr. Soup. He sent in a request for some volcanic essence to turn this vile pool of evil back to its former glory.
pasos:
1. Proceed to the main chamber in Flamefang Sanctum and retrieve the following from Nyanhell Knights or Snowarixes:
 Volcanic Essence: /c$9%43310%/c*/ 30
2. Report to Mr. Soup.

filas.intro: The Razorex Temple holds an artifact that keeps the monsters at bay. When Razorex went berserk, the holy artifact shattered, and the shards were stolen not long after. Seer Zeon has made a prediction that the shards will appear in Flamefang Sanctum. Hurry over and retrieve the shards.
pasos:
1. Head down to the middle chamber in Flamefang Sanctum and obtain the following from Fiery Chirizards:
  Holy Artifact Shard: /c$9%43311%/c*/ 20
2. Report back to Seer Zeon and get your reward.

filas.intro: The biologist, Charles, plans to observe the lake’s ecosystem. But he doesn’t have the proper equipment to enter the waters for his research. Help Charles gather materials from Flamefang Sanctum to build his equipment!
pasos:
1. Head over to Flamefang Sanctum and obtain the following from Beetlesap Dukes or Saucy Crabbadads:
  Soft Shell: /c$9%43312%/c*/ 30
2. Report back to Biologist Charles to get your reward.

filas.intro: With everyone's help, Razorex's madness was quelled and peace has been restored to Vulcania. But then, Furnace Guard Sander senses a disturbance in the treasure room in Flamefang Sanctum. Is there still evil afoot?
pasos: 1. Head down to the treasure room in Flamefang Sanctum and defeat Infernal Lavamon!
2. You've defeated Infernal Lavamon! Return to Whitefang Village and speak to Furnace Guard Sander.

filas.intro: The plan to restore Razorex's sanity has failed! The evil has corrupted him so much that defeating Infernal Lavamon only pushed him deeper into madness. The only way left to free Razorex is to beat the evil out of him, for good!
pasos: 1. Head over to the main chamber in Flamefang Sanctum and defeat the corrupted Razorex!
2. Let Warrior Wolfie know that you've defeated the corrupted Razorex.

filas.intro: The goddess of Vulcania may be immune to the corruption, but she is known to have a foul temper. Annoyed by the recent upheaval, her anger has destabilized the volcano and the land has plunged into chaos once more...
pasos: 1. Head down to the deepest parts of Flamefang Sanctum and defeat the rampaging Satrixia!
2. Inform Firefae Feena that you've nullified Satrixia's rage and that the volcano is now stable.

filas.intro: Vidar has been dutifully hunting down monsters on the Starglow Path to keep the area safe for travellers, but he's run into something he can't handle…
pasos:
1. Get rid of the following monsters for Vidar: 
Chickpets: /c$9%47106%/c*/ 50
2. Return to Vidar for your reward.

filas.intro: Reno's torch has been stolen by monsters. Please help gather the materials needed to make another torch.
pasos:
1. Gather materials to make a torch: 
Defeat Loneshroms to get:
Special Stick: /c$9%47108%/c*/ 1 
Defeat Niteycoos to get: 
Phosphorus Powder: /c$9%47109%/c*/ 1 handful
2. Return to Reno for your reward.

filas.intro: Monsters have been chewing away at the precious manuscripts in Academia Woods. Please drive them off.
pasos:
1. Darlene wants you to defeat the following:
Peamo: /c$9%47111%/c*/ 50
2. Return to Darlene for your reward.

filas.intro: The ancient manuscripts scattered about Academia Woods contain precious knowledge passed down from our ancestors. But the monsters have been ripping into them, and there are pages missing from the books that Jadea needs to refer to. Help her find the lost pages!
pasos:
1. Defeat Cheery Charlies to get: 
Lost Pages: /c$9%47113%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Jadea for your reward.

filas.intro:
Carson is a historian who is very interested in the history of the 
Mana City. These days, he's been noticing daily changes in the ruins nearby. Help him check it out!
pasos:
1. Investigate the following areas: 
East Ruins: /c$9%47115%/c*/ 1 
West Ruins: /c$9%47116%/c*/ 1 
South Ruins: /c$9%47117%/c*/ 1 
North Ruins: /c$9%47118%/c*/ 1
2. Return to Carson for your reward.

filas.intro: Pookie has been researching the ruins for years. He knows that the shattered stones hold traces of residual power. And that this power has eventually caused creatures to go berserk. Help retrieve these magical stones from them.
pasos:
1. Defeat Violent Sentinels to get: 
Power Stones: /c$9%47120%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Pookie for your reward.

filas.intro: Ronnie is very dedicated to his job. But his cargo for today has been stolen. Please help him get it back.
pasos:
1. Defeat KerPow Buns to get: 
Stolen Cargo:/c$9%47122%/c*/ 1
2 Return to Ronnie for your reward.

filas.intro: Manny is a famous herbalist from Coo Village. Lots of people seek his herbal concoctions, but the recent spate of monster attacks make it difficult for him to gather any herbs. Help him, so that he can make more medicine.
pasos:
1. Defeat Bottlecap Butlers to get: 
Glow Drops:/c$9%47124%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Manny for your reward.

filas.intro: Kavo is the best chef in Coo Village, and he's looking for ingredients for his next recipe. Ethereal Garden is known for its magical creatures that provide yummy ingredients. Help him collect some!
pasos:
1. Defeat Pealads to get: 
Juicy Leaves: /c$9%47126%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Kavo for your reward.

filas.intro: Chelsea was forced to visit the Ethereal Garden in order to collect materials for her school project. But then she realised that she can't do it on her own. Help her out!
pasos:
1. Defeat Daylilies to get: 
Shine Dew: /c$9%47128%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Chelsea for your reward.

filas.intro: Rianne is in charge of maintaining peace and quiet in the Daydream Library, but ever since the monsters showed up, her work volume has increased tenfold. She really needs help!
pasos:
1. Rianne wants you to defeat the following: 
Karate Buns: /C$9%47130%/C*/ 50
2. Return to Rianne for your reward.

filas.intro: A book in the Daydream Library has mysteriously gone missing. Darcy thinks that it's been stolen by monsters, and he wants you to get the book back.
pasos:
1. Defeat Suth Chymes to get:
The Next Merlin: /c$9%47132%/c*/ 1
2. Return to Darcy for your reward.

filas.intro: Capone's job is to make sure the artworks don't get damaged. But the monsters flooding the place make it really hard for him to do his job. Help him teach the monsters a lesson!
pasos:
1. Capone wants you to defeat the following: 
Matrix Stalkers: /C$9%47134%/C*/ 50
2. Return to Capone for your reward.

filas.intro: The painting that Dallo wanted to sell to Capone has been stolen by monsters! If we don't get it back, Dallo's reputation will be at stake. Do help him out!
pasos:
1. Defeat Trumpetoos to get: 
Untitled Painting A: /c$9%47136%/c*/ 1
2. Return to Dallo for your reward.

filas.intro: The Enchanted Sanctum is the most important part of Magikale, but ever since the mana source started exhibiting signs of instability, the sanctum's defenses have weakened, and monsters have intruded the place. Please go drive the monsters away!
pasos:
1. Enter the Enchanted Sanctum, and drive away the following monsters from the Mystic Lobby.
Peapeachies: /c$9%47145%/c*/ 15
Chickdandies: /c$9%47146%/c*/ 15
2. Report back to Mogol to receive your reward.

filas.intro: Polta's study materials have been stolen by monsters, and they've run into the sanctum! She needs to get the stuff back quick before she gets disciplined by the librarians. Please help her.
pasos:
1. Enter the Enchanted Sanctum, and defeat Aerial Assassins in the Spell Hall to get: 
Study Materials: /c$9%47147%/c*/ 20
2. Hand over the study materials to Polta.

filas.intro: Jacob's art works bring joy to people's hearts, but his most beautiful piece has been stolen by monsters. Please help him get it back, so that people may gaze upon its beauty again.
pasos:
1. Enter the Enchanted Sanctum, and defeat the Manahoot Girgil to get: 
Masterpiece: /c$9%47148%/c*/ 1
2. Tell Jacob that you've found his masterpiece.

filas.intro: Wine-taster Geoffrey has travelled the world in search of rare wines. He just heard of an exquisite wine that's hidden in the depths of the Enchanted Sanctum, and he's not about to let this opportunity slip out of his hands! But alas, the monsters there are too powerful for him to deal with, so he has to ask for your help.
pasos:
1. Enter the Enchanted Sanctum, and defeat Tippler Toms to get: 
Hidden Wine: /c$9%47149%/c*/ 20
2. Report back to Geoffrey to get your reward.

filas.intro: The stone statue guarding the Mana Ruins has been affected by the instability, and has gone berserk. Hwoota needs to find similar statue cores to experiment on, and apparently, the Brass Colossi have appropriate ones. Help him retrieve the cores for the future of Magikale.
pasos:
1. Enter the Enchanted Sanctum, and retrieve the following from Brass Colossi:
Colossus Core: /c$9%47150%/c*/ 20
2. Report back to Hwoota to get your reward.

filas.intro: The corrupted mana source has produced a dangerous beast that thrives on chaos. It has destroyed much of the sanctum's interior, and we mustn't let it out. Please put an end to this monster before it hurts anyone.
pasos: 1. Enter the Beast Lair in the Enchanted Sanctum, and destroy the Arcane Kayote!
2. Now that you've destroyed the beast, hurry back to Coo Village to tell Jerika the good news.

filas.intro: The great mage Datura sacrificed himself to become the vessel for the mana source. But evil forces hiding within the source are wrecking his body. Please find a way to purge him of evil, so that he can rest in peace.
pasos: 1. Enter the Arcane Hall in the Enchanted Sanctum, and defeat Devilish Datura.
2. Tell Ageless Katrin that you have defeated Devilish Datura.

filas.intro: The real culprit that's been hiding within the mana source has finally revealed itself. Armed with magical power, it plans to destroy all of Eden. Stop it!
pasos: 1. Enter the depths of the Enchanted Sanctum, and defeat the Abyssal Drakos.
2. Now that you've defeated the Abyssal Drakos, the mana source has regained stability, and it's time to tell Samuel the good news!

filas.intro: So the Mana City really existed once upon a time... Elder Wanta, with a heavy frown, describes the danger Magikale is facing, now that the barrier protecting the region has weakened. The mana source under their guard is showing signs of instability as well. We need to rebuild the barrier, stabilize the source, and find out what's causing the instability.
pasos: 1. Head over to the Starglow Path to look for Defender Ria before Elder Wanta's spell wears off. (The spell lasts for only two hours.)

2. Defender Ria wants you to defeat the following: 
Wyn Chymes: /c$9%47403%/c*/ 50
Rypple Chymes: /c$9%47404%/c*/ 50
3. Having gotten rid of the troublemakers, you can now report back to Ria.

4. Defeat Soul Guardians to get: 
Energy Crystals: /c$9%47405%/c*/ 150
5. Now that you've collected enough Energy Crystals, hand them over to Defender Ria.

6. Ria wants you to defend the barrier by defeating the following: 
Insomnicoos: /c$9%47406%/c*/ 150
7. Now that you've driven away the monsters, go check on Ria, and get your reward.

filas.intro: Defender Ria has received a request for help from Intern Kacey, who is in the Academia Woods. But no one knows what kind of help he needs...
pasos: 1. Defender Ria wants you to go to Academia Woods to help Intern Kacey.

2. Intern Kacey wants you to punish the following monsters: 
Pulp Shredders: /c$9%47407%/c*/ 150
3. Tell Intern Kacey that you've dealt with the monsters.
4. Get clues from Chill Collins.
5. You've found a little plaque from one of the Chill Collins, but you don't know what it is. Go ask Kacey for more info.
6. Defeat Hunky Sebastian.
7. You've dealt with Hunky Sebastian, and it's time to report back to Kacey for your reward.

filas.intro: Intern Kacey believes that the monsters are actually wrecking parts of Academia Woods for a specific purpose, but she doesn't know what it is. She would like you to look for Tobir at the Mana Ruins. He might be able to help.
pasos: 1. Intern Kacey wants you to look for Tobir at the Mana Ruins.

2. Tobir would like you to investigate the following pillars: 
Mysterious North Pillar: /c$9%47409%/c*/ 1
Mysterious Central Pillar: /c$9%47410%/c*/ 1
Mysterious South Pillar: /c$9%47411%/c*/ 1
3. Now that you've investigated all three pillars, report back to Tobir.

4. Help Tobir buy some time by eliminating the following: 
Masked Bladers: /c$9%47412%/c*/ 100
Arcane Bladers: /c$9%47413%/c*/ 100
5. You've bought him enough time, so return to Tobir to get your reward.

filas.intro: Tobir wants you to convey your findings to Aktos, the head of Coo Village. Aktos might have an idea on how to prevent the mana source from deteriorating further.
pasos: 1. Pass the results of the investigation to Aktos.

2. Aktos wants you to deal with the following monsters:
Chikahorns: /c$9%47414%/c*/ 150
Chikadrums: /c$9%47415%/c*/ 150
3. Tell Aktos that you've exterminated all the monsters.

4. Defeat Slate Golems to get: 
Wooden Sticks: /c$9%47416%/c*/ 100
5. You've collected enough wooden sticks! Give them to Aktos now to get your reward.

filas.intro: People who've survived trials often attain the wisdom needed to handle threats. Aktos thinks it's worth checking out the Ethereal Garden, where sorcerers are sent to undergo trials. Perhaps we can find some answers there.
pasos: 1. Atkos wants you to talk to Fadino.

2. Fadino wants you to collect the following from various monsters: 
Sesame Serum from Corareis: /c$9%47417%/c*/ 50 bottles
Aqua Tears from Azureis: /c$9%47418%/c*/ 50
3. You've collected enough Sesame Serum and Aqua Tears. Give them to Fadino.

4. Collect from Steelhedge: 
Steel Artery: /c$9%47419%/c*/ 1
Collect from Peavender:
Lavender Heart: /c$9%47420%/c*/ 1
Collect from Strawflora:
Sunset Chain: /c$9%47421%/c*/ 1
5. Give all three items to Fadino to get your reward.

filas.intro: Fadino has combined all three items, but he doesn't know how to use them. He thinks that Rossa the librarian might have a clue.
pasos: 1. Fadino wants you to bring the mysterious gear to Rossa at the Daydream Library.

2. Rossa wants you to deal with the following monsters:
Whizhoots: /c$9%47422%/c*/ 200
Scholhoots: /c$9%47423%/c*/ 200
3. Tell Rossa that you've driven away the monsters.

4. Retrieve from Graceful Garys:
Book Pages: /c$9%47424%/c*/ 150
5. Now that you've retrieved the pages, report back to Rossa to get your reward.

filas.intro: Rossa says that this is actually an ancient key, but she doesn't know much else about it. She does know of mysterious mechanisms in the Reminiscence Cloister, and they might be related in some way. Rossa asks you to consult Kenton in the Reminiscence Cloister.
pasos: 1. Rossa wants you to look for Kento in the Reminiscence Cloister.

2. Kenton would like you to eliminate the following monsters first: 
Syren Trebles: /c$9%47425%/c*/ 200
Syren Basses: /c$9%47426%/c*/ 200
3. You've taken care of the monsters that were attacking the art works. Report back to Kenton.
4. Use the Mana Key to unlock the north mechanism.
5. Use the Mana Key to unlock the central mechanism.
6. Use the Mana Key to unlock the south mechanism.
7. You've unlocked all the mechanisms, and something very strange is happening. Hurry back to Kenton to tell him, and get your reward.

filas.intro: Timeless City is a safe haven created by the goddess Angelika to protect her people. The residents used to make merry, oblivous to the chaos around them. It was a city that knew only peace. But the people have started fighting amongst themselves... Is the Evil Lyceum behind this? For Eden's sake, we're getting to the bottom of this!
pasos: 1. Hurry to the Dial Desert beyond the palace ruins and look for Guard Dwain to find out more about the situation.

2. Help Guard Dwain defeat the following:
Cake Buns: /c$9%48699%/c*/ 100
3. Report back to Guard Dwain.

Get water back from Amberixes and Cool Kitties:

1. Go to the Timespring in Apocalypso to get:
