  Industrial Solvent: /c$9%52754%/c*/ 80
2. Return to Ruins Restorer for your reward.

filas.intro: Once the guardian of the Royal Ruins, the spirit of Skeli Marli watches helplessly as the demons ravage the place. Drive off the demons so that she may rest in peace.
pasos:
1. Get rid of the vandals:
  Ultravi: /c$9%52757%/c*/ 100
  Reptica: /c$9%52758%/c*/ 100
  Talbok: /c$9%52759%/c*/ 30
2. Report to Skeli Marli.

3. Pay respects to Marli's friend, Bud:
  Light incense: /c$9%52760%/c*/ 1
4. Return to Skeli Marli for your reward.

filas.intro: The demons have stolen some of Tycoon Ricky's treasure! Sure, they only took a trifle, but we need to show them who's the boss here! Go get the treasure back!
pasos:
1. Go to the Antechamber at Radiant Castle and get the stolen treasure from:
  Herblars:
  Golden Balls: /c$9%52779%/c*/ 15
  Skelshrooms:
  Golden Cubes: /c$9%52780%/c*/ 15
2. Report to Tycoon Ricky for your reward.

filas.intro: Prof Roger is a famous surgeon who has come to the Gold Isle in search of a mysterious fruit with amazing properties. He requires your assistance to conduct his search amidst the ongoing unrest at the Radiant Castle.
pasos:
1. Go to the Ancient Cloister at Radiant Castle and get from:
  Venomats:
  Blue Fruits: /c$9%52781%/c*/ 25
  Satyra:
  Dark Fruits: /c$9%52782%/c*/ 25
2. Let Prof Roger know that you have collected the fruits.

filas.intro: Guprin has been heartbroken ever since Lea's disappearance. Go to the Radiant Castle and look for clues regarding Lea's whereabouts!
pasos:
1. Go to the Waterway at Radiant Castle and get from Nilar:
  Mysterious Notes: /c$9%52783%/c*/ 10
2. Hand the notes to Guprin.

filas.intro: With the Radiant Castle in chaos, the Strategist Zhu has determined that the best course of action is to defeat the vanguards first.
pasos:
1. Go to the waterway at Radiant Castle and defeat:
  Platoxes: /c$9%52784%/c*/ 20
  Bunsenays: /c$9%52785%/c*/ 20
2. Report to Strategist Zhu for your reward.

filas.intro: Hauche is an accomplished martial artist, but his injuries have taken their toll on him. Defeat the enemies at Radiant Castle and secure Gold Isle!
pasos:
1. Go to the Radiant Castle and defeat:
   Taigol: /c$9%52786%/c*/ 20
   Mazdra: /c$9%52787%/c*/ 20
2. Report to Hauche for your reward.

filas.intro: Once fostered by Trasno, the famous dragon tamer, Natz, is unable to bring himself to harm the ancient dragon. You will have to suppress Trasno on his behalf!
pasos: 1. Go to Dragon Isle at Radiant Castle and defeat Trasno!
2. Let Tamer Natz know that you have successfully suppressed Trasno.

filas.intro: One of Radiant Castle's bosses is the speedy Vetica. Even the self-proclaimed speedster, Hyper Hood, cannot keep up with her. You'll have to go to the castle and defeat Vetica!
pasos: 1. Go to the Horseman's Realm at Radiant Castle and defeat Vetica.
2. Let Hyper Hood know that you have defeated Vetica.

filas.intro: Young Niels has always been an admirer of intellectuals. He read up to prepare for his meeting with his idol, Deanna, at the Radiant Castle. Unfortunately, the castle has been plunged into a state of chaos! Restore order to the Radiant Castle so that Niels can fulfill his wish.
pasos: 1. Go to the Scholar's Domain at Radiant Castle and awaken Deanna!
2. Let Young Niels know that you've managed to awaken Deanna.

filas.intro: The [Bottomless Pit] near Dark City has always been a mystery. However, with the hard work of the researchers at the [Energy Research Center] and the use of alien technology, it is now possible for the researchers to set foot on the bottom of the pit. Just as they finish setting up their research stations, monsters and fanatics showed up to mess things up. Is the [daemon] of the legends really in here...?
pasos: 1. Learn about the current status of the [Bottomless Pit] and look for Researcher Eliot at the Ancient Landing.

2. Defeat Ratty Robbers to get:
  Power Shards: /c$9%55105%/c*/ 100 pieces
3. Hand the Power Shards to Researcher Emily.
4. Place the Power Crystal inside the Power Conduit.
5. Report back to Researcher Eliot.

6. Defeat the fanatics protesting the excavation:
  Wham Ogre: /c$9%55108%/c*/ 150
7. Report back to Researcher Eliot and get your reward.

filas.intro: Further investigations at the [Energy Research Center] have revealed that this cavern is home to a variety of creatures. For unknown reasons, the creatures have been attacking researchers on sight and the fanatics have seized the opportunity to barge into the Bottomless Pit. It seems like the researchers would benefit greatly from your aid.
pasos: 1. Repairs for the Power Conduit is complete. Go to the Forsaken Crevasse and get more details from Scythe Marcus.

2. Retrieve the following from:
  Desert Piscine:
  Sharp Scythes: /c$9%55109%/c*/ 100
  Marsh Piscine:
  Round Shields: /c$9%55110%/c*/ 100
3. Hand the equipment to Scythe Marcus.

4. Retrieve Piscine King's weapon:
  /c$9%55111%/c*/ 1
5. Hand the weapon to Scythe Marcus.
6. Hand the necklace to Scythe Mary and collect your reward.

filas.intro: With the fanatics stopped, it is time to handle the problems found in the deeper parts of the cave. If left unchecked, they can potentially escalate and affect locations beyond the cave. You need to explore further to protect Eden and possibly uncover the secret within the [Bottomless Pit]!
pasos: 1. Go to Specter Village and look for Overseer Isaac to learn more.

2. Look for the Geological Report:
  Mapleant: /c$9%55113%/c*/ 150

3. Look for the Geological Report:
  Kupillars: /c$9%55114%/c*/ 150

4. Look for the Geological Report:
  Vegan Ogre: /c$9%55115%/c*/ 150

5. Look for the Geological Report:
  Lamias: /c$9%55116%/c*/ 150
6. Return to Overseer Isaac with the [Geological Report].

7. Hand the [Geological Report Copy] to:
  Researcher Ike: /c$9%55118%/c*/ 1
  Researcher Amy: /c$9%55119%/c*/ 1
  Researcher Edge: /c$9%55120%/c*/ 1
8. Report back to Overseer Isaac and get your reward.

filas.intro: The rumors turned out to be true, a mysterious daemon is indeed present in the Bottomless Pit! Just when Isaac and others thought they could study the site in peace, the fanatics have returned while everyone was distracted by the damaged [Power Conduit]. These commotions have awoken the [Mysterious Daemon], and the other creatures living in the pit. It would be best if you went to investigate...
pasos: 1. Go to the Crystal Marsh to help out Analyst Troy.

2. Defeat the following:
  Rock Masks: /c$9%55121%/c*/ 200
  Slate Masks: /c$9%55122%/c*/ 200
3. Report back to Analyst Troy.

4. Use the [Reversal Draught] at:
  East Marsh: /c$9%55123%/c*/ 1
  West Marsh: /c$9%55124%/c*/ 1
5. Update Analyst Troy on the situation.

6. Defeat the enemy's leader:
  Dracossy: /c$9%55125%/c*/ 1

7. Defeat the following:
  Dracolet: /c$9%55126%/c*/ 100
8. Report back to Analyst Troy and get your reward.

filas.intro: While it is unclear if all of the events were directly linked to the [Mysterious Daemon], the best way to stop the chaos is to learn more about this unfamiliar world. Besides the analysis of the researchers, you will also need to learn more about the history of this place.
pasos: 1. With peace restored to the marsh, go to the Crystal Quarry and look for David Diggs.

2. Defeat the following:
  Rowdy Ruffians: /c$9%55127%/c*/ 150
3. Report back to David Diggs.

4. Help to mine:
  Crystal Vein: /c$9%55128%/c*/ 30 times

5. Listen to the mysterious male voice.
  (Select the Crystal Vein to hear the voice again...)

6. Defeat Cultist Mell to get:
  Evil Token: /c$9%55129%/c*/ 1
7. Hand the [Evil Token] to Captain Will at Shrouded Haven and get your reward.

filas.intro: After learning more about the place, you have a better idea on the source of the chaos. To put a stop to the wild ambitions of the fanatics, you will need to work with the local group known as the Scythes. If possible, they would like to solve all of this amicably, but there several mysteries remained...
pasos:
1. Help Captain Will:
  Eavesdrop on the conversation between Researcher Ashe and Researcher Iver: /c$9%55130%/c*/ 1
  Eavesdrop on the conversation between Scythe Mark and Scythe Arthur: /c$9%55131%/c*/ 1
  Eavesdrop on the conversation between Asuma and Lillian: /c$9%55132%/c*/ 1
2. Return to Captain Will with all of the information.

3. Defeat Bombergusts to get:
  Confession Note: /c$9%55133%/c*/ 1
4. Hand the Confession Note to Captain Will.

5. Defeat the following:
  The Others: /c$9%55134%/c*/ 200
  Scoreant: /c$9%55135%/c*/ 200
6. Go to the Peril Chasm and report to Historian Marlene for your reward.

filas.intro: The cause was more than just the [Mysterious Daemon] being disgruntled. An evil organization is looking to harness its power for their own has caused all of the chaos to delay the progress of the researchers. To ensure the safety of Eden, you need to put a stop to their malicious plot!
pasos:
1. Defeat Balaur to get:
  Round Power Rock: /c$9%55136%/c*/ 1

2. After getting the Round Power Rock, the owner of the same mysterious voice from earlier confirmed that he would meet you in person.
  (Speak to Historian Marlene to hear the voice again...)

3. Defeat the following:
  Zburator: /c$9%55137%/c*/ 200

4. Defeat Kulshedra to get:
  Moon Power Rock: /c$9%55138%/c*/ 1
5. Give the Sun Power Rock and Moon Power Rock to Historian Marlene for your reward.

filas.intro: The Power Conduit is used to protect the Dark Abyss from external forces. Researcher Elias has been tasked to protect this important piece of equipment, but he is going to need all the help he can get to fend off the fanatics!
pasos:
1. Help Researcher Elias defeat the following:
  Greepillars: /c$9%55060%/c*/ 100
 Blupillars: /c$9%55061%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Researcher Elias for your reward.

filas.intro: While the Power Conduit plays a key role in protecting the Dark Abyss, it cannot properly function without any Power Shards. Researcher Eisner has been tasked to find more Power Shards but he is going to need some help getting them off of the monsters!
pasos:
1. Help Researcher Eisner defeat:
  Tourmanite or Tanzanite to get:
  Power Shards: /c$9%55063%/c*/ 100
2. Return to Researcher Eisner for your reward.

filas.intro: Dozus and Snoozie are deeply in love, but recent changes to the abyss have created a crack in their relationship. Well, a literal crack in the ground that you can probably help with...
pasos: 1. Hand Dozus' letter to Snoozie.
2. Hand Snoozie's letter to Dozus for your reward.

filas.intro: Feeling helpless about the crack that has developed between Dozus and Snoozie, Sage Jimmy has decided to enlist your help with a plan...
pasos:
1. Defeat Teal Dolls to get:
  Pebbles: /c$9%55068%/c*/ 200
2. Hand the pebbles to Sage Jimmy.

3. Defeat Stone Masks to get:
  Large Rocks: /c$9%55069%/c*/ 100
4. Hand the Large Rocks to Sage Jimmy.
5. Throw the Pebbles and Large Rocks into the crack between Dozus and Snoozie.
6. "Fixed" the crack (Report back to Sage Jimmy for your reward)

filas.intro: After experiencing all of the chaos, Researcher Isaiah has decided to stop supporting the [Energy Research Center]. However, if he wants to remain a researcher, he will need your help getting some evidence from the monsters.
pasos:
1. Defeat Lavendeants to get:
  Pieces of evidence: /c$9%55072%/c*/ 200
2. Hand the evidence to Researcher Isaiah for your reward.

filas.intro: After experiencing all of the chaos, Lich Wenzt has decided to stop supporting the [Fanatics] because they are doing more harm to the place than the [Research Center]. He is currently looking for help against his former allies.
pasos:
1. Defeat the following:
  Spiriton: /c$9%55074%/c*/ 150
  Ghoston: /c$9%55075%/c*/ 150
2. Report back to Lich Wentz.

3. Defeat the following:
  Grim Schkull: /c$9%55076%/c*/ 1
4. Report back to Lich Wenzt for your reward.

filas.intro: Since the start of their research here, Issac and Shirley have been too occupied with work to spend time with their daughter, Aywne. They are hoping that you can spend some time with her, and maybe even cheer her up!
pasos: 1. Look for Aywne.

2. Defeat the Albino Piscine to get:
  Mr Teddy: /c$9%55078%/c*/ 1
3. Hand Mr Teddy to Aywne for your reward.

filas.intro: As a geologist, Wayne's responsibility here is to study the water quality of the abyss. But due to his carelessness, the report on the water has been lost. Can you help him retrieve the report and avoid a reprimand by the chief?
pasos: 1. Defeat Drac and get the Observation Notes: /c$9%55080%/c*/ 1
2. Hand the notes to Wayne.

3. Defeat Dracarmine for:
  Draco Scales: /c$9%55081%/c*/ 50.
4.Hand the Observation Notes and Draco Scales to Lars.
5. Return to Wayne for your reward.

filas.intro: While it has always been Researcher Alph's dream to understand the secrets of the [Bottomless Pit], he also has keen interests in geomancy and magnetic fields. With the abundance of crystals in the quarry, he would appreciate your help with an experiment...
pasos:
1. Try defeating the Sneaky Scouts for:
  Scout Token: /c$9%55083%/c*/ 1
2. Get the Scout Token and report back to Researcher Alph.

3. Defeat the Sneaky Scouts for:
  Scout Token: /c$9%55085%/c*/ 1
4. Report back to Researcher Alph for your reward.

filas.intro: Wonders never cease! Long has Taylor fantasized about being in a romantic relationship and she just happens to meet a mysterious handsome man. She tried asking around but no one seems to know him. Can you find out the man's identity for Taylor?
pasos:
1. Defeat the following:
  White Cultists: /c$9%55087%/c*/ 100
2. Report back to Taylor.

3. Defeat the following:
  Beryl Fae: /c$9%55088%/c*/ 100
4. Report back to Taylor.

5. Defeat the following:
  Green Cockatrice: /c$9%55089%/c*/ 100
6. Report back to Taylor for your reward.

filas.intro: During her research on immortality in the Dark City, Alista happened to hear about the Dark Abyss. She decided to make a trip here in search of any information that could aid her in her quest...
pasos:
1. Defeat Blue Ogres to get:
  Scarlet Powder: /c$9%55091%/c*/ 200
2. Report back to Alista for your reward.

filas.intro: In his bid to visit all of the locations on Eden, Uncle Sam Toucan has saved up a pretty penny. But after stumbling upon this place, he no longer has the desire to leave or visit anywhere else. It would be the perfect home if someone could get rid of those pesky monsters!
pasos:
1. Defeat the following:
  Snow Ogres: /c$9%55093%/c*/ 200
2. Report back to Uncle Sam Toucan for your reward.

filas.intro: Wyatt is one of the top warriors of the Scythes and he is looking for allies to fend off the attacks at the Peril Chasm. You should lend him a hand!
pasos:
1. Defeat the following:
 Dracodians: /c$9%55095%/c*/ 200
2. Report back to General Wyatt.

3. Defeat Obsidian Crocs to get the following:
  Sharp Weapons: /c$9%55096%/c*/ 150
  Tough Shields: /c$9%55097%/c*/ 150
4. Hand the equipment to Wyatt for your reward.

filas.intro: Mads is one of the top mages of the Scythes and he is looking for allies to fend off attacks at the Peril Chasm. You should lend him a hand!
pasos:
1. Defeat the following:
 Blue Cultists: /c$9%55099%/c*/ 200
2. Report back to Archmage Mads.

3. Defeat Sketoms to get the following:
  Cypress Staves: /c$9%55100%/c*/ 150
  Magic Shields: /c$9%55101%/c*/ 150
4. Hand the equipment to Mads for your reward.

filas.intro: The parts used to maintain the pit's teleporter have gone missing! While the teleporter can still function for now, it would be disastrous if it stopped working. Let's help Mechanic Hank recover those maintenance parts!
pasos:
1. Go to Leviathan's Domain and defeat Gravel Piscines and Punk Worms for:
 Steel Plates: /c$9%55947%/c*/ 15
 Screws: /c$9%55948%/c*/ 15
2. Report back to Mechanic Hank for your reward.

filas.intro: Mida is a botanist who have travelled around the world. When she heard that a [Peculiar Flower] may be present at the pit, she knew she had to be a part of the research team. The rare flower has been spotted at an inaccessible area for her, can you help her?
pasos: 1. Get the Peculiar Flower from Leviathan's Domain.
2. Report back to Mida with the flower.

filas.intro: There seems to be an unexpected rise in the numbers of fanatics. Is it possible for them to have a stronghold here? Constable Bell would like you to investigate the chambers found at the Leviathan's Domain.
pasos:
1. Check the 2 chambers at  Leviathan's Domain and defeat the following:
 Mad Cultists: /c$9%55950%/c*/ 10
 Loyal Cultists: /c$9%55951%/c*/ 10
2. Report back to Constable Bell with the news.

filas.intro: Once he is done with his work here at the Bottomless Pit, Mogu will return to his hometown to wed his childhood sweetheart. Unfortunately, he has dropped the Engagement Necklace in a fissure located at the Leviathan's Domain. Please lend him a hand!
pasos: 1. Look for Mogu's Engagement Necklace at the fissure.
2. Report back to Mogu with the necklace.

filas.intro: Phil is a gourmet who travelled all over the lands in search of the best food Eden has to offer. When he heard about the taste of Cockatrice Meat, he knew he had to get here immediately. The delicacy has been found at a dangerous area, can you give him a hand?
pasos:
1. Go to Leviathan's Domain and defeat Brute Cockatrices to get:
 Cockatrice Meat: /c$9%55953%/c*/ 15
2. Report back to Phil for the reward.

filas.intro: It has been rumored that the core of Krystarox can be refined into a magic crystal. To be a successful merchant, it's all about being the first to market and Trader Joe is not going to miss the chance of getting such a rare product. However, merchants don't usually make for good fighters so he is going to need your help with this!
pasos: 1. Go to Leviathan's Domain and defeat Krystarox to get its core.
2. Report back to Trader Joe with the core crystal.

filas.intro: Vera's father is one of the researchers working in the Bottomless Pit. During his investigation of the Leviathan's Domain, he was ambushed by Cultist Malfax, and has since been turned into one of his mindless slaves. Go forth and defeat the evil Cultist Malfax, and save Vera's father!
pasos: 1. Go to Leviathan's Domain and defeat Cultist Malfax
2. Report back to Vera.

filas.intro: The once dormant Jaggamir has awakened due to the Evil Lyceum's intrusion. Driven into a state of uncontrollable rage, the powerful shockwaves created by Jaggamir's attacks is slowly splitting the entire Eden from underneath. For the safety of Eden, you need to stop Jaggamir before the damage becomes irreparable!
pasos: 1. Go to the Abyssal Depths at Leviathan's Domain to put a stop to Jaggamir.
2. Report back to Archmage Greg.

filas.intro: While playing, a little bear strayed too far from his home in the depths of the forest. He's scared of unfamiliar creatures, and needs you to get rid of all the scary things on the way home.
pasos:
1. Lost Ted needs you to drive away:
Snow Sprites:/c$9%58487%/c*/ 100
Little Onesies: /c$9%58488%/c*/ 100
2. Talk to Lost Ted to get your reward.

filas.intro: Sly Sweeney has a habit of borrowing things from the bears without returning them, so he can't go into bear territory without getting hit. He hopes that you can help him collect Pots from the land of the bears.
pasos:
1. Sly Sweeney wants you to help him collect: 
From Windmillies:
Pots: /c$9%58490%/c*/ 100
2. Take the pots to Sly Sweeney.

3. Get from Cool Crabbies:
Honey:
/c$9%58491%/c*/ 100
4. Bring the pots of honey to Sly Sweeney.

filas.intro: The two warring families in the city will finally be united via marriage. But they keep arguing over the details of the wedding ceremony. Help Beareo and Teddiet so that they can get married properly!
pasos:
1. Get from Owie Powies:
Engagement Roses:
/c$9%58493%/c*/ 99
2. Give the 99 Engagement Roses to Teddiet.
3. Give the Hand Baked Cookies to Beareo to get your reward.

filas.intro: Ranelle dreams of becoming a famous dancer. She's about to put on a performance for the first time. Help her prep for it!
pasos:
1. Get from Pink Shrooms:
Colorful Thread: /c$9%58496%/c*/ 200
2. Give the Colorful Thread to Ranelle.

3. Get from Red Wolfies:
Dreamy Ribbons: /c$9%58497%/c*/ 100
4. Give the Dreamy Ribbons to Ranelle to get your reward.

filas.intro: Teddiet's Dad can't bear to see his beloved daughter get wed, but after seeing how happy the two bears are, he melted and would like to do his best for the wedding.
pasos:
1. Teddiet's Dad wants you to drive away:
Bearnaps: /c$9%58499%/c*/ 100
Sleepy Bears: /c$9%58500%/c*/ 100
2. Go back and tell Teddiet's Dad that the monsters are gone.

3. Get from Swordsbears:
Fresh Flowers: /c$9%58501%/c*/ 50
4. Give the Fresh Flowers to Teddiet's Dad.

5. Get from Cranky Caroline:
Decorative Carving: /c$9%58502%/c*/ 1
6. Give the Decorative Carving to Teddiet's Dad to get your reward.

filas.intro:
イカ?をみた男がパトロール
中に事件を目撃！イカ?をみ
た男と一緒に事件解決を目
指そう！
pasos:
1.不思議な海岸の「イカ?を
 みた男」に話しをきいてみ
 よう！

2.「封印解除の欠片」を30
 個集めよう！
 欠片：/c$9%58216%/c*/ 30個。

3.「封印解除の欠片」が集ま
 った！「イカ？を見た男」
 に渡しに行こう！
4.「封印の部屋」にいる「イ\n カ娘」に話しかけよう！\n

filas.intro: The Lone Duelist has been ambitious since childhood. If you think you have what it takes, this is the time to prove your skills!
pasos:
1. The Lone Duelist challenges you to defeat: 
Clematis Crabbies: /c$9%58504%/c*/ 100
Sugarisons: /c$9%58505%/c*/ 100
Beary Crates: /c$9%58506%/c*/ 100
2. Report back to the Lone Duelist.

3. To prove your worth, defeat: 
Bearrel: /c$9%58507%/c*/ 1
4. Tell the Lone Duelist that you've defeated Bearrel to get your reward.

filas.intro: The bears have been living peacefully in the [Dream Garden] hidden behind the woods for centuries. But one day, the peace is ruined by a deafening bang followed by horrified screams. What just happened in this dreamy sanctuary? And what does that terrible sound mean?
pasos: 1. After Baby Blair tells you about the dire situation in the Dream Garden, you hurry to the Hidden Grove to look for Scaredy Bass.

2. Get rid of the monsters surrounding Scaredy Bass:
Shrooms: /c$9%58874%/c*/ 50
3. Now that you've gotten rid of the scary monsters, you can talk to Scaredy Bass.

4. You need to find out more about the monsters. Investigate:
Leaf Sprites: /c$9%58875%/c*/ 100
Blue Onesies: /c$9%58876%/c*/ 100
5. Now that you're done with your investigations, you can report back to Scaredy Bass.

6. Defeat the monster leader:
Rascally Ricky: /c$9%58877%/c*/ 1
7. Report back to Scaredy Bass to get your reward.

filas.intro: We still don't know why such a terrible fate has befallen the bear community, but monsters have swarmed into their homeland, turning a sanctuary into a nightmare. We must carry on our investigation to find out more!
pasos: 1. The Hidden Grove is a little safer now, so you head over to the Forest of Whispers to talk to Cop Ebearny. He might know more.

2. Cop Ebearny wants you to get a potion from Muddy Crabbies:
Morph Potion: /c$9%58878%/c*/ 1
3. Carefully bring the Morph Potion back to Cop Ebearny.

4. Having turned into a fellow bear, you can now:
Talk to Rosursa and Cartonursa: /c$9%58881%/c*/ 1 time
5. Hurry back and tell Cop Ebearny what you heard.

6. Get rid of the monsters plaguing the residents in the Forest of Whispers:
Fiery Hissies: /c$9%58882%/c*/ 200
7. Hand Cop Ebearny's letter over to Elder Bearuce in Teddy Amusement to get your reward.

filas.intro: From the local gossip, you know the residents have lost all trust in each other because of this calamity. Just what deity is behind this influx of monsters? There are still so many unknown details as to the its cause... Everyone feels lost and in despair. When will we find out the truth?
pasos:
1. Look for the following in Teddy Amusement:
Edible Herbs : 1 basket
Blessed Water from Cardbears: /c$9%58884%/c*/3 portions

Give them to Elder Bearuce once you've finished collecting them.
2. Look for the residents that need medical attention in Teddy Amusement: /c$9%58886%/c*/ 3
3. While treating the residents, you managed to get some new info. Hurry back and report this to Elder Bearuce.

4. Get rid of the following monsters in Teddy Amusement:
Bearoons: /c$9%58888%/c*/ 100
Pink Bearoons: /c$9%58889%/c*/ 100
5. A shiny red gem fell from a monster's body. Go ask Elder Bearuce about it and get your reward.

filas.intro: According to Elder Bearuce, the gem was part of the Bear King's crown. Why was it in the possession of the monsters? Did the Bear King befriend the Evil Lyceum and cause this calamity? But why would he suddenly get in touch with the Evil Lyceum?
pasos: 1. Give the gem to Caregive Rhim in the City of Dreams, and ask him if he knows why the monsters had the gem.

2. Help get rid of the following monsters in the City of Dreams:
Green Shrooms: /c$9%58891%/c*/ 150
But make sure you don't hit any baby bears.
3. You've exterminated the monsters that were bullying the baby bears. Report back to Caregiver Rhim.

4. Play music that will soothe the baby bears:
Piano in the east: /c$9%58892%/c*/ 1
Piano in the west: /c$9%58908%/c*/ 1
Piano in the south: /c$9%58909%/c*/ 1
Piano in the north: /c$9%58910%/c*/ 1
Piano in the center: /c$9%58911%/c*/ 1
5. Tell Caregiver Rhim that you've played on all the pianos.

6. Go collect the following from Purple Wolfies:
Wooden Planks: /c$9%58893%/c*/ 10
Nails: /c$9%58894%/c*/ 20
7. Now that you've collected them all, head over to the library in the west, and give the materials to Librarian Noel.
8. Head over to Foodie Paradise to look for the Bear King's confidant, Snow. Perhaps Snow will be able to tell you more about the King.

filas.intro: If the gem from the Bear King's crown is an ancient treasure, then it's not a surprise that the Evil Lyceum would try to get their hands on it. Snow has also personally witnessed the King attacking civilians, and although he wants to believe that the King is innocent, it's hard to defend the King in light of these circumstances.
pasos: 1. Go to Teddy Amusement to see if you can find any sleeping pills in the shops there. If you do, buy one for Snow.

2. Look for something that helps with sleep:
Slumberbloom Essence: /c$9%58896%/c*/ 50 drops
3. Give the Slumberbloom Essence to Snow.

4. Head over to the Hidden Grove and get from Dark Shrooms:
Healthy Mushrooms: /c$9%58897%/c*/ 50
Head to the Forest of Whispers and get from the Bully Hissy:
Firm Thigh: /c$9%58898%/c*/ 1
Head to Teddy Amusement and get from Bam Whammies:
Sweet Nectar: /c$9%58899%/c*/ 50 portions
5. Now that you have all the ingredients, give them to Snow in Foodie Paradise.

6. Help defeat pesky blade wielders:
Green Millies: 
/c$9%58900%/c*/ 200
7. Tell Snow that you've dealt with the monsters.
8. Give the prepared food to Sentry Bruno. He will find a way to give it to the Bear King.

filas.intro: Bruno said [controlled], and it sent shivers down your spine... So someone else is behind the Bear King's attack after all. That explains why things have gotten so much worse since the King disappeared. You need to help Bruno find out more. We're really close to the truth now!
pasos:
1. Interrogate an Evil Lyceum member:
Cross Crabby: /c$9%58901%/c*/ 1 time
2. Tell Bruno what the Cross Crabby said.

3. You need more info, so you need to interrogate another Evil Lyceum member:
Candison: /c$9%58902%/c*/ 1 time
4. Tell Bruno what the Candison said.

5. Interrogate yet another Evil Lyceum member:
Beary Boxy: /c$9%58903%/c*/ 1 time
6. You've obtained shocking info and you need to report this to Bruno right away. Talk to Bruno to get your reward.

filas.intro: The Bear King is confused and can't tell reality apart from the dream world. Perhaps it'll do him some good to sleep. Let's get rid of the noisy monsters in the Nightmare City so that he can have a quiet environment to sleep in!
pasos: 1. Go to Nightmare City and defeat the noisy Yellow Shrooms: /c$9%59517%/c*/ 20
2. Report back to C' Estar to get your reward.

filas.intro: The berserk Bear King has been wrecking havoc in every direction. After seeing how terrified the residents are, the monsters have become even more daring and are destroying things as well. We hope that you'll help us teach the monsters a lesson!
pasos: 1. Go to Nightmare City and teach the Black Wolfies a lesson: /c$9%59518%/c*/ 20
2. Report back to Pan'da to get your reward.

filas.intro: Marionett, a being from the Bear King's dream world, has the power to give good dreams. As a robot, Tal Nodreams has always wanted to be able to dream. Do a kind deed and help him out.
pasos: 1. Go to Nightmare City and defeat Mirage Marionett to obtain Dreamshards.
2. Give the Dreamshards to Tal Nodreams.

filas.intro: Mariano, a being from the Bear King's dream world, has the power to give nightmares. The power is gradually affecting everyone in Dream Garden, starting with the City of Dreams. Go hunt down the nightmares for everyone's sake!
pasos: 1. Go to Nightmare City and defeat Dreamy Mariano to get rid of the nightmares plaguing the residents of Dream Garden.
2. Tell the Dream Guard the good news.

filas.intro: The Bear King's insanity and violent behaviour are getting worse, and if this carries on, Dream Garden will be ruined, and the Bear King himself will waste away. But the Bear King is essential to the realm. Please defeat him and put him into a deep sleep for the sake of all of our people!
pasos: 1. Go to the Manic Hall in Nightmare City and defeat Bearjesty.
2. You've put Bearjesty into a deep sleep. Go tell Sentry Kady the good news!

filas.intro: Ever since the [Munol Battleship] crashed on Eden, everyone's been curious about it, and time has not diminished that curiosity one bit. A powerful [Teleporter] was built, and when it was turned on, a massive force wave swept the land around it. What dangers does this hold for everyone on Eden...?
pasos: 1. After Raydia explains the situation, she asks you to hurry to Whispering Hill via the Secret Area entrance, and look for Buzzy.

2. Defeat the monsters that are disturbing the peace: 
Phollixes: /c$9%60565%/c*/ 200
3. Now that peace has been returned to Whispering Hill, report back to Buzzy.

4. Protect the [Starwind Gate] by defeating: 
Skelon Aquin: /c$9%60566%/c*/ 1
5. Now that you've defended the Gate, you can report back to Buzzy.

6. Collect [Wind Sprites]:
  Sprayer Prince: /c$9%60567%/c*/ 100
 Fan Wielder: /c$9%60568%/c*/ 100
7. Now that you've collected all the [Wind Sprites], you can hand them over to Buzzy to get your reward.

filas.intro: After defending Whispering Hill, Buzzy was planning to send you to guard the [Star Gate], but after some consideration, she's decided that it would be best to head over to Galaxia Square to find out more first. Does anyone know what's really going on?
pasos: 1. It's better to head over to Galaxia Square first, and find out more from the guard named Floren.

2. Floren asks you to help her get [Wind Power]:
  Whisper Fae: /c$9%60569%/c*/ 200

3. Floren asks you to help her get [Water Power]:
  Fluvo Fae: /c$9%60570%/c*/ 200

4. Floren asks you to help her get [Fire Power]:
 Scorch Imp: /c$9%60571%/c*/ 200

5. Floren asks you to help her get [Earth Power]:
  Sandy Golem: /c$9%60572%/c*/ 200
6. Give all the [Four Powers] you've collected to Floren to get your reward.

filas.intro: Apparently this place has been cut off from Eden all along, and although the townsfolk have heard of Eden, they don't really pay attention to it. They do know that the Galaxia Palace has been absorbing power from the four elements since...perhaps around the time the Goddess Angelina first appeared?
pasos: 1. Go to Pristine Lake and look for the water fairy named Flow.

2. Defeat the monsters polluting the water:
Waterfaller: /c$9%60573%/c*/ 200
3. Now that you've protected the lake from pollution, report back to Flow.

4. Protect the [Water Gate] by defeating:
  Crabby Canthes: /c$9%60574%/c*/ 1
5. Now that you've protected the gate, report back to Flow.

6. Collect [Water Essence]:
  Beach Boi: /c$9%60575%/c*/ 100
 Snorkela: /c$9%60576%/c*/ 100
7. Once you've finished collecting [Water Essence], give it to Flow to get your reward.

filas.intro: Now that the [Water Gate] has been fixed, we still need to carry out repairs in two other areas. While carrying out repairs, we experienced the power of the four elements, and I can't help wondering why the Galaxia Palace needs to keep absorbing elemental power. Is there some kind of purpose to it...?
pasos: 1. Go to the Magma Field and look for the fire fairy named Firia.

2. Defeat the monsters that are putting out the flames:
  Ancestral Blu: /c$9%60577%/c*/ 200
3. Now that you've prevented the flames from going out, report back to Firia.

4. Protect the [Fire Gate] by defeating:
  Shadowmane Leo: /c$9%60578%/c*/ 1
5. Now that you've defended the gate, report back to Firia.

6. Collect [Fire Essence]:
  Bomber Guy: /c$9%60579%/c*/ 100
  Gas Guy: /c$9%60580%/c*/ 100
7. Once you've finished collecting [Fire Essence], give it to Firia to get your reward.

filas.intro: There's just one gate left that we need to fix now. Once it's fixed, will we have a better understanding of what's going on? Is this all related to the works of the Evil Lyceum? I wonder...
pasos: 1. Go to Rolling Sands and look for the earth sprite named Sandee.

2. Defeat the monsters digging up the dirt:
  Sandstormer: /c$9%60581%/c*/ 200
3. Now that you've gotten rid of the pesky things, report back to Sandee.

4. Protect the [Earth Gate] by defeating: 
  Speedy Sagitaur: /c$9%60582%/c*/ 1
5. Now that you've defended the gate, report back to Sandee.

6. Collect [Earth Essence]:
  Potate Digger: /c$9%60583%/c*/ 100
  Potate Driller: /c$9%60584%/c*/ 100
7. Once you've finished collecting [Earth Essence], give it to Sandee to get your reward.

filas.intro: Now that all four gates have been repaired, and Sandee has given us a thorough account of everything that has happened, it seems like there's no connection with the Evil Lyceum after all. But what worries me is the [Third Force] mentioned in the legends, and it reminds me of what [Jaggamir] said before...
pasos: 1. Go to the Horizon Library and look for Horizon Alpha.

2. Defeat the monsters in the central part of the archives:
Crystal Giant: /c$9%60585%/c*/ 200
3. Now that you've defended the central archives, report back to Horizon Beta.
4. Go to the [Special Spot] in the reading area to read the [Anecdote].

5. Teach the noisy monsters a lesson:
  Chalky Axeman: /c$9%60587%/c*/ 200
6. Now that the borders are quiet, you can return to the [Special Spot] to read the [Anecdote].
7. Return the [Anecdote] to the Horizon staff in the central part of the archives.
8. Report to the Horizon staff in the elemental books section to get your reward.

filas.intro: A young hunter is on his very first solo hunting trip. He has taken on a challenge from a veteran hunter, and has to bring back some Jadewing Birds and Lazuli Vialers. But these monsters tend to gather together in large groups, and he's afraid he won't be a match for them all. He's asked you to help him defeat some monsters, so that he can successfully carry out his task.
pasos:
1. Young Jeff wants you to help him defeat the following:
  Jadewing Bird: /c$9%60859%/c* / 160
Lazuli Vialer: /c$9%60860%/c* / 160
2. Now that you've defeated enough of the monsters, you can report back to Young Jeff.

filas.intro: The drunk old man detects your foot steps and calls out to you to state your purpose. After you reply him, he snootily challenges you to prove your worth, and asks you to fight Gate Pioneers and Gate Guards.
pasos:
1. The drunk hunter wants you to defeat the following:
  Gate Pioneer: /c$9%60862%/c* / 160
 Gate Guard: /c$9%60863%/c* / 160
2. Now that you've completed your task, report back to the drunk hunter to get your reward.

filas.intro: Lulu usually goes out with Ashe to gather herbs from Pristine Lake, but they've been arguing lately, and so she has been going alone. But the ingredients spoil quickly once gathered, and she needs to be quick in order to make potions. Since you're passing by, she's asked you to help her collect dew drops from Dewy Fae and golden crab roe from Violet Crabbo. She promises to give you a special potion if you help her.
pasos:
1. Help Herbalist Lulu collect the following:
  Dew Drops: /c$9%60865%/c* / 170 vials
  Golden Crab Roe: /c$9%60866%/c* / 170 bowls
2. Oof, the ingredients are heavy! Quick, go give them to Lulu now.
3. Please wait 5 minutes and then talk to Lulu again.

filas.intro: Ashe's younger twin brother has decided to become a hunter. To show his support, Ashe made a bow to give to his brother, but he was so busy making the bow that he forgot all about his anniversary with his girlfriend Lulu. He wants to make a necklace out of rare materials to appease her. But he's not all that good at fighting, and you need to kill a lot of monsters to get these rare materials. Help Ashe collect Fyreplumes from Fyrebirds and Fantasy Fur from Lavalions.
pasos:
1. Alchemist Ashe has asked you to help him collect the following: 
  Fyreplume: /c$9%60868%/c* / 2
  Fantasy Fur: /c$9%60869%/c* / 2
2. The materials look so beautiful! Let's hand them over to Ashe now.

filas.intro: Horizon Delta, the staff member at the entrance of the archives needs materials for the light pillars in the archives. But gathering them by himself seems way too boring, and since you're here, he'd like you to accompany him. Help collect Green Crystals from Jadeite Giants and Copper Bows from Ashen Centaurs.
pasos:
1. Help Horizon Delta collect the following: 
Green Crystal: /c$9%60871%/c* / 180
  Copper Bow: /c$9%60872%/c* / 180
2. These things are surprisingly heavy! Quick, take them to Horizon Delta now.

3. Defeat Chantra Esqua to get its Esqua Crystal.
  Esqua Crystal: /c$9%60873%/c* / 1
4. This crystal is brimming with magical power. Report back to Horizon Delta.

filas.intro: There is an intern without a title at the Horizon Archives. Hoping to become an official staff one day, she has to learn everything about the place itself. However, as the Frost Pixies and Chartreuses are causing a din nearby, she needs your help to teach them a lesson for disrupting her.
pasos:
1. Help the Horizon Intern defeat the following:
Frost Pixie: /c$9%60875%/c* / 180
  Chartreuse: /c$9%60876%/c* / 180
2. It's much more peaceful now! Let's return to where the Horizon Intern is.

3. To waste no time, help the Horizon Intern to search for the following:
Goblin Anatomy: /c$9%60877%/c* / 1
Slime Ecology: /c$9%60878%/c* / 1
Story Of A Foreign Princess: /c$9%60879%/c* / 1
Platelet Diaries: /c$9%60880%/c* / 1
4. These books seem to be for nerds. Bring them to the Horizon Intern.

filas.intro: Norwel and his friends were attacked by Goldcrowns, and they're all in a poison-induced haze. Please help defeat the Goldcrowns and disrupt their spell. That's the only way to save Norwel and his friends from the poison!
pasos:
1. Head over to the Galaxia Palace and defeat:
  Goldcrown: /c$9%61923%/c*/ 15
2. Go check on Norwel, and get your reward.

filas.intro: The Galaxia river water and lake have all frozen solid, and the townsfolk are facing problems with the lack of water flow. After investigating, they find out that Magtite Stark is behind this. Help them defeat the monster and return the water to its fluid state!
pasos: 1. Head over to Galaxia Palace and teach Magtite Stark a lesson:  /c$9%61924%/c*/ 1
2. Drag the monster back to Lady Yael to receive your reward.

filas.intro: Smith Cling has been wishing for a breakthrough in his blacksmith skills, and hopes for you to bring him the [Fire Ore] from the hands of Hephaestus. The Fire Ore improves the firepower of the furnace, and weapons forged out of it surely will become more powerful and durable!
pasos: 1. Head over to Galaxia Palace and defeat Hephaestus to obtain the Fire Ore.
2. The Fire Ore is in your hands! Bring it over to Smith Cling now.

filas.intro: Workman Clang has discovered that the Secret Area portal is starting to malfunction. If he doesn't get it fixed quickly, we might lose our only way to access that realm. Clang wants you to go to Galaxia Palace to get an electrowave stabilizer from Zeus. The sooner the better!
pasos: 1. Head over to Galaxia Palace and get an electrowave stablizer from Zeus.
2. Report back to Workman Clang and give him the electrowave stablizer.

filas.intro: Ominous Oriel has been absorbing large amounts of the four elemental powers, causing an imbalance in Galaxia, and the people have grown weak as a result. Fairy Airmi is asking you to go to Galaxia Palace and put a stop to Oriel's destructive ways. Let's go save the world!
pasos: 1. Head to the shadow quarters of Galaxia Palace and defeat Ominous Oriel to put a stop to his malicious plans.
2. Now that you've put a stop to Ominous Oriel, return to Fairy Airmi and tell her the good news!

filas.intro: Aliua has studied the [Supreme Power] contained within the [Forbidden Rune]. It's said to enable one to become more powerful and learn more skills. It is only granted to those who deserve it.\n
pasos:
1. Go to the Perilous Depths and defeat:
Pearl Cockatrice: /c$9%8783%/c*/200
  Ruby Cockatrice: /c$9%8784%/c*/200
2. Report back to Aliua after defeating the targets.

3. Collect at least 200 of each of the following materials:
Lv301 Ashen Berries
  Lv301 Spring Drops
  Lv301 Phoenix Fiber
  Lv301 Amber Stone
  Lv301 Tanzatox Fang
4. Earned the right of supremacy. Talk to Aliua to obtain the Supreme Power!

filas.intro:
エデン大陸の「世界像」に祈
りを捧げに行こう！

【クエスト報酬】
・経験値：100,000,000
・功績：10,000
・AM：50,000,000
pasos: 1.「竜の墓場」の「世界像」\nを調べて祈りを捧げよう。
2.「棘の荒野」の「世界像」\nを調べて祈りを捧げよう。
3.「幻影の湿地」の「世界像」\nを調べて祈りを捧げよう。
4.「エンジェル学園」にいる\n「ゴールド姫」に報告しよう。

filas.intro: Due to the lack of evidence, the fabled Yatiss has long faded from memory. Never did I expect to hear about Yatiss again, least of all from this blue little creature. [Puji] of the  Puji Village hopes you can help this blue creature.\n
pasos: 1. Dive into the ocean floor and learn more about the plan from Shaw at the Deep Trench.

2. Collect the required materials: 
Sea Collagen/c$9%63659%/c*/3 from Day Starry;
  Firm Seagrass/c$9%63660%/c*/3 from Green Gator.
3. Talk to Shaw after collecting the required materials.

4. Go to the bridge and proceed with the repairs:
Bridge's Entrance/c$9%63661%/c*/1;
  Bridge's Center/c$9%63662%/c*/1;
  Bridge's Exit/c$9%63663%/c*/1.
5. The seagrass bridge is fixed. Report back to Shaw.
6. To gain Shaw's trust, you must first prove your strength. Defeat Silver Sentinel /c$9%63664%/c*/200.
7. Complete the test and report back to Shaw.

filas.intro: The info on Yatiss is bleak as Lucas is unwilling to reveal more here. The ancient rift Lucas and Shaw mentioned sounds like two different places, yet they are the same. One certain thing is that the rift is a dark and scary place with watchful eyes lurking at every corner.\n
pasos:
1. Collect the following from the 
Night Starry:
Gem: /c$9%63665%/c*/1.
2. Talk to Orion at the Ancient Rift.
3. Return to the Deep Trench and collect the following from the Night Starry: Gem: /c$9%63666%/c*/4.
4. Return to the Ancient Rift and pass the Gems to Orion.

5. Go to the Dark Zone at the Ancient Rift and place the Gems at:
Dark Zone (16,74)
/c$9%63667%/c*/1;
  Dark Zone (92,75) /c$9%64166%/c*/1;
  Dark Zone (208,125) /c$9%64167%/c*/1;
  Dark Zone (222,15) /c$9%64168%/c*/1.
6. Light has been restored. Report back to Orion.

7. Defeat the man-eating: 
Angler/c$9%63668%/c*/200.
8. Most of the monsters are destroyed. Report back to Orion.

filas.intro: The former splendor of the desolate city shines upon entry. Shiny gems are used as energy sources and the surrounding giant bubble enables me to breathe underwater. Despite its technological prowess, there is deep sorrow in the air.\n
pasos: 1. Go to the Desolate City entrance via the Ancient Rift and ask the Gem Knight to let you through.

2. Accept the challenge and defeat his true form: 
Red Eliana: /c$9%63669%/c*/1.
3. Defeat the Gem Knight's true form and speak with him.
4. Go to the Desolate City's square and examine the Gem Stele I:  /c$9%63670%/c*/1.
5. Examine the Gem Stele II: /c$9%63671%/c*/1.
6. Examine the Gem Stele III: /c$9%63672%/c*/1.

7. Save Damian from the monsters' attack by defeating the Yellow Protector:
/c$9%63673%/c*/200.
8. Talk to Damian to show your concern.

filas.intro: The gem steles detail Yatiss's tragic history. As Damian mentioned, the Yatissians have developed a robot powerful enough to combat the Hydra. War is coming.\n
pasos: 1. Go to the Abyssal Arena and apply to join the Yatiss Elite through the YE Trainer.
2. Defeat the specified targets within the given time frame: Azure Beast: /c$9%63674%/c*/100. Report back to the YE Trainer.
3. Defeat the specified targets within the given time frame: Golden Beast: /c$9%63675%/c*/120. Report back to the YE Trainer.
4. Defeat the specified targets within the given time frame: Green Snail/c$9%63676%/c*/140. Report back to the YE Trainer.
5. Defeat the specified targets within the given time frame: Violet Snail/c$9%63677%/c*/160. Report back to the YE Trainer.
6. Defeat the specified targets within the given time frame: Mystic Snail/c$9%63678%/c*/1. Report back to the YE Trainer.

filas.intro: According to the gem steles' writings, Yatiss was created and destroyed by Poseidon. Even so, the Yatissians still held deep respect for their creator and continued to maintain Poseidon's shrine. Like the desolate city, this place is filled with a blinding light emitted by the gems. Just looking at the Poseidon statue cleanses one's mind.\n
pasos: 1. Approach the Poseidon Statue at the Poseidon Shrine.
2. Prove your strength by defeating: Brutal Nymph: /c$9%63679%/c*/200.
3. Prove your courage by defeating: Little Snake: /c$9%63680%/c*/200.
4. Prove your wisdom by defeating: Bewitcher/c$9%63681%/c*/1.
5. Return to the Poseidon Statue after completing the trials.
6. Prove your worth by defeating: Poseidon's Shadow /c$9%63682%/c*/1.
7. Return to the Poseidon Statue after completing the trials.

filas.intro: Nearing the Hadal Lair, the remains of those who perished in the war are seen lying around, serving as a constant reminder of Yatiss's ordeal. Now that the Yatissians are determined to fight back, I will fulfill my duty as a Yatiss Elite and assist them.\n
pasos: 1. Go to the Deep Prison and assist Produs.
2. Destroy the monsters in the south: Mordant Beast: /c$9%63684%/c*/200.
3. Destroy the monsters in the west: Moody Merman: /c$9%63685%/c*/200.
4. Destroy the monsters in the east: Red Protector /c$9%63686%/c*/200.
5. Destroy the monster in the north: Lair Watcher /c$9%63687%/c*/1.
6. Report back to Produs after destroying all the monsters.

filas.intro: The fisherman, Skinny, looks frantic and keeps muttering, "It's too late." Upon seeing you, he rushes forward and asks you to help with the fishing.\n
pasos: 1. Catch the following in this area: Pale Gator: /c$9%63691%/c*/200.
2. Report back to Skinny with your catch to get your reward.

filas.intro: The scarcity of food at the ancient rift has driven the monsters mad with hunger. To protect passersby from the monsters' vicious attacks, Titus needs you to feed the monsters.\n
pasos: 1. Capture the following monsters to use as monster feed: Mean Angler: /c$9%63693%/c*/200.

2. Place the feed at the following locations: 
North Gathering Spot: /c$9%63694%/c*/1;
  East Gathering Spot: /c$9%63695%/c*/1;
  West Gathering Spot: /c$9%63696%/c*/1;
  South Gathering Spot: /c$9%63697%/c*/1.
3. Report back to Titus to get your reward.

filas.intro: The inventory manager, Pete, is hiring volunteers to help replenish the supplies. Seeing there's nothing to do for now, why not give it a try?\n
pasos:
1. Obtain the following from the Jelly Orb:
 Delicate Gem: /c$9%63699%/c*/50;
  Feed Rod: /c$9%63700%/c*/50.
  Obtain the following from the Silver Steel:
  Robot Fuel: /c$9%63701%/c*/50 cans;
  Microchip: /c$9%63702%/c*/50.
2. Report back to Manager Pete with the items to get your reward.

filas.intro: Abyssal Arena is the Yatiss Elites' training ground. While most people admire the combatants, few appreciate the workers who help clean up the mess after training. If you don't mind, please help with the cleaning.\n
pasos: 1. Defeat the training's leftover monsters: Pink Protector: /c$9%63704%/c*/200.
2. Ask Worker Oz if it needs further assistance.
3. Send the following training monster back to its cage: Colorful Beast: /c$9%63705%/c*/1.
4. Report back to Worker Oz.

filas.intro: The magnificent Poseidon statues have a calming effect on the shrine's visitors. The cleaners here work tirelessly to keep the statues clean and would like you to lend them a hand.\n
pasos: 1. Drive out the monsters that are disturbing the shrine's peace: Wild Nymph /c$9%63707%/c*/200.
2. Peace is restored to the shrine. Report back to Kind Sally.

3. Clean the following: Holy Statue: /c$9%63708%/c*/1;
  Majestic Statue: /c$9%64248%/c*/1;
  Delicate Statue: /c$9%64249%/c*/1;
  Intricate Statue: /c$9%64250%/c*/1;
  Large Statue: /c$9%64251%/c*/1.
4. The statues are sparkling clean. Report back to Kind Sally to get your reward.

filas.intro: This area is very close to the Hadal Lair. Remains from the war are visible everywhere, reminding Yatissians of their past mistake.  You notice Faela comes here every day to pay respects to her friend. You decide to join her to lay beautiful corals across the area.\n
pasos:
1. Obtain the following from the Lair Monster: Offerings: /c$9%63710%/c*/1.
  Find the following at the side of the path:
  Beautiful Coral: /c$9%63711%/c*/1.
2. Pass the offerings and corals to Faela.
3. Place the offerings and corals before her friend's tombstone.
4. Talk to Faela to get your reward.

filas.intro: Due to the raging battle, Pierre the mask maker is facing a shortage in the materials used for manufacturing gas masks. To ensure the Yatiss troops are protected from the miasma of the Hadal Lair, he needs you to collect the materials for him.\n
pasos:
1. Pierre the mask maker needs you to collect the following from the Hadal Lair: Miasma Grass: /c$9%64593%/c*/10;
  Mucus: /c$9%64594%/c*/50 vials.
2. Report back to Pierre with the materials.

filas.intro: Bose has been attacking the Hadal Lair for years. His recent efforts to train recruits have forced the enemy to retaliate. Having learned about the brave recruit from the surface, he plans to weaken the lair's defenses by urging the Yatiss Elites to attack the female lieutenant and monsters within.\n
pasos: 1. General Bose seeks your help to kill the following monsters at the Hadal Lair: Fathom Queen: /c$9%64595%/c*/1;  Fathom Beast: /c$9%64596%/c*/1.
2. Report back to General Bose with the relics.

filas.intro: Decades ago, the brilliant robot maker, Finn, succeeded in fusing robotic and biological technology and created the most powerful robot - Yatiss Watcher. Blinded by ambition, he later captured and experimented on the Midgard Serpent and thus unleashed a monster upon Yatiss. Experiments were banned in Yatiss ever since.\n
pasos: 1. Help Inventor Finn by defeating the Midgard Serpent at the Hadal Lair: /c$9%64597%/c*/1.
2. Report back to Inventor Finn.

filas.intro: There's a biologist named Boris at the Desolate City who seeks to solve the secret of the Hydra's regenerative abilities and help the Yatiss Elite invade its lair. To that end, he needs you to collect large amounts of Abaddon's hatchling's samples.\n
pasos: 1. Help Biologist Boris collect the following from the Hadal Lair: Abaddon's Hatchling's Sample: /c$9%64598%/c*/20.
2. Report back to Boris with the samples.

filas.intro: A war between Yatiss and the Hydra, Sephtis, is on the horizon. Although Napos has led the Yatiss Elite to destroy all the monsters surrounding the lair, his attempt to eliminate the monsters within failed. Having learned about the brave Yatiss Elite from the surface, he has found new hope and is ready to challenge Sephtis once more!\n
pasos:
1. Commander Napos seeks your help to kill the Hydra at the Hadal Lair: 
Sephtis: /c$9%64599%/c*/1.
2. The evil of Yatiss is destroyed. Inform Napos about your victory.

filas.intro: Christmas is approaching, but the children's presents have been stolen by a bunch of thieves! Head to X'mas Village to stop this nightmare from ruining the children's Christmas night!
pasos: 1. Defeat X'mas Thieves: /c$9%64992%/c*/ 200
2. Head back to Santa Claus upon completing the challenge.

filas.intro:
After a discussion with [Hestia], Archangel Michael has decided to leave a clone of himself in [Angel Lyceum] to aid players in completing quests to become [competent angels]!
※Don't forget to look for [Angels' Tutor] if you are new to the game!
pasos: 1. Collect a set of the [Four Elemental Cards] and give them to [Hestia]. Ask [Hestia] for directions.
2. Get any of the [Four Main Cities Quest Expert] achievement! Ask [Hestia] for directions.
3. Reach Rank 5! Earn Credits by clearing quests and taking part in Daily Events!
4. Learn more than 100 [Spell Stances] or more than 50 [Recipes]. You can learn more stances and recipes as your level up higher.
5. Collect 10 [Dailies Silver Coins] and give them to [Hestia]! Feel free to ask her questions too.
6. Get the achievement [Lv 1-3 Item Fusion Master]. Go to Fusion and click on [Description] for more details.
7. Defeat [Nemeo] once, or complete 500 Orders!

filas.intro: The Red Desert is too hot! The icy goodies at Wintry Realm might help ease the heat, but Paula can't leave her post. She hopes you can get her some of the goodies before she gets a heatstroke.
pasos:
1. Obtain items from the
 monsters at Wintry Realm:
 Cute Penguin's Cool Lollipop: /c$9%66999%/c*/ 15.
 Ice Sentry's Lance Shard:
 /c$9%67000%/c*/ 15.
2. Give Paula the icy items and collect the reward.

filas.intro: Enid is a curious elf who wishes to know the origins behind the snow woman and snowman at Wintry Realm. She hopes you can help obtain some materials.
pasos:
1. Obtain materials from these Wintry Realm's monsters:
 Floating Snow Girl: /c$9%67001%/c*/ 25.
 Yeti: /c$9%67002%/c*/ 25.
2. Give Enid the materials and collect the reward.

filas.intro: Duddy might be incapable of magic, but he wants to do his part to protect the Elf Village. Mighty Leon's mane is rumored to grant magical powers. Maybe you can help him get it.
pasos: 1. Go to Land of Roars at Wintry Realm and subdue Mighty Leon!
2. You've obtained Mighty Leon's mane. Give it to Duddy.

filas.intro: Sancross has always been grateful towards Ice Giant Hydea for bringing her forebears to the Elf Village for refuge during the Millennium War. She hopes you can go to Wintry Realm and calm Hydea down.
pasos: 1. Go to Howl Wasteland at Wintry Realm and defeat Ice Giant Hydea.
2. You've calmed Ice Giant Hydea down. Report back to Sancross.

filas.intro: Seasonia's powers will hurt the people of the Elf Village and throw Eden into chaos. To protect everyone, Wonda seeks your help to defeat the Elf Queen!
pasos: 1. Go to Frozen Domain at Wintry Realm and defeat Seasonia!
2. Inform Wonda about Seasonia's defeat.

filas.intro: A stranger at the Four Main Cities comes to you in tears, saying that his friend has been captured and wounded by the evil elves. He hopes for you to go to the Elf Kingdom and rescue his friend.
pasos: 1. Fat Ryder begs you to head over to Spring Garden and save his friend, Jumpy Andy, from the violent elves.

2. Help Jumpy Andy punish:
Powdery Pixie: /c$9%67037%/c*/ 150.
3. Go back and check on Jumpy Andy.

4. Retrieve Andy's weapons from the Grass Fairy:
Steel Dagger: /c$9%67038%/c*/ 1.
 Iron Bat: /c$9%67039%/c*/ 1.
5. Return the weapons to Jumpy Andy.

6. Obtain the following from Fairy Rose:
Special Herb: /c$9%67040%/c*/ 1.
7. Give the herb to Jumpy Andy while it's still fresh.

filas.intro: It's not clear why the elves are attacking the humans, but they must be stopped. You need to find the other abducted humans quickly.
pasos: 1. Jumpy Andy says the elves have taken his friend. Go to Silent Lakeside and pursue the elves.

2. Rescue Cloud by defeating:
 Teen Fairy: /c$9%67041%/c*/ 160.
3. You've driven most of the elves away. Approach Cloud and see how he's doing.

4. Plant the explosives at these nearby spots:
Northern Spot: /c$9%67042%/c*/ 1.
 Eastern Spot: /c$9%67043%/c*/ 1.
Southern Spot: /c$9%67044%/c*/ 1.
5. Plant the explosives as instructed and report back to Cloud.

6. Help Cloud capture:
Tiny Sprout: /c$9%67045%/c*/ 180.
  Baby Sprout: /c$9%67046%/c*/ 180.
7. Take the monsters to Cloud.

filas.intro: The elves are indeed a force to be reckoned with. Looking into the elves' fearful eyes, sympathy rose within you. No matter what, you vow to defeat the elves and save the humans.
pasos: 1. Go to Red Desert and find Boss Locke.

2. Help Boss Locke deal with:
Banana Fairy: /c$9%67047%/c*/ 200.
3. The task is done. Report back to Boss Locke.
4. Persuade Elder Summer Elf.

5. Ask about the truth behind the incident:
 Summer Bee: /c$9%67048%/c*/ 1.
 Ruby Lizard: /c$9%67049%/c*/ 1.
6. Return and speak with Elder Summer Elf.

7. Collect the materials by borrowing the following from Mouse Smith:
 Log: /c$9%67050%/c*/ 5.
 Nail: /c$9%67051%/c*/ 10.
 Go to Spring Garden after 
 the collection:
 Fix the damaged entrance: /c$9%67052%/c*/ 1.
8. Report back to Elder Summer Elf at Red Desert.

filas.intro: Turns out you were deceived by the humans. To make up to the elves, you decide to help rebuild their kingdom and drive out the humans. Besides this, you learn about an unexpected threat.
pasos:
1. Defeat the humans at Red Desert:
Sweaty Brute: /c$9%67053%/c*/ 200.
2. Go to Chilly Village and find Elf Eiffel.

3. Defeat the terrible humans:
Playful Brat: /c$9%67054%/c*/ 200.
 Lazy Oaf: /c$9%67055%/c*/ 200.
4. Report back to Elf Eiffel.

5. Obtain the following at the lakeside:
Water of Life: /c$9%67056%/c*/ 4.
6. Fetch the lake water and give it to Elf Eiffel.

7. Treat the wounded elves at the Elf Kingdom:
 Spring Garden: /c$9%67057%/c*/ 1.
 Silent Lakeside: /c$9%67058%/c*/ 1.
 Red Desert: /c$9%67059%/c*/ 1.
 Chilly Village: /c$9%67060%/c*/ 1.
8. Return to Chilly Village and report to Elf Eiffel.

filas.intro: The arrival of the humans has disrupted the peace of the Elf Kingdom and the seasons across Eden. Help restore order to the Elf Kingdom before the situation aggravates.
pasos: 1. Go to Pink Woods and talk to Elder Autumn Elf. He needs your help too.

2. Help drive out the humans:
Autumn Imp: /c$9%67061%/c*/ 200.
 Ambusher Amber: /c$9%67062%/c*/ 1.
3. Report back to Elder Autumn Elf.

4. Calm the animals down:
Gobbly Squirrel: /c$9%67063%/c*/ 200.
5. The animals have calmed down. Report back to Elder Autumn Elf.

6. Drip the Vigor Solution on the:
 Broken northern tree: /c$9%67064%/c*/ 1.
 Damaged eastern tree: /c$9%67065%/c*/ 1.
 Damaged western tree: /c$9%67066%/c*/ 1.
7. The task is done. Report back to Elder Autumn Elf.

filas.intro: The elves worry that the queen's rage will eventually invoke a war in Eden. To salvage the situation, the elves have one last urgent task for you.
pasos: 1. Go to Frozen Region and find Elder Winter Elf.

2. Help drive out the humans:
Fierce Warrior: /c$9%67067%/c*/ 200.
  Duelist Kota: /c$9%67068%/c*/ 1.
3. Report back to Elder Winter Elf.

4. Get rid of the intruders at the hot spring area:
Bathing Monkey: /c$9%67069%/c*/ 200.

5. Go to the hot spring area and fetch some water. Pour the water on the:
 Ice Crystal: /c$9%67071%/c*/ 3 times.
6. The hot spring water is ineffective. Report back to Elder Winter Elf.
7. Go to Red Desert and seek Elder Summer Elf's help to get rid of the ice crystal.
8. Report back to Elder Winter Elf.

filas.intro: The annual meteor shower is coming, yet the stars are dimming. The monsters out there have also become more violent. I hope you can get to the bottom of this.
pasos:
1. Go to the Lake Fields and collect:
Magic Fragment: /c$9%67077%/c*/100.
After that, look for the Astrologer.
2. Talk to the Astrologer the next day.

3. Go to the Lake Fields and collect:
Star Shard: /c$9%67078%/c*/150.
After that, look for the Star Witch.
4. Go to the Lake Fields the next day and collect Star Shards for the Star Witch.

5. Go to the Lake Fields and collect:
Star Shard: /c$9%67175%/c*/200.
After that, look for the Star Witch.
6. Return to the Lake Fields the next day and collect Star Shards for the Star Witch.

7. Go to the Lake Fields and collect:
Star Shard: /c$9%67176%/c*/200.
After that, look for the Star Witch.
8. Look for the Star Witch at the Lake Fields the next day and ask about the crystal ball.

filas.intro: The monsters' pollens are exacerbating Mucus Lad's sneezing. He hopes you can drive out the monsters before his mucus forms a puddle of slime.
pasos:
1. Drive out Spring Garden's: 
Blossom Fairy: /c$9%67136%/c*/ 100.
 Tulip Envoy: /c$9%67137%/c*/ 100.
2. Report back to Mucus Lad.

filas.intro: A badly bruised Little Mia crouches by the lakeside. She claims that she's been beaten by the Lake Monkey and Idle Boxer, and asks you to seek justice for her.
pasos:
1. Defeat Silent Lakeside's:
Idle Boxer: /c$9%67139%/c*/ 150.
  Repentance Report: /c$9%67140%/c*/ 50.
2. Report back to Little Mia.

3. Defeat Silent Lakeside's:
Lake Monkey: /c$9%67141%/c*/ 150.
Apology Banana: /c$9%67142%/c*/ 50.
4. Report back to Little Mia.

filas.intro: To think that someone would bask in the sun despite the heat! Things get stranger when he wants me to find him a warmer spot.
pasos:
1. Catch Red Desert's:
Earth Spirit: /c$9%67144%/c*/ 100.
2. Bring your catch to Pupow.

3. Obtain Fairy Gonana's:
Banana Skin: /c$9%67145%/c*/ 1.
4. Bring the Banana Skins to Pupow.

filas.intro: Little Rascal keeps pestering you to play with him. Unwilling to see him cry, you decide to oblige.
pasos:
1. Stand on Diver Croc's goggles and:
Draw: /c$9%67147%/c*/ 150 times.
2. Report back to Little Rascal.

3. Steal Guard Studdy's:
Wooden Rod: /c$9%67148%/c*/ 1.
4. Report back to Little Rascal.

filas.intro: While passing by, you hear a loud noise and realize Glutto lying by the side of the road. Poor Glutto says he hasn't eaten anything since he came here to look for special ingredients for the autumn festival. You decide to help him.
pasos:
1. Catch the fleshy:
Brown Crab: /c$9%67150%/c*/ 150.
2. Pass the acquired ingredients to Glutto.

3. Catch the aromatic:
Fragrant Shroom: /c$9%67151%/c*/ 150.
4. Pass the acquired ingredients to Glutto.

filas.intro: Shifu Harte has snatched the bathing tub, leaving Froggy shivering by the hot spring. Retrieve the bathing tub for Froggy to let him bathe without getting cooked.
pasos:
1. Defeat Shifu Harte and retrieve:
Bathing Tub: /c$9%67153%/c*/ 1.
2. Bring the Bathing Tub to Froggy.

filas.intro: Although the crystal ball is fixed, the monsters are still wreaking havoc at the Lake Fields. Destroy them and restore peace to the area.\n
pasos:
1. Go to the Lake Fields and defeat: 
Mystic Jelly: /c$9%67156%/c*/50.
2. Report back to the Star Witch.

filas.intro: The brave traveler, Mr. Porter, has seen much of the world, but he has one weakness: rabbits. Help him defeat the rabbits that are blocking his way.
pasos:
1. Defeat Pier Lane's:
  Stout Rabbit: /c$9%69762%/c* / 150
2. Report back to Mr. Porter.

3. Defeat Way Ants:
  Retrieve Mr. Porter's
  Luggage: /c$9%69761%/c*/ 1
4. Return the Luggage to Mr. Porter.

filas.intro: Big Glutton never pays for his meal and scared the chef's customers away. Enraged, the chef plans to get back the money that Big Glutton owes him.
pasos:
1. Defeat Big Glutton:
  Take Big Glutton's
  wallet: /c$9%69763%/c*/ 1
2. Pass Big Glutton's wallet to Chef Ramsay.

filas.intro: The Bath Area is Eden's most popular tourist attraction. Besides being overloaded,  its manager has just received another customer complaint. Help her appease the customer.
pasos: 1. Find the complaining customer.

2. Defeat Roaming Lizard:
  Retrieve the stolen feather
  coat: /c$9%69764%/c*/ 1

3. Report to Satine:
  Obtain the 5-Star Rating
  Symbol: /c$9%69765%/c*/ 1
4. Pass the 5-Star Rating Symbol to Manager Annie.

filas.intro: The horse breeder is troubled because his horse is bad-tempered and a fussy eater. Help him obtain the required feed.
pasos:
1. Collect the following from Silver Knight, One-Horned Beast, and Pale Centaur:
  Wondrous Nuts: /c$9%69766%/c*/ 50
  Frost Wine: /c$9%69767%/c*/ 50
  Centaur's Product: /c$9%69768%/c*/ 50
2. Report to Breeder William.

filas.intro: The soldiers have been hearing sounds of sorrowful singing after midnight. They believe the camp is haunted. You decide to investigate the matter.
pasos: 1. Talk to the Garrison Guard.
2. Talk to the Guard Captain.

3. Obtain the proof of Droopy Crow's prank:
  Prank Booklet: /c$9%69770%/c*/ 1
4. Pass the proof to Guard Alfen.

filas.intro: The worker is clearing the objects lying on the road between the Arena and Bath Area, but his cart broke down midway. Please buy a new cart for him at the item shop.
pasos:
1. Buy the following from the Roaming Merchant:
  Cart: /c$9%69771%/c*/ 1
2. Pass the cart to Worker Sean.

3. Drive out:
  Glaring Giant: /c$9%69772%/c*/ 100
  Armored Wolf: /c$9%69773%/c*/ 100
  Payne: /c$9%69774%/c*/ 100
4. Report to Worker Sean.

filas.intro: An oddly dressed lady at the Four Main Cities pulls you to a corner and tells you about Eden's present ordeal. She says there may be a chance to prevent it if she takes you to Hasse.
pasos: 1. Meet Horos at Pier Lane.

2. Protect Horos and defeat:
  Fighter Ant: /c$9%70372%/c*/ 150
3. Return and check on Horos.
4. Help Horos find the token.
5. Take the token to Horos.

6. Defeat:
  Intrusion Guard: /c$9%70373%/c* / 150
7. Find Jaymus.

filas.intro: As told by Jaymus, you arrive at the market to meet Athena. Meanwhile, you learn about the reason behind Eden's ordeal and how to stop it.
pasos: 1. To understand the situation, go to Busy Market and find Athena.

2. Paste the flyers containing hidden messages at the following Busy Market areas:
  Northeastern Area: /c$9%70374%/c*/ 1
  Southwestern Area: /c$9%70375%/c*/ 1
  Southeastern Area: /c$9%70376%/c*/ 1
  Northwestern Area: /c$9%70377%/c*/ 1
3. Report to Athena.

4. Obtain from the Thieving Wolf:
  Military Material: /c$9%70378%/c*/ 170
5. Pass the unknown item to Athena for confirmation.

6. Check if there are other similar items.
  Obtain information from the
  Hopping Mouse: /c$9%70379%/c*/ 170

7. Check if there are other similar items.
  Obtain information from the
  King Hopper: /c$9%70380%/c*/ 1
8. Report to Athena.

filas.intro: As told by Athena, you arrive at the Bath Area to meet Erosia. As time is tight, you decide to proceed with the plan even though you feel things aren't as simple as they seem.
pasos: 1. Go to Bath Area and find Erosia.

2. Break the enemy's defenses by defeating:
  Wise Lizard: /c$9%70381%/c*/ 200
3. Report to Erosia.
4. Obtain spring water: /c$9%70382%/c*/ 1
5. Tell Erosia what you overheard.

6. Tie up the loose ends by defeating:
  Gaping Dragon: /c$9%70383%/c*/ 200
  Green Merman: /c$9%70384%/c*/ 200
7. Report to Erosia.

filas.intro: Besides stopping the war, you must rescue the prisoners at the Arena. Nothing is more precious than people's lives.
pasos: 1. Go to the Manège, and pass the spring water to Cyroz.

2. Protect the market by stopping:
  Dark Beast: /c$9%70385%/c*/ 200
3. Report to Cyroz.

4. Retaliate by defeating: 
  Honor Knight: /c$9%70386%/c*/200 
  Horned Pegasus: /c$9%70387%/c*/ 1 
  Get the following from
  Honor Knight:
  Hypnotic Grass: /c$9%70409%/c*/ 100

5. Place and light the Hypnotic Grasses at the:
  Northwestern Area: /c$9%70388%/c*/ 1 
  Northern Area: /c$9%70389%/c*/ 1 
  Northeastern Area: /c$9%70390%/c*/ 1 
  Eastern Area: /c$9%70391%/c*/ 1
6. Report to Cyroz.

7. Defeat:
  Beefy Rabbit: /c$9%70392%/c*/ 200
8. Report to Samuss.

filas.intro: Let the enemy have a taste of their own medicine. Infiltrate Ares' camp amid the chaos.
pasos:
1. Defeat: 
  Black Magpie: /c$9%70393%/c*/ 200
2. Report to Samuss, and rest up.

3. Check out the hidden messages on the following statues:
  Ares Statue: /c$9%70394%/c*/ 1
  Baphomet Statue: /c$9%70395%/c*/ 1
  Goblin Statue: /c$9%70396%/c*/ 1
4. Inform Samuss about the hidden messages.

5. Defeat:
  Centaur Archer: /c$9%70397%/c*/ 200
  Pink Robbie: /c$9%70398%/c*/ 1
6. Tell Samuss the good news.

7. Divert the enemy's attention by creating smoke signals at the:
  Northwestern Area: /c$9%70399%/c*/ 1
  Northern Area: /c$9%70400%/c*/ 1
  Northeastern Area: /c$9%70401%/c*/ 1
8. Consult Samuss about the next course of action.

filas.intro: After a series of battles, you come to the Arena. You must stop Ares to end the war and save the people.
pasos: 1. Go to the Champions' Arena and meet Deroyxia.

2. Defeat the following Ares' troops:
  Dragon Soldier: /c$9%70402%/c*/ 200
  Bull Lord: /c$9%70403%/c*/ 200
3. Report to Deroyxia.

4. Collect the following from Ant Warrior:
  Special Adhesive: /c$9%70404%/c*/ 50

5. Set adhesive traps at the:
  Western Tunnel: /c$9%70405%/c*/ 1 
  Northern Tunnel: /c$9%70406%/c*/ 1 
  Southern Tunnel: /c$9%70407%/c*/ 1
6. Report to Deroyxia.

7. Uproot the problem by defeating:
  Tauros: /c$9%70408%/c*/ 1
8. Report to Deroyxia.

filas.intro: You have saved the people of Reguile Kingdom, but Ares' military power is still very strong. To reach him, you must first weaken  his military power.
pasos:
1. Obtain the following items from the Warring Realm's monsters:
  Harthus' Harthus
  Feathers: /c$9%71087%/c*/ 15
  Sharp Magpie's Feathered
  Bow: /c$9%71088%/c*/ 15
2. Pass the items to Kefiar, and collect your reward.

filas.intro: Isus takes notice of your ancient token and learns that it is linked to the underworld's sudden disappearance years ago. Meanwhile, a mysterious cave has appeared at the Warring Realm's border. You suspect it might be related to this token.
pasos: 1. Obtain the Token Intel from the monsters at the Warring Realm's Path of Darkness: /c$9%71089%/c*/ 50
2. Pass the intel to Isus, and collect your reward.

filas.intro: Despite Ares' harsh treatment for his objection, Uri remains loyal to Ares and hopes you can put a stop to Ares' plan.
pasos: 1. Go to the Shrine of Victory at the Warring Realm, and defeat Ares.
2. Report to Uri.

filas.intro: Rhodia has told you everything about what she knows about the underworld's reappearance. To investigate further, you must defeat the enemies that stand in the way.
pasos: 1. Go to the Purgatory Hall at the Warring Realm, and defeat Cerberus.
2. Report to Rhodia and tell her you've removed the hindrance to the investigation.

filas.intro: Virence is the prince of the underworld. After learning that the truth is not what the Evil Lyceum claimed to be, he tried to stop Hades but failed. Hence, he returned to Reguile Kingdom to look for help.
pasos: 1.  Go to the Shrine of Tartarus at the Warring Realm, and defeat Hades.
2. Report to Virence.

filas.intro: A young girl has appeared in the four main cities of the Hasse continent, her expression helpless and urgent as she searches for something. She asks everyone she meets if they have any knowledge of the great war that occurred in the Hasse Kingdom in the past. Her quest is to find the warrior who once aided Athena in that war.
pasos: 1. Meet up with Kamenosuke, who is in charge of reception, at the Floating Station.
2: Rescue Kamenosuke and defeat: Blue Jagsharks /c$9%72163%/c*/ 150.
3. Return to check on Kamenosuke's condition.

4. Defeat Fierce Roughskin and collect:
  Viscous Liquid /c$9%72164%/c*/ 3.
  Defeat Saltwater Octo and collect:
  Tough Tentacles /c$9%72165%/c*/ 3.
5. Once you have collected the repair materials, go back and find Kamenosuke.

6. Repair:
  Railway (Front): /c$9%72166%/c*/1
  Railway (Middle): /c$9%72167%/c*/1
  Railway (Back): /c$9%72168%/c*/1
7. After the railway repairs are complete, report back to Kamenosuke.

filas.intro: After a long journey, you finally arrive in the territory of the Sun Empire. The sparsely populated city is a shadow of its former prosperity, and now only a group of impoverished people call it home. It's no wonder Princess Otohime is so anxious about the future of her empire.
pasos: 1. Talk to the station attendant and board the train bound for the Sun Sea Maze.
2: Speak with Princess Otohime.

3. Defeat
 Blacktail Masks /c$9%72171%/c*/ 200.
4. Successfully defeat the Blacktail Mask and report back to Princess Otohime.
5. Find Sir Arima and inquire if there are any relevant clues regarding the incident.

6. Capture:
  Can Crawlie: /c$9%72172%/c*/ 200.
  Nekoemon: /c$9%72173%/c*/ 1.
7. Search for the note hidden underneath a buddha statue.
8. After finding the hidden note, report back to Princess Otohime.

filas.intro: The note detailing an object that needs to be destroyed appears highly suspicious. Without delay, you make the decision to retrieve it immediately.
pasos: 1. Go to the Dragon Palace and inquire with Elder Fukumatsu for more information.
2: Go to the Dragon King's bedroom and see if there are any clues.

3. Defeat Latte Troop to get:
 Rusty Mainspring /c$9%72175%/c*/ 1.
4. Use Rusty Mainspring to open the hidden compartment and retrieve Broken Article /c$9%72176%/c*/ 1.
5. Bring the Broken Article back and inquire with Elder Fukumatsu.

6. Find materials for repairs:
  Wood: /c$9%72177%/c*/ 2.
  Nails: /c$9%72178%/c*/ 2.
7. Bring the repair materials and go find Sir Imadoki.

filas.intro: You bring the damaged object and the materials needed for its repair to the hot springs to look for Sir Imadoki's help, but it seems he appears to be preoccupied...
pasos: 1. Assist in clean up: Contaminated Bubbles: /c$9%72179%/ 200
2: Report back to Sir Imadoki.

3. Defeat
 Ageless Ghost: /c$9%72180%/c*/ 200.
4. Report back to Sir Imadoki.

5. Defeat White Lava and collect:
  Beauty Essences: /c$9%72181%/c*/ 5.
6. Report back to Sir Imadoki
7. Head to the Verdant Shrine to search for clues.

filas.intro: Following Sir Imadoki's advice, you examine the repaired object and discover that its pattern matches the emblem of the Bamboo Grove Shrine. Intrigued, you venture to the shrine, only to find a powerful barrier blocking the bridge that leads to it. Despite your best efforts, you find yourself unable to cross and reach the other side.
pasos: 1. Search for clues nearby.

 to Miner Aman.

 progress.

 materials to Sheriff Hirojiro.

 Bloom.

 disaster relief to Rich
 Kaneshiro.

 Yamaguchi.

  Spider: /c$9%78302%/c* / 100.

  Curry.

  Rogue Monkey.

  from Fat Tyrant William.

3.Report back to the
  Vendor Normar.

  Racer: /c$9%78307%/c* / 50.
  Night Raging Monkey:
  /c$9%78308%/c* / 50.

  Popcorn Maniac: /c$9%78310%/c* / 100.

2.Report back to Manager
  Gable.

  Challenger: /c$9%78312%/c* / 50.

  Keke.

  Warrior: /c$9%78313%/c* / 50.

  Keke.

filas.intro: Wanderers who exist in various places usually lead a nomadic life, roaming from place to place. They are always able to keep up with the latest local rumors and information. Go seek out Miro, the wanderer at the harbor, for confirmation of clues regarding venturing deep into the Secret Peak.
pasos:
1.Head to the skywalk on
  the Secret Peak, Defeat
  the Power Cannons:
  /c$9%78694%/c* / 15.

2.Report back to Wanderer
  Milo.

filas.intro: The source of evil energy is hidden within the Secret Peak, but you must first defeat the monsters in the plaza to prevent them from guarding the entrance to the Restricted Zone. These monsters possess powerful energy and can continuously launch attacks against intruders. You have been entrusted with the task of defeating the core monster guarding them, in order to prevent the monsters from becoming even stronger.
pasos:
1.Head to the Garden Plaza
  at the Secret Peak and
  defeat Speed Knight:
  /c$9%78695%/c* / 15.

2.Report back to Mercenary
  Brett.

filas.intro: Intelligent guards manufactured with cutting-edge technology possess special modifications on their bodies. In order to verify the technological development of the Nest of Babylon's forces, intelligence agents are planning to confirm these technologies. If you can obtain samples of the metal components, it will help in resisting them and identifying their core technologies, allowing you to devise a perfect counter-strategy. You have been commissioned to acquire them.
pasos:
1.Head to the Restricted
  Zone of the Secret Peak,
  defeat the Speedy
  Automaton, and retrieve
  the metal material from
  its armor.

2.Report back to
  Information Merchant
  Henry.

filas.intro: In the Habitat Cabin located on the Secret Peak, there are records of the mastermind behind this case entering and leaving this place. To prevent relevant clues from being effectively erased by members within the organization, it is currently necessary to seek out Noble Morgan for questioning and assist with the investigation.
pasos:
1.Head to the Habitat
  Cabin in the Secret
  Peak, defeat Court Eagle
  Cassidy, and obtain new
  clues.

2.Report back to Noble
  Morgan.

filas.intro: The nearby guard, Collins, has learned about the evil plans by "Babel Technology". He informs you that it is necessary to stop the crisis originating from the Laboratory. If their plan succeeds, it could bring about great harm. You must ensure that this city can return to peace.
pasos:
1.Head to the Laboratory
  in the Secret Peak, and
  defeat Ba'shin!

2.Report back to Guard
  Collins.
